subtitle: "Within-property near–far price gaps: attention regressions from 2014, sales price profiles from 1995"
author: "Jacopo Olivieri"

  reestimate: true
  fixtures_only: false
format:

    toc: true

    code-fold: true
    code-tools: true
    theme: cosmo
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <style>

                     font-size: .85rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
        main th, main td { padding: .45rem .5rem; vertical-align: top; }
        main thead { border-bottom: 2px solid #b9c4ca; }

        </style>

  message: false
  cache: false

This report asks whether the same properties near mapped sewage overflows
experienced different price changes from farther properties as national sewage
attention increased. It extends the extensive-margin news analysis with
repeat-property panels: property fixed effects replace location fixed effects,
so the near–far gap is identified from within-property price changes across
calendar months. The attention regressions use sales from January 2014 through
December 2024 and rentals from January 2014 through December 2023. The sales
annual near–far price profiles use a separate, wider panel: every property with
two eligible sale dates between January 1995 and December 2024, so the longer
history of relative prices can be inspected; the rental profiles keep the
2014–2023 panel.

The findings come first: the coefficient comparison across the full model grid,
the headline cells, and the annual near–far profiles. The design section gives
the equations, sample variants and inference conventions; the full-results
section carries every cell, its estimation support and the residual-variation
measures; the sample-flows section regenerates the readiness evidence (mapping
integrity, current-address verification, the exclusion ledger, exposure and the
attention calendar); limitations and the reproduction contract follow, and the
Appendix explains what the improved repeat-data cleaning resolved. Every number
is computed from the results bundle that this render either rebuilt or
validated and loaded.

```{r}
#| label: helpers-inputs
#| include: false

`%chin%` <- data.table::`%chin%`

# ---- Market configuration ------------------------------------------------------

market_config <- function(market) {
  if (!is.character(market) || length(market) != 1L || !market %in% MARKETS) {
    stop("Unknown market: ", paste(market, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
  }
  cfg <- CONFIG[[market]]
  cfg$market <- market
  cfg$panel <- "scalar"
  cfg
}

# The annual-profile window of a market: the scalar configuration with `start`
# replaced by `profile_start` (the end is shared). Every sample rule is reused
# through this configuration rather than reinterpreted (KTD1).
profile_config <- function(cfg) {
  if (is.null(cfg$profile_start)) {
    stop("Market configuration lacks `profile_start`.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  if (cfg$profile_start > cfg$start) {
    stop("`profile_start` cannot be later than the scalar `start`.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  cfg$start <- cfg$profile_start
  cfg$panel <- "profile"
  cfg
}

# TRUE when the annual profiles need their own panel (a wider window than the
# scalar cells); FALSE when they share the scalar headline panel unchanged.
separate_profile_window <- function(cfg) {
  !identical(as.Date(cfg$profile_start), as.Date(cfg$start))
}

# Months since the article origin, origin month = 1. Earlier months are zero or
# negative: the index is a calendar-month identifier for fixed effects and is
# valid for any date; only the attention join (scalar panels) requires it to
# fall inside the article calendar.
calendar_month_index <- function(dates, origin = CONFIG$article_origin) {
  as.integer(
    (lubridate::year(dates) - lubridate::year(origin)) * 12L +
      lubridate::month(dates) -
      lubridate::month(origin) +
      1L
  )
}

# The list shape that build_address_key()/validate_repeat_config() expect. Paths
# other than the input are placeholders: nothing is written and `publish` is unset.
repeat_key_config <- function(cfg) {
  list(
    id_col = cfg$id_col,
    date_col = cfg$date_col,
    price_col = cfg$price_col,
    postcode_col = "postcode",
    address_cols = cfg$address_cols,
    primary_address_col = cfg$primary_address_col,
    input_path = cfg$history_path,
    output_path = "read-only",
    log_file = "read-only",
    large_group_review_path = "read-only",
    price_ratio_review_path = "read-only",
    same_day_review_path = "read-only",
    market = cfg$market,
    year_min = lubridate::year(cfg$start),
    year_max = lubridate::year(cfg$end),
    key_coverage_floor = 0,
    repeat_share_floor = 0,
    large_group_size = CONFIG$large_group_size,
    extreme_annualized_price_ratio = CONFIG$extreme_annualized_price_ratio
  )
}

history_columns <- function(cfg) {
  extra <- if (cfg$market == "rentals") "rented" else character()
  unique(c(
    cfg$id_col,
    cfg$date_col,
    cfg$price_col,
    cfg$address_cols,
    cfg$change_cols,
    cfg$control_cols,
    "country",
    "easting",
    "northing",
    "lsoa",
    "msoa",
    "quality",
    extra
  ))
}

# The stored repeat_count is full-window and never consulted (eligibility is
# recomputed from surviving dates), so it is not read.
mapping_columns <- function(cfg) c(cfg$id_col, "repeat_id")

review_path <- function(cfg, suffix) {
  sub("\\.parquet$", paste0("_", suffix, ".parquet"), cfg$mapping_path)
}

# ---- Blocking conditions -------------------------------------------------------

# A validation failure that the plan says should stop the affected market, not
# the whole run. prepare_market_panel() catches this class and records the market
# as blocked with `details`; any other error propagates and stops the render.
block_market <- function(market, stage, message, details = NULL) {
  cond <- structure(
    class = c("market_blocked", "error", "condition"),
    list(
      message = sprintf("[%s / %s] %s", market, stage, message),
      call = NULL,
      market = market,
      stage = stage,
      details = details
    )
  )
  stop(cond)
}

# ---- Input readability and provenance -----------------------------------------

assert_readable_input <- function(path, label, market = NA_character_) {
  fail <- function(msg) {
    if (is.na(market)) {
      stop(msg, call. = FALSE)
    }
    block_market(market, "input", msg)
  }
  if (
    !is.character(path) ||
      length(path) != 1L ||
      is.na(path) ||
      !file.exists(path)
  ) {
    fail(sprintf(
      "Required input `%s` is unreadable: file not found at %s",
      label,
      path
    ))
  }
  reader <- tryCatch(
    arrow::ParquetFileReader$create(path),
    error = function(e) {
      fail(sprintf(
        "Required input `%s` is unreadable: %s (%s)",
        label,
        path,
        conditionMessage(e)
      ))
    }
  )
  invisible(reader)
}

parquet_file_info <- function(path, label, market = NA_character_) {
  reader <- assert_readable_input(path, label, market)
  schema <- reader$GetSchema()
  list(
    n_rows = as.numeric(reader$num_rows),
    columns = names(schema),
    metadata = schema$metadata
  )
}

generation_id_from_metadata <- function(metadata) {
  candidates <- c("cleaning_run_stamp", "run_timestamp")
  hit <- candidates[candidates %in% names(metadata)]
  if (length(hit) == 0L) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  as.character(metadata[[hit[[1L]]]])
}

file_mtime_utc <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  format(file.info(path)$mtime, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", tz = "UTC")
}

# One provenance row for a consumed parquet input. Content identity is the file
# hash; mtime/size are descriptive only (KTD8). Unreadability never stops the
# capture: the row then carries content_hash = NA and readable = FALSE, so a
# market blocked at the input stage still names its files in the bundle and the
# cached render can detect the file appearing later (AE4).
input_provenance_row <- function(input, path, columns_used) {
  path <- as.character(path)
  info <- tryCatch(parquet_file_info(path, input), error = function(e) NULL)
  readable <- !is.null(info)
  tibble::tibble(
    input = input,
    path = path,
    content_hash = if (readable) {
      digest::digest(file = path, algo = "xxhash64")
    } else {
      NA_character_
    },
    generation_id = if (readable) {
      generation_id_from_metadata(info$metadata)
    } else {
      NA_character_
    },
    n_rows = if (readable) info$n_rows else NA_real_,
    columns_used = paste(columns_used, collapse = ";"),
    mtime = if (readable) file_mtime_utc(path) else NA_character_,
    readable = readable
  )
}

# Strict form: an unreadable file stops (or blocks the market when `market` is set).
capture_input_provenance <- function(
  input,
  path,
  columns_used,
  market = NA_character_
) {
  assert_readable_input(path, input, market)
  input_provenance_row(input, path, columns_used)
}

# Canonical input names of a market's three consumed files.
market_input_names <- function(market) {
  c(
    history = paste0(market, "_history"),
    mapping = paste0(market, "_mapping"),
    same_day_review = paste0(market, "_same_day_review")
  )
}

# The three per-market inputs, captured before any loading so that a blocked
# market still records them.
market_input_provenance <- function(market, cfg = market_config(market)) {
  names <- market_input_names(market)
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    input_provenance_row(
      names[["history"]],
      cfg$history_path,
      history_columns(cfg)
    ),
    input_provenance_row(
      names[["mapping"]],
      cfg$mapping_path,
      mapping_columns(cfg)
    ),
    input_provenance_row(
      names[["same_day_review"]],
      review_path(cfg, "same_day"),
      cfg$id_col
    )
  )
}

# ---- Loading (column-pruned; read_parquet -> as.data.frame -> as.data.table) -----

# as.data.frame() materialises the Arrow vectors (see docs/solutions on Arrow
# ALTREP joins); setDT() then converts in place rather than copying the
# 30-million-row sales history a second time.
read_parquet_columns <- function(path, columns) {
  frame <- as.data.frame(
    arrow::read_parquet(path, col_select = tidyselect::all_of(columns))
  )
  data.table::setDT(frame)
  frame[]
}

load_history <- function(
  market,
  path = market_config(market)$history_path,
  cfg = market_config(market)
) {
  cols <- history_columns(cfg)
  info <- parquet_file_info(path, paste0(market, "_history"), market)
  missing <- setdiff(cols, info$columns)
  if (length(missing) > 0L) {
    block_market(
      market,
      "input",
      sprintf(
        "history %s lacks required columns: %s",
        path,
        paste(missing, collapse = ", ")
      )
    )
  }
  dt <- read_parquet_columns(path, cols)
  dt[, (cfg$id_col) := as.character(get(cfg$id_col))]
  dt[, (cfg$date_col) := as_transaction_date(get(cfg$date_col))]
  dt[, (cfg$price_col) := as.numeric(get(cfg$price_col))]
  dt[, easting := as.numeric(easting)]
  dt[, northing := as.numeric(northing)]
  dt[, quality := as.integer(quality)]
  for (col in c("country", "lsoa", "msoa")) {
    dt[, (col) := as.character(get(col))]
  }
  dt[]
}

load_mapping <- function(
  market,
  path = market_config(market)$mapping_path,
  cfg = market_config(market)
) {
  cols <- mapping_columns(cfg)
  info <- parquet_file_info(path, paste0(market, "_mapping"), market)
  missing <- setdiff(cols, info$columns)
  if (length(missing) > 0L) {
    block_market(
      market,
      "input",
      sprintf(
        "mapping %s lacks required columns: %s",
        path,
        paste(missing, collapse = ", ")
      )
    )
  }
  dt <- read_parquet_columns(path, cols)
  dt[, (cfg$id_col) := as.character(get(cfg$id_col))]
  dt[, repeat_id := as.character(repeat_id)]
  list(mapping = dt[], manifest = info$metadata)
}

load_same_day_ids <- function(market, cfg = market_config(market)) {
  path <- review_path(cfg, "same_day")
  info <- parquet_file_info(path, paste0(market, "_same_day_review"), market)
  if (!cfg$id_col %in% info$columns) {
    block_market(
      market,
      "input",
      sprintf("same-day review %s lacks %s", path, cfg$id_col)
    )
  }
  if (info$n_rows == 0) {
    return(character())
  }
  as.character(read_parquet_columns(path, cfg$id_col)[[cfg$id_col]])
}

# ---- Mapping validation (KTD10, structural part) -------------------------------

validate_mapping <- function(
  history,
  mapping,
  manifest,
  same_day_ids,
  market,
  cfg = market_config(market)
) {
  id_col <- cfg$id_col
  fail <- function(message, details = NULL) {
    block_market(market, "mapping", message, details)
  }

  hist_ids <- history[[id_col]]
  map_ids <- mapping[[id_col]]
  if (!is.character(hist_ids) || anyNA(hist_ids) || any(!nzchar(hist_ids))) {
    fail("history transaction ids must be non-missing character strings")
  }
  n_hist_dup <- sum(duplicated(hist_ids))
  if (n_hist_dup > 0L) {
    fail(sprintf("history contains %d duplicated transaction ids", n_hist_dup))
  }
  if (!is.character(map_ids) || anyNA(map_ids) || any(!nzchar(map_ids))) {
    fail("mapping transaction ids must be non-missing character strings")
  }
  n_map_dup <- sum(duplicated(map_ids))
  if (n_map_dup > 0L) {
    fail(
      sprintf(
        "mapping contains %d duplicated transaction ids; a join would multiply rows",
        n_map_dup
      ),
      details = list(n_duplicated_mapping_ids = n_map_dup)
    )
  }
  if (
    !is.character(mapping$repeat_id) ||
      anyNA(mapping$repeat_id) ||
      any(!grepl("^[0-9a-f]{16}$", mapping$repeat_id))
  ) {
    fail("mapping repeat_id values must be 16-character lowercase hex strings")
  }

  map_in_hist <- map_ids %chin% hist_ids
  n_absent_from_history <- sum(!map_in_hist)
  if (n_absent_from_history > 0L) {
    fail(
      sprintf(
        "mapping contains %d ids absent from history",
        n_absent_from_history
      ),
      details = list(n_mapping_absent_from_history = n_absent_from_history)
    )
  }

  required_fields <- c(
    "repeat_manifest_version",
    "input_row_count",
    "mapped_count",
    "excluded_count",
    "same_day_excluded_count",
    "run_timestamp"
  )
  missing_fields <- setdiff(required_fields, names(manifest))
  if (length(missing_fields) > 0L) {
    fail(paste(
      "mapping manifest lacks fields:",
      paste(missing_fields, collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }
  manifest_num <- function(field) as.numeric(manifest[[field]])
  if (manifest_num("input_row_count") != nrow(history)) {
    fail(sprintf(
      "manifest input_row_count %s differs from history rows %d",
      manifest$input_row_count,
      nrow(history)
    ))
  }
  if (manifest_num("mapped_count") != nrow(mapping)) {
    fail(sprintf(
      "manifest mapped_count %s differs from mapping rows %d",
      manifest$mapped_count,
      nrow(mapping)
    ))
  }

  # History rows absent from the mapping must be exactly the unkeyed addresses
  # plus the same-day conflicts. Recompute the key on those rows only (cheap) and
  # compare with the manifest counts and the same-day review ids.
  hist_in_map <- hist_ids %chin% map_ids
  absent_ids <- hist_ids[!hist_in_map]
  n_absent <- length(absent_ids)
  same_day_ids <- unique(as.character(same_day_ids))
  absent_keys <- if (n_absent > 0L) {
    build_address_key(
      history[!hist_in_map, cfg$address_cols, with = FALSE],
      repeat_key_config(cfg)
    )
  } else {
    character()
  }
  n_unkeyed_recomputed <- sum(is.na(absent_keys))
  keyed_absent_ids <- absent_ids[!is.na(absent_keys)]
  n_same_day_not_absent <- sum(!same_day_ids %chin% absent_ids)
  reconciled <- n_absent ==
    manifest_num("excluded_count") + manifest_num("same_day_excluded_count") &&
    n_unkeyed_recomputed == manifest_num("excluded_count") &&
    length(same_day_ids) == manifest_num("same_day_excluded_count") &&
    n_same_day_not_absent == 0L &&
    setequal(keyed_absent_ids, same_day_ids)

  result <- list(
    status = if (reconciled) "passed" else "failed",
    n_history = nrow(history),
    n_mapping = nrow(mapping),
    n_groups_mapping = data.table::uniqueN(mapping$repeat_id),
    n_mapping_absent_from_history = n_absent_from_history,
    n_history_absent_from_mapping = n_absent,
    n_unkeyed_manifest = manifest_num("excluded_count"),
    n_unkeyed_recomputed = n_unkeyed_recomputed,
    n_same_day_manifest = manifest_num("same_day_excluded_count"),
    n_same_day_review = length(same_day_ids),
    n_same_day_recomputed = length(keyed_absent_ids),
    n_same_day_not_absent = n_same_day_not_absent,
    reconciled = reconciled,
    manifest_version = as.character(manifest$repeat_manifest_version),
    generation_id = as.character(manifest$run_timestamp),
    manifest_input_mtime = as.character(
      manifest$input_mtime %||% NA_character_
    ),
    manifest_largest_group_size = as.character(
      manifest$largest_group_size %||% NA_character_
    )
  )
  if (!reconciled) {
    fail(
      sprintf(
        paste(
          "history rows absent from mapping (%d) do not reconcile with manifest unkeyed (%s) +",
          "same-day (%s); recomputed unkeyed %d, same-day review ids %d (%d not absent)"
        ),
        n_absent,
        manifest$excluded_count,
        manifest$same_day_excluded_count,
        n_unkeyed_recomputed,
        length(same_day_ids),
        n_same_day_not_absent
      ),
      details = result
    )
  }
  result
}

# ---- Current-address verification (KTD10, read-only) ----------------------------

# `candidates` holds the id column plus the market's address columns for every
# requested-window row that is in the mapping, singles included. Keys and
# expected repeat ids are recomputed with the production contract and compared
# with the stored repeat_id. Nothing is rebuilt or repaired.
verify_current_address_keys <- function(
  candidates,
  mapping,
  market,
  cfg = market_config(market)
) {
  id_col <- cfg$id_col
  idx <- match(candidates[[id_col]], mapping[[id_col]])
  if (anyNA(idx)) {
    stop(
      "verify_current_address_keys() received rows absent from the mapping.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  stored <- mapping$repeat_id[idx]
  rm(idx)
  # Keys and hashes are recomputed in row chunks: the per-row results are the
  # same as one pass over every candidate, but the 30-million-row sales history
  # never holds all of its recomputed keys and hashes at once.
  n <- nrow(candidates)
  missing_key <- logical(n)
  mismatched <- logical(n)
  key_config <- repeat_key_config(cfg)
  chunk_size <- 2000000L
  starts <- seq.int(1L, max(n, 1L), by = chunk_size)
  for (start in starts[starts <= n]) {
    rows <- seq.int(start, min(start + chunk_size - 1L, n))
    key <- build_address_key(
      candidates[rows, cfg$address_cols, with = FALSE],
      key_config
    )
    chunk_missing <- is.na(key)
    expected <- rep(NA_character_, length(key))
    if (any(!chunk_missing)) {
      expected[!chunk_missing] <- hash_serialized_values(key[!chunk_missing])
    }
    missing_key[rows] <- chunk_missing
    mismatched[rows] <- !chunk_missing & expected != stored[rows]
    rm(key, expected, chunk_missing)
  }
  group_sizes <- data.table::data.table(repeat_id = stored)[,
    .N,
    by = repeat_id
  ]
  result <- list(
    status = if (any(missing_key) || any(mismatched)) "failed" else "passed",
    n_candidates = n,
    n_candidate_groups = nrow(group_sizes),
    n_window_singles = sum(group_sizes$N == 1L),
    n_missing_keys = sum(missing_key),
    n_mismatched = sum(mismatched),
    n_mismatched_groups = data.table::uniqueN(stored[mismatched]),
    example_missing_ids = utils::head(candidates[[id_col]][missing_key], 5L),
    example_mismatched_ids = utils::head(candidates[[id_col]][mismatched], 5L)
  )
  if (result$status != "passed") {
    block_market(
      market,
      "address_keys",
      sprintf(
        paste(
          "current address keys disagree with the stored mapping: %d candidates,",
          "%d missing current keys, %d mismatched repeat ids (%d groups);",
          "mapping is stale relative to the history and must be regenerated upstream"
        ),
        result$n_candidates,
        result$n_missing_keys,
        result$n_mismatched,
        result$n_mismatched_groups
      ),
      details = result
    )
  }
  result
}

# ---- Geography contradictions within candidate groups ---------------------------

# Contradiction = more than one distinct NONMISSING value within a repeat group.
# Missing-to-observed differences are not contradictions.
check_group_geography_contradictions <- function(candidates) {
  needed <- c("repeat_id", "country", "easting", "northing", "lsoa", "msoa")
  missing <- setdiff(needed, names(candidates))
  if (length(missing) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "Geography check lacks columns: ",
      paste(missing, collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  distinct_nonmissing <- function(cols) {
    dt <- candidates[, c("repeat_id", cols), with = FALSE]
    keep <- Reduce(`&`, lapply(cols, function(col) !is.na(dt[[col]])))
    unique(dt[keep])[, .N, by = repeat_id][N > 1L, repeat_id]
  }
  country_ids <- distinct_nonmissing("country")
  coord_ids <- distinct_nonmissing(c("easting", "northing"))
  lsoa_ids <- distinct_nonmissing("lsoa")
  msoa_ids <- distinct_nonmissing("msoa")
  group_ids <- unique(c(country_ids, coord_ids, lsoa_ids, msoa_ids))
  list(
    n_groups_checked = data.table::uniqueN(candidates$repeat_id),
    n_rows_checked = nrow(candidates),
    n_groups_contradictory = length(group_ids),
    n_groups_country = length(country_ids),
    n_groups_coordinates = length(coord_ids),
    n_groups_lsoa = length(lsoa_ids),
    n_groups_msoa = length(msoa_ids),
    group_ids = group_ids
  )
}

# ---- Exclusion ledger ----------------------------------------------------------

count_groups <- function(repeat_ids) {
  data.table::uniqueN(repeat_ids[!is.na(repeat_ids)])
}

new_ledger <- function() {
  tibble::tibble(
    market = character(),
    step_order = integer(),
    step = character(),
    n_rows_before = numeric(),
    n_rows_after = numeric(),
    n_rows_removed = numeric(),
    n_groups_before = numeric(),
    n_groups_after = numeric(),
    note = character()
  )
}

ledger_append <- function(
  ledger,
  market,
  step,
  n_rows_before,
  n_rows_after,
  n_groups_before,
  n_groups_after,
  note = ""
) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    ledger,
    tibble::tibble(
      market = market,
      step_order = nrow(ledger) + 1L,
      step = step,
      n_rows_before = as.numeric(n_rows_before),
      n_rows_after = as.numeric(n_rows_after),
      n_rows_removed = as.numeric(n_rows_before) - as.numeric(n_rows_after),
      n_groups_before = as.numeric(n_groups_before),
      n_groups_after = as.numeric(n_groups_after),
      note = note
    )
  )
}

# Restrict a panel by a logical vector and append the ledger row (for U2/U3).
restrict_panel <- function(panel, keep, ledger, market, step, note = "") {
  if (length(keep) != nrow(panel)) {
    stop("`keep` must have one entry per panel row.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  keep <- !is.na(keep) & keep
  before_rows <- nrow(panel)
  before_groups <- count_groups(panel$repeat_id)
  panel <- panel[keep]
  ledger <- ledger_append(
    ledger,
    market,
    step,
    before_rows,
    nrow(panel),
    before_groups,
    count_groups(panel$repeat_id),
    note
  )
  list(panel = panel, ledger = ledger)
}

# The three identities every ledger chain must satisfy, in step order: removed =
# before - after on each row, and each row's after (rows and groups) equals the
# next row's before. Returns the ordered rows; `label` names the chain in errors.
assert_ledger_chain <- function(rows, label) {
  rows <- rows[order(rows$step_order), ]
  if (!all(rows$n_rows_removed == rows$n_rows_before - rows$n_rows_after)) {
    stop(
      "Ledger removed counts do not equal before minus after for ",
      label,
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  if (nrow(rows) > 1L) {
    if (!all(rows$n_rows_after[-nrow(rows)] == rows$n_rows_before[-1L])) {
      stop("Ledger rows do not chain for ", label, call. = FALSE)
    }
    if (!all(rows$n_groups_after[-nrow(rows)] == rows$n_groups_before[-1L])) {
      stop("Ledger group counts do not chain for ", label, call. = FALSE)
    }
  }
  invisible(rows)
}

assert_ledger_identity <- function(ledger) {
  for (mkt in unique(ledger$market)) {
    assert_ledger_chain(ledger[ledger$market == mkt, ], mkt)
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

# ---- Repeat eligibility and change flags -----------------------------------------

# Eligibility = at least two DISTINCT dates surviving in the group (AE1). Stored
# repeat_count is full-window and is never consulted.
repeat_eligible_ids <- function(panel) {
  distinct_dates <- unique(panel[, .(repeat_id, date)])[, .N, by = repeat_id]
  distinct_dates[N >= 2L, repeat_id]
}

recompute_repeats <- function(panel) {
  panel[repeat_id %chin% repeat_eligible_ids(panel)]
}

# One logical per change column: more than one distinct nonmissing value within
# the group. Missing-to-observed is never a change (AE2).
freeze_change_flags <- function(panel, change_cols) {
  missing <- setdiff(change_cols, names(panel))
  if (length(missing) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "Change columns absent from panel: ",
      paste(missing, collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  flags <- data.table::data.table(repeat_id = unique(panel$repeat_id))
  for (col in change_cols) {
    changed_ids <- unique(panel[
      !is.na(get(col)),
      c("repeat_id", col),
      with = FALSE
    ])[, .N, by = repeat_id][N > 1L, repeat_id]
    flags[, (paste0("change_", col)) := repeat_id %chin% changed_ids]
  }
  flag_cols <- paste0("change_", change_cols)
  flags[,
    any_change := Reduce(`|`, lapply(flag_cols, function(col) flags[[col]]))
  ]
  flags[]
}

# ---- Requested coverage --------------------------------------------------------

assert_requested_years <- function(dates, market, cfg) {
  requested <- seq(lubridate::year(cfg$start), lubridate::year(cfg$end))
  if (length(dates) == 0L) {
    block_market(
      market,
      "coverage",
      sprintf(
        "no observations between %s and %s in %s",
        cfg$start,
        cfg$end,
        cfg$history_path
      )
    )
  }
  present <- unique(lubridate::year(dates))
  absent <- setdiff(requested, present)
  if (length(absent) > 0L) {
    block_market(
      market,
      "coverage",
      sprintf(
        "requested year(s) %s have no observations in %s",
        paste(absent, collapse = ", "),
        cfg$history_path
      )
    )
  }
  invisible(requested)
}

# ---- Rental unit evidence ------------------------------------------------------

# The local provider profile does not define the rental listing_price unit. A
# constant unit is absorbed by property and month effects; a unit break at the
# 2022/2023 vintage boundary would not be. No conversion is ever applied.
rental_unit_evidence <- function(
  prices,
  dates,
  repeat_ids,
  tolerance = CONFIG$rental_unit_tolerance
) {
  dt <- data.table::data.table(
    price = prices,
    date = dates,
    repeat_id = repeat_ids
  )
  dt <- dt[is.finite(price) & price > 0]
  dt[, year := lubridate::year(date)]
  dt[, month := lubridate::floor_date(date, "month")]
  by_year <- dt[,
    .(
      n = .N,
      median = stats::median(price),
      q25 = stats::quantile(price, 0.25),
      q75 = stats::quantile(price, 0.75),
      log_mean = mean(log(price))
    ),
    by = year
  ][order(year)]
  by_month <- dt[
    month >= as.Date("2022-07-01") & month <= as.Date("2023-06-01"),
    .(
      n = .N,
      median = stats::median(price),
      q25 = stats::quantile(price, 0.25),
      q75 = stats::quantile(price, 0.75),
      log_mean = mean(log(price))
    ),
    by = month
  ][order(month)]
  median_2022 <- by_year[year == 2022L, median]
  median_2023 <- by_year[year == 2023L, median]
  ratio <- if (length(median_2022) == 1L && length(median_2023) == 1L) {
    median_2023 / median_2022
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }
  # Within-property: properties listed in both 2022 and 2023.
  within <- dt[
    year %in% c(2022L, 2023L),
    .(log_mean = mean(log(price))),
    by = .(repeat_id, year)
  ]
  within <- data.table::dcast(within, repeat_id ~ year, value.var = "log_mean")
  within_ratio <- if (all(c("2022", "2023") %in% names(within))) {
    both <- within[!is.na(`2022`) & !is.na(`2023`)]
    if (nrow(both) > 0L) {
      exp(stats::median(both[["2023"]] - both[["2022"]]))
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }
  n_within <- if (all(c("2022", "2023") %in% names(within))) {
    sum(!is.na(within$`2022`) & !is.na(within$`2023`))
  } else {
    0L
  }
  weekly_monthly <- 52 / 12
  near_conversion <- function(r) {
    !is.na(r) &&
      (abs(log(r) - log(weekly_monthly)) < log(tolerance) ||
        abs(log(r) + log(weekly_monthly)) < log(tolerance))
  }
  status <- if (is.na(ratio)) {
    "blocked"
  } else if (near_conversion(ratio) || near_conversion(within_ratio)) {
    "blocked"
  } else {
    "consistent_within_property_comparable"
  }
  list(
    status = status,
    documented_unit = paste(
      "Not documented locally: data/raw/zoopla/CDRC Data Profile - WFZ Transactions Safeguarded",
      "20221124.pdf describes the sales-matched dataset, not the rentals file. Existing project",
      "tables label the outcome 'log weekly asking rent'."
    ),
    vintage_proxy = "listing year 2023 (rentals_safeguarded_2023.csv) vs 2014-2022 (rentals_safeguarded_2014-2022.csv); the processed file carries no vintage column",
    conversion_applied = "none",
    median_ratio_2023_2022 = ratio,
    within_property_ratio_2023_2022 = within_ratio,
    n_within_property_pairs = n_within,
    weekly_monthly_factor = weekly_monthly,
    tolerance = tolerance,
    by_year = tibble::as_tibble(by_year),
    by_month = tibble::as_tibble(by_month),
    reason = if (status == "blocked") {
      sprintf(
        "2023/2022 median ratio %.3f (within-property %.3f) lies within the weekly/monthly conversion band",
        ratio,
        within_ratio
      )
    } else {
      NA_character_
    }
  )
}

# ---- Ordered sample contract -----------------------------------------------------

# Steps (plan order): requested dates -> mapped rows -> KTD10 address verification
# -> geography contradictions on candidate groups -> finite positive outcome ->
# England -> projected coordinates -> LSOA/MSOA. The panel is returned BEFORE the
# distance bands (U2) and the two-distinct-dates requirement (U2 applies bands,
# then calls recompute_repeats() through restrict_panel()).
# Restrictions are accumulated in one logical vector over the full history so no
# full-width copy is made until the narrow panel is built.
apply_sample_contract <- function(
  history,
  mapping,
  market,
  cfg = market_config(market)
) {
  id_col <- cfg$id_col
  n_full <- nrow(history)
  ids <- history[[id_col]]
  repeat_id <- mapping$repeat_id[match(ids, mapping[[id_col]])]
  dates <- as_transaction_date(history[[cfg$date_col]])
  price <- history[[cfg$price_col]]
  ledger <- new_ledger()
  groups <- function(keep) count_groups(repeat_id[keep])
  step <- function(prev, keep, name, note) {
    ledger <<- ledger_append(
      ledger,
      market,
      name,
      sum(prev),
      sum(keep),
      groups(prev),
      groups(keep),
      note
    )
    keep
  }

  # (1) requested dates
  all_rows <- rep(TRUE, n_full)
  keep <- !is.na(dates) & dates >= cfg$start & dates <= cfg$end
  keep <- step(
    all_rows,
    keep,
    "requested_dates",
    sprintf("%s to %s inclusive", cfg$start, cfg$end)
  )
  assert_requested_years(dates[keep], market, cfg)
  coverage <- data.table::data.table(year = lubridate::year(dates[keep]))[,
    .(n_rows = .N),
    by = year
  ][order(year)]
  coverage <- tibble::tibble(
    market = market,
    year = coverage$year,
    n_rows = coverage$n_rows
  )
  date_range <- range(dates[keep])

  # (2) rows in the mapping (unkeyed addresses and same-day conflicts are absent;
  #     they were reconciled in validate_mapping())
  keep <- step(
    keep,
    keep & !is.na(repeat_id),
    "mapped_rows",
    "rows absent from the repeat mapping: unkeyed addresses and same-day conflicts"
  )

  # (2b) KTD10 read-only address verification on all mapped window candidates
  address <- verify_current_address_keys(
    history[keep, c(id_col, cfg$address_cols), with = FALSE],
    mapping,
    market,
    cfg
  )
  keep <- step(
    keep,
    keep,
    "address_key_verification",
    sprintf(
      "read-only recomputation of address keys and repeat ids on %d candidates (%d singles); no rows removed",
      address$n_candidates,
      address$n_window_singles
    )
  )

  # (3) contradictory nonmissing geography within candidate groups
  geography <- check_group_geography_contradictions(data.table::data.table(
    repeat_id = repeat_id[keep],
    country = history$country[keep],
    easting = history$easting[keep],
    northing = history$northing[keep],
    lsoa = history$lsoa[keep],
    msoa = history$msoa[keep]
  ))
  keep <- step(
    keep,
    keep & !(repeat_id %chin% geography$group_ids),
    "geography_contradictions",
    sprintf(
      "whole groups with >1 distinct nonmissing country (%d), coordinates (%d), LSOA (%d) or MSOA (%d)",
      geography$n_groups_country,
      geography$n_groups_coordinates,
      geography$n_groups_lsoa,
      geography$n_groups_msoa
    )
  )

  # (4) common requirements
  keep <- step(
    keep,
    keep & is.finite(price) & price > 0,
    "finite_positive_outcome",
    sprintf(
      "finite positive %s; outcome is log(%s)",
      cfg$price_col,
      cfg$price_col
    )
  )
  unit_evidence <- if (market == "rentals") {
    rental_unit_evidence(price[keep], dates[keep], repeat_id[keep])
  } else {
    NULL
  }
  keep <- step(
    keep,
    keep & !is.na(history$country) & history$country == "England",
    "england",
    "country == England (Greater London retained; Wales, Scotland and missing country dropped)"
  )
  keep <- step(
    keep,
    keep & is.finite(history$easting) & is.finite(history$northing),
    "projected_coordinates",
    "nonmissing British National Grid easting and northing"
  )
  keep <- step(
    keep,
    keep &
      !is.na(history$lsoa) &
      nzchar(history$lsoa) &
      !is.na(history$msoa) &
      nzchar(history$msoa),
    "lsoa_msoa_nonmissing",
    "nonmissing 2011 LSOA and MSOA identifiers"
  )

  # Narrow panel built by column extraction (safe pattern for later data.table keys).
  panel_dates <- dates[keep]
  panel <- data.table::data.table(
    id = ids[keep],
    repeat_id = repeat_id[keep],
    date = panel_dates,
    year = as.integer(lubridate::year(panel_dates)),
    month_index = calendar_month_index(panel_dates),
    log_price = log(price[keep]),
    lsoa = history$lsoa[keep],
    msoa = history$msoa[keep],
    easting = history$easting[keep],
    northing = history$northing[keep],
    postcode = as.character(history$postcode[keep]),
    quality = history$quality[keep]
  )
  for (col in unique(c(cfg$change_cols, cfg$control_cols))) {
    panel[, (col) := history[[col]][keep]]
  }
  if (market == "rentals") {
    panel[, rented_fallback := is.na(history$rented[keep])]
  }

  list(
    panel = panel[],
    ledger = ledger,
    coverage = coverage,
    date_range = date_range,
    address_verification = address,
    geography = geography[setdiff(names(geography), "group_ids")],
    unit_evidence = unit_evidence
  )
}

# ---- Observation diagnostics (no exclusions) ------------------------------------

compute_observation_diagnostics <- function(
  panel,
  market,
  group_col = NULL,
  cfg = market_config(market)
) {
  grp <- if (is.null(group_col)) character() else group_col
  if (length(grp) > 0L && !all(grp %in% names(panel))) {
    stop(
      "Grouping column(s) absent from panel: ",
      paste(setdiff(grp, names(panel)), collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  dt <- panel[,
    c(
      "id",
      "repeat_id",
      "date",
      "year",
      "log_price",
      "easting",
      "northing",
      "postcode",
      "quality",
      intersect(c("rented_fallback"), names(panel)),
      grp
    ),
    with = FALSE
  ]
  data.table::setorderv(dt, c("repeat_id", "date", "id"))

  # Observations per repeat group (a group sits in one band because location is fixed).
  per_group <- dt[, .(n_obs = .N), by = c("repeat_id", grp)]
  per_group[,
    size_bucket := data.table::fcase(
      n_obs == 1L , "1"   , n_obs == 2L                      , "2"    , n_obs == 3L , "3" , n_obs == 4L , "4" ,
      n_obs <= 8L , "5-8" , n_obs <= CONFIG$large_group_size , "9-12" ,
      default = paste0(">", CONFIG$large_group_size)
    )
  ]
  group_sizes <- per_group[,
    .(n_groups = .N, n_rows = sum(n_obs)),
    by = c(grp, "size_bucket")
  ]
  data.table::setorderv(group_sizes, c(grp, "size_bucket"))
  n_large_groups <- sum(per_group$n_obs > CONFIG$large_group_size)

  # Inter-observation gaps and same-month repeats (consecutive pairs within a group).
  dt[, prev_date := data.table::shift(date), by = repeat_id]
  dt[, prev_log_price := data.table::shift(log_price), by = repeat_id]
  dt[, gap_days := as.numeric(date - prev_date)]
  pairs <- dt[!is.na(gap_days)]
  gap_summary <- pairs[,
    .(
      n_pairs = .N,
      min = min(gap_days),
      p10 = stats::quantile(gap_days, 0.10),
      p25 = stats::quantile(gap_days, 0.25),
      median = stats::median(gap_days),
      p75 = stats::quantile(gap_days, 0.75),
      p90 = stats::quantile(gap_days, 0.90),
      max = max(gap_days),
      share_under_30_days = mean(gap_days < 30),
      share_under_365_days = mean(gap_days < 365)
    ),
    by = grp
  ]
  pairs[,
    same_month := lubridate::year(date) == lubridate::year(prev_date) &
      lubridate::month(date) == lubridate::month(prev_date)
  ]
  same_month <- pairs[,
    .(
      n_pairs = .N,
      n_same_month_pairs = sum(same_month),
      share_same_month_pairs = mean(same_month),
      n_groups_with_same_month_pair = data.table::uniqueN(repeat_id[
        same_month
      ]),
      share_groups_with_same_month_pair = data.table::uniqueN(repeat_id[
        same_month
      ]) /
        data.table::uniqueN(repeat_id)
    ),
    by = grp
  ]

  # Outcome summaries by year (and optional grouping).
  outcome_by_year <- dt[,
    .(
      n = .N,
      mean_log = mean(log_price),
      sd_log = stats::sd(log_price),
      p10 = stats::quantile(log_price, 0.10),
      median = stats::median(log_price),
      p90 = stats::quantile(log_price, 0.90)
    ),
    by = c(grp, "year")
  ]
  data.table::setorderv(outcome_by_year, c(grp, "year"))

  # Extreme annualised price ratios (descriptive flag; same definition as the
  # repeat-transaction review: ratio^(365.25/holding_days) > 4 or < 1/4).
  threshold <- CONFIG$extreme_annualized_price_ratio
  pairs[,
    annualized_ratio := data.table::fifelse(
      gap_days > 0,
      exp(log_price - prev_log_price)^(365.25 / gap_days),
      NA_real_
    )
  ]
  pairs[,
    extreme := !is.na(annualized_ratio) &
      (annualized_ratio > threshold | annualized_ratio < 1 / threshold)
  ]
  extreme_by_year <- pairs[,
    .(n_pairs = .N, n_extreme = sum(extreme), share_extreme = mean(extreme)),
    by = c(grp, "year")
  ]
  data.table::setorderv(extreme_by_year, c(grp, "year"))
  extreme_total <- pairs[,
    .(n_pairs = .N, n_extreme = sum(extreme), share_extreme = mean(extreme)),
    by = grp
  ]

  # Rental rented_est fallback (rented missing, latest_to_rent used) by year.
  fallback_by_year <- if ("rented_fallback" %in% names(dt)) {
    out <- dt[,
      .(
        n = .N,
        n_fallback = sum(rented_fallback),
        share_fallback = mean(rented_fallback)
      ),
      by = c(grp, "year")
    ]
    data.table::setorderv(out, c(grp, "year"))
    tibble::as_tibble(out)
  } else {
    NULL
  }

  # Spatial precision: unique coordinates versus properties; coordinate quality.
  spatial <- list(
    n_rows = nrow(dt),
    n_properties = data.table::uniqueN(dt$repeat_id),
    n_unique_coordinates = nrow(unique(dt[, .(easting, northing)])),
    n_unique_postcodes = data.table::uniqueN(dt$postcode),
    quality_distribution = tibble::as_tibble(dt[,
      .(n_rows = .N),
      by = quality
    ][order(quality)]),
    geography_vintage = "2011 LSOA/MSOA codes from the ONS postcode lookup used at cleaning",
    postcode_lookup_path = CONFIG$postcode_lookup_path,
    postcode_lookup_exists = file.exists(CONFIG$postcode_lookup_path)
  )

  list(
    market = market,
    group_col = group_col,
    n_rows = nrow(dt),
    n_groups = data.table::uniqueN(dt$repeat_id),
    n_large_groups = n_large_groups,
    group_sizes = tibble::as_tibble(group_sizes),
    gap_summary = tibble::as_tibble(gap_summary),
    same_month = tibble::as_tibble(same_month),
    outcome_by_year = tibble::as_tibble(outcome_by_year),
    extreme_ratio_total = tibble::as_tibble(extreme_total),
    extreme_ratio_by_year = tibble::as_tibble(extreme_by_year),
    rented_fallback_by_year = fallback_by_year,
    spatial = spatial
  )
}

# ---- Market preparation (provenance -> load -> validate -> contract -> diagnostics)

# Returns list(market, status, reason, panel, readiness, ledger, diagnostics,
# provenance, profile_panel, profile_ledger). `panel` is the pre-band scalar
# panel (NULL when blocked); `profile_panel` is the pre-band annual-profile
# panel when the market's profile window is wider than its scalar window (NULL
# when the profiles share the scalar panel). Both panels come from one load of
# the full history and one mapping validation against the full generation.
# Later units apply bands, recompute_repeats() and freeze_change_flags().
prepare_market_panel <- function(market, cfg = market_config(market)) {
  started <- Sys.time()
  invisible(gc(reset = TRUE))
  readiness <- list(
    market = market,
    status = "ready",
    reason = NA_character_,
    blocked_stage = NA_character_
  )
  # Provenance is captured before any stage can block, so the bundle names this
  # market's inputs (hashed when readable) whatever its final status.
  out <- list(
    market = market,
    status = "ready",
    reason = NA_character_,
    panel = NULL,
    readiness = readiness,
    ledger = new_ledger(),
    diagnostics = NULL,
    provenance = market_input_provenance(market, cfg),
    profile_panel = NULL,
    profile_ledger = new_ledger()
  )
  result <- tryCatch(
    {
      for (i in seq_len(nrow(out$provenance))) {
        assert_readable_input(
          out$provenance$path[[i]],
          out$provenance$input[[i]],
          market
        )
      }
      history <- load_history(market, cfg$history_path, cfg)
      mapping_obj <- load_mapping(market, cfg$mapping_path, cfg)
      same_day_ids <- load_same_day_ids(market, cfg)
      mapping_validation <- validate_mapping(
        history,
        mapping_obj$mapping,
        mapping_obj$manifest,
        same_day_ids,
        market,
        cfg
      )
      contract <- apply_sample_contract(
        history,
        mapping_obj$mapping,
        market,
        cfg
      )
      # The annual-profile panel: the same sample rules over the wider window,
      # prepared from the full history rather than by widening the scalar panel.
      profile_contract <- if (separate_profile_window(cfg)) {
        apply_sample_contract(
          history,
          mapping_obj$mapping,
          market,
          profile_config(cfg)
        )
      } else {
        NULL
      }
      rm(history, mapping_obj, same_day_ids)
      invisible(gc())
      # Diagnostics on the pre-band panel restricted to >= 2 distinct dates. This is
      # informational only; the ledger's two-distinct-dates step is applied after
      # the bands (U2).
      eligible <- recompute_repeats(contract$panel)
      diagnostics <- compute_observation_diagnostics(
        eligible,
        market,
        NULL,
        cfg
      )
      n_eligible_rows <- nrow(eligible)
      n_eligible_groups <- data.table::uniqueN(eligible$repeat_id)
      rm(eligible)
      invisible(gc())
      list(
        mapping_validation = mapping_validation,
        contract = contract,
        profile_contract = profile_contract,
        diagnostics = diagnostics,
        n_eligible_rows = n_eligible_rows,
        n_eligible_groups = n_eligible_groups
      )
    },
    market_blocked = function(cond) cond
  )

  if (inherits(result, "market_blocked")) {
    out$status <- "blocked"
    out$reason <- conditionMessage(result)
    out$readiness$status <- "blocked"
    out$readiness$reason <- conditionMessage(result)
    out$readiness$blocked_stage <- result$stage
    out$readiness[[paste0("blocked_", result$stage)]] <- result$details
  } else {
    out$panel <- result$contract$panel
    out$ledger <- result$contract$ledger
    out$diagnostics <- result$diagnostics
    out$readiness$mapping_validation <- result$mapping_validation
    out$readiness$address_verification <- result$contract$address_verification
    out$readiness$geography <- result$contract$geography
    out$readiness$coverage <- result$contract$coverage
    out$readiness$date_range <- result$contract$date_range
    out$readiness$unit_evidence <- result$contract$unit_evidence
    out$readiness$n_rows_pre_band <- nrow(result$contract$panel)
    out$readiness$n_groups_pre_band <- data.table::uniqueN(
      result$contract$panel$repeat_id
    )
    out$readiness$n_rows_repeat_eligible_pre_band <- result$n_eligible_rows
    out$readiness$n_groups_repeat_eligible_pre_band <- result$n_eligible_groups
    out$readiness$profile <- profile_readiness(
      market,
      cfg,
      result$profile_contract,
      result$contract
    )
    if (!is.null(result$profile_contract)) {
      out$profile_panel <- result$profile_contract$panel
      out$profile_ledger <- result$profile_contract$ledger
    }
    if (
      market == "rentals" &&
        identical(result$contract$unit_evidence$status, "blocked")
    ) {
      out$status <- "blocked"
      out$reason <- paste(
        "rental unit evidence:",
        result$contract$unit_evidence$reason
      )
      out$readiness$status <- "blocked"
      out$readiness$reason <- out$reason
      out$readiness$blocked_stage <- "rental_units"
      out$panel <- NULL
      out$profile_panel <- NULL
    }
  }
  gc_info <- gc()
  out$readiness$runtime_seconds <- as.numeric(difftime(
    Sys.time(),
    started,
    units = "secs"
  ))
  # Ncells are 56 bytes and Vcells 8 bytes; "max used" is since the gc(reset = TRUE) above.
  out$readiness$peak_memory_mb <- as.numeric(
    gc_info["Ncells", "max used"] * 56 + gc_info["Vcells", "max used"] * 8
  ) /
    1024^2
  out
}

# Readiness record of the annual-profile panel: its window, whether it is the
# scalar panel or a separate one, requested-window coverage by year and the
# pre-band counts (recomputed eligibility, as for the scalar panel).
profile_readiness <- function(market, cfg, profile_contract, scalar_contract) {
  pcfg <- profile_config(cfg)
  contract <- profile_contract %||% scalar_contract
  # Counts only: the eligible ids are enough, so the wide panel is not copied.
  eligible_ids <- repeat_eligible_ids(contract$panel)
  list(
    panel = if (is.null(profile_contract)) "shared" else "separate",
    start = pcfg$start,
    end = pcfg$end,
    coverage = contract$coverage,
    date_range = contract$date_range,
    n_rows_pre_band = nrow(contract$panel),
    n_groups_pre_band = data.table::uniqueN(contract$panel$repeat_id),
    n_rows_repeat_eligible_pre_band = sum(contract$panel$repeat_id %chin% eligible_ids),
    n_groups_repeat_eligible_pre_band = length(eligible_ids)
  )
}

# Used by the estimation driver's progress output and the run metadata, so it
# stays in the computational code.
format_count <- function(x) {
  format(x, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
}
```
