```{r}
#| label: helpers-exposure
#| include: false

# U2: site projection, nearest distance, bands, attention calendar, article evidence.

# ---- Fixed site projection (KTD2, R3) ------------------------------------------

# Columns the projection helper requires. `annual_status` is read only so that
# derive_site_group_projection() can validate the crosswalk's structure; it never
# enters eligibility (AE3).
crosswalk_columns <- function() {
  c(
    "site_id",
    "year",
    "water_company",
    "annual_status",
    "ngr",
    "easting",
    "northing"
  )
}

# Latest-valid location per Site Group over `years`, plus `usable` (finite
# easting and northing). Stops when no site has a usable location.
project_sites <- function(crosswalk, years = CONFIG$crosswalk_years) {
  projection <- derive_site_group_projection(
    crosswalk,
    years = years,
    include_availability = FALSE
  )
  projection <- dplyr::mutate(
    projection,
    site_id = as.integer(.data$site_id),
    easting = as.numeric(.data$easting),
    northing = as.numeric(.data$northing),
    usable = is.finite(.data$easting) & is.finite(.data$northing)
  )
  n_usable <- sum(projection$usable)
  if (n_usable == 0L) {
    stop(
      "Site projection has zero usable locations; nearest-site matching cannot run.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  list(
    projection = projection,
    years = as.integer(years),
    n_sites = nrow(projection),
    n_usable = n_usable,
    n_unusable = nrow(projection) - n_usable,
    unusable_site_ids = projection$site_id[!projection$usable],
    n_water_companies = dplyr::n_distinct(projection$water_company)
  )
}

load_site_projection <- function(
  path = CONFIG$crosswalk_path,
  years = CONFIG$crosswalk_years
) {
  cols <- crosswalk_columns()
  info <- parquet_file_info(path, "site_group_crosswalk")
  missing <- setdiff(cols, info$columns)
  if (length(missing) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "Site Group crosswalk lacks required columns: ",
      paste(missing, collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  crosswalk <- arrow::read_parquet(
    path,
    col_select = tidyselect::all_of(cols)
  ) |>
    as.data.frame()
  out <- project_sites(crosswalk, years)
  out$n_crosswalk_rows <- nrow(crosswalk)
  out$provenance <- capture_input_provenance("site_group_crosswalk", path, cols)
  out
}

# ---- Nearest usable site through unique coordinates -----------------------------

# `coords`: data.table/data.frame of unique (easting, northing) pairs in BNG metres.
# Returns a data.table with those coordinates plus `site_id` and `distance_m`
# (planar metres to the nearest usable Site Group representative location).
# STRtree-indexed nearest-feature search; never an all-pairs matrix. Ties resolve to
# the feature sf returns first and are not reported.
nearest_site_distance <- function(coords, projection) {
  if (!all(c("easting", "northing") %in% names(coords))) {
    stop("`coords` must carry easting and northing.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  if (
    !all(c("site_id", "easting", "northing", "usable") %in% names(projection))
  ) {
    stop(
      "`projection` must carry site_id, easting, northing and usable.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  sites <- projection[projection$usable, c("site_id", "easting", "northing")]
  if (nrow(sites) == 0L) {
    stop("No usable site locations to match against.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  coords <- data.table::as.data.table(coords)[, .(
    easting = as.numeric(easting),
    northing = as.numeric(northing)
  )]
  if (anyDuplicated(coords) > 0L) {
    stop("`coords` must be unique on (easting, northing).", call. = FALSE)
  }
  if (any(!is.finite(coords$easting) | !is.finite(coords$northing))) {
    stop("`coords` must be finite.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  pts_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(
    as.data.frame(coords),
    coords = c("easting", "northing"),
    crs = 27700
  )
  sites_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(
    as.data.frame(sites),
    coords = c("easting", "northing"),
    crs = 27700
  )
  idx <- sf::st_nearest_feature(pts_sf, sites_sf)
  dist <- sf::st_distance(pts_sf, sites_sf[idx, ], by_element = TRUE)
  coords[, site_id := as.integer(sites$site_id[idx])]
  coords[, distance_m := as.numeric(dist)]
  if (anyNA(coords$site_id) || any(!is.finite(coords$distance_m))) {
    stop("Nearest-site matching left unmatched coordinates.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  coords[]
}

# ---- KTD5 bands ---------------------------------------------------------------

# near = [near_min, near_max] inclusive -> 1L; far = (far_min, far_max] -> 0L;
# everything else (including NA) -> NA_integer_ (dropped).
assign_bands <- function(distance_m, bands = CONFIG$bands) {
  distance_m <- as.numeric(distance_m)
  data.table::fcase(
    !is.na(distance_m) & distance_m >= bands$near_min & distance_m <= bands$near_max , 1L ,
    !is.na(distance_m) & distance_m > bands$far_min & distance_m <= bands$far_max    , 0L ,
    default = NA_integer_
  )
}

band_label <- function(near) data.table::fifelse(near == 1L, "near", "far")

band_note <- function(bands = CONFIG$bands) {
  sprintf(
    "near = [%s, %s] m inclusive; far = (%s, %s] m; (%s, %s] m and > %s m dropped",
    bands$near_min,
    bands$near_max,
    bands$far_min,
    bands$far_max,
    bands$near_max,
    bands$far_min,
    bands$far_max
  )
}

# ---- Exposure on a market panel -------------------------------------------------

# Takes the pre-band panel from prepare_market_panel(), attaches one fixed
# exposure per row (site_id, distance_m, near, band), applies the bands and the
# two-distinct-dates requirement through the ledger, then freezes the change
# flags on the eligible long-run panel (KTD6) and joins them without restricting.
# The input panel is modified by reference (columns added) and then subset.
apply_exposure <- function(
  panel,
  projection,
  ledger,
  market,
  cfg = market_config(market),
  bands = CONFIG$bands
) {
  if (!data.table::is.data.table(panel)) {
    stop("`panel` must be a data.table.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  coords <- unique(panel[, .(easting, northing)])
  matched <- nearest_site_distance(coords, projection)
  n_unique_coordinates <- nrow(matched)
  panel[
    matched,
    on = .(easting, northing),
    `:=`(site_id = i.site_id, distance_m = i.distance_m)
  ]
  if (anyNA(panel$site_id) || any(!is.finite(panel$distance_m))) {
    stop(
      "Every retained row must receive exactly one nearest-site distance.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  panel[, near := assign_bands(distance_m, bands)]
  distance_summary_all <- tibble::tibble(
    n_unique_coordinates = n_unique_coordinates,
    n_rows = nrow(panel),
    n_sites_matched = data.table::uniqueN(matched$site_id),
    distance_min = min(matched$distance_m),
    distance_median = stats::median(matched$distance_m),
    distance_max = max(matched$distance_m),
    share_coordinates_near = mean(
      assign_bands(matched$distance_m, bands) %in% 1L
    ),
    share_coordinates_far = mean(
      assign_bands(matched$distance_m, bands) %in% 0L
    ),
    share_coordinates_dropped = mean(is.na(assign_bands(
      matched$distance_m,
      bands
    )))
  )
  rm(coords, matched)
  restricted <- restrict_panel(
    panel,
    !is.na(panel$near),
    ledger,
    market,
    "distance_bands",
    band_note(bands)
  )
  panel <- restricted$panel
  ledger <- restricted$ledger
  panel[, band := band_label(near)]
  restricted <- restrict_panel(
    panel,
    panel$repeat_id %chin% repeat_eligible_ids(panel),
    ledger,
    market,
    "two_distinct_dates",
    "at least two distinct surviving dates per property (recomputed; stored repeat_count unused)"
  )
  panel <- restricted$panel
  ledger <- restricted$ledger
  change_flags <- freeze_change_flags(panel, cfg$change_cols)
  # Keyed in-place update: no full-panel copy, row order unchanged.
  flag_cols <- setdiff(names(change_flags), "repeat_id")
  panel[
    change_flags,
    on = "repeat_id",
    (flag_cols) := mget(paste0("i.", flag_cols))
  ]
  if (anyNA(panel$any_change)) {
    stop("Change flags did not cover every eligible property.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  list(
    panel = panel[],
    ledger = ledger,
    change_flags = change_flags,
    distance_summary_all = distance_summary_all
  )
}

# ---- Exposure summaries (descriptive; no exclusions) ---------------------------

exposure_summaries <- function(
  panel,
  market,
  cfg = market_config(market),
  event_month = CONFIG$event_month
) {
  needed <- c(
    "repeat_id",
    "date",
    "band",
    "near",
    "distance_m",
    "site_id",
    "any_change",
    paste0("change_", cfg$change_cols)
  )
  missing <- setdiff(needed, names(panel))
  if (length(missing) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "Exposure summaries lack columns: ",
      paste(missing, collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  event_start <- lubridate::floor_date(event_month, "month")
  band_counts <- panel[,
    .(
      n_rows = .N,
      n_properties = data.table::uniqueN(repeat_id),
      n_unique_coordinates = nrow(unique(.SD[, .(easting, northing)])),
      n_sites_matched = data.table::uniqueN(site_id),
      distance_min = min(distance_m),
      distance_p10 = stats::quantile(distance_m, 0.10),
      distance_median = stats::median(distance_m),
      distance_p90 = stats::quantile(distance_m, 0.90),
      distance_max = max(distance_m)
    ),
    by = band
  ][order(-band)]
  by_period <- panel[,
    .(n_rows = .N, n_properties = data.table::uniqueN(repeat_id)),
    by = .(band, post = as.integer(date >= event_start))
  ][order(-band, post)]
  sides <- panel[,
    .(pre = any(date < event_start), post = any(date >= event_start)),
    by = .(repeat_id, band)
  ]
  both_sides <- sides[,
    .(
      n_properties = .N,
      n_pre_only = sum(pre & !post),
      n_post_only = sum(!pre & post),
      n_both_sides = sum(pre & post),
      share_both_sides = mean(pre & post)
    ),
    by = band
  ][order(-band)]
  flag_cols <- c(paste0("change_", cfg$change_cols), "any_change")
  per_property <- unique(panel[,
    c("repeat_id", "band", flag_cols),
    with = FALSE
  ])
  change_prevalence <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(flag_cols, function(col) {
    per_property[,
      .(
        change_flag = col,
        n_properties = .N,
        n_changed = sum(get(col)),
        share_changed = mean(get(col))
      ),
      by = band
    ]
  }))[order(change_flag, -band)]
  change_rows <- panel[,
    .(
      n_rows = .N,
      n_rows_in_changed_properties = sum(any_change),
      share_rows_in_changed_properties = mean(any_change)
    ),
    by = band
  ][order(-band)]
  list(
    market = market,
    n_rows = nrow(panel),
    n_properties = data.table::uniqueN(panel$repeat_id),
    n_sites_matched = data.table::uniqueN(panel$site_id),
    band_counts = tibble::as_tibble(band_counts),
    by_period = tibble::as_tibble(by_period),
    both_sides_event = tibble::as_tibble(both_sides),
    change_prevalence = tibble::as_tibble(change_prevalence),
    change_rows = tibble::as_tibble(change_rows),
    diagnostics_by_band = compute_observation_diagnostics(
      panel,
      market,
      "band",
      cfg
    )
  )
}

# ---- Article input validation ---------------------------------------------------

# One valid row per observed year-month with a finite nonnegative integer count.
# Returns list(status = "passed" | "failed", reasons, n_rows, ...); never stops.
validate_article_input <- function(monthly) {
  reasons <- character()
  monthly <- as.data.frame(monthly)
  needed <- c("year", "month", "article_count")
  missing <- setdiff(needed, names(monthly))
  if (length(missing) > 0L) {
    return(list(
      status = "failed",
      reasons = paste("missing columns:", paste(missing, collapse = ", ")),
      n_rows = nrow(monthly),
      n_months = 0L,
      n_articles = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  year <- monthly$year
  month <- monthly$month
  count <- monthly$article_count
  if (nrow(monthly) == 0L) {
    reasons <- c(reasons, "no rows")
  }
  if (anyNA(year) || any(!is.finite(year)) || any(year != round(year))) {
    reasons <- c(reasons, "year must be a nonmissing integer")
  }
  if (
    anyNA(month) ||
      any(!is.finite(month)) ||
      any(month != round(month)) ||
      any(month < 1 | month > 12)
  ) {
    reasons <- c(reasons, "month must be a nonmissing integer in 1-12")
  }
  key <- paste(year, month)
  n_dup <- sum(duplicated(key))
  if (n_dup > 0L) {
    reasons <- c(
      reasons,
      sprintf(
        "%d duplicated year-month keys (input problem, not values to sum)",
        n_dup
      )
    )
  }
  if (anyNA(count)) {
    reasons <- c(
      reasons,
      sprintf(
        "%d missing article counts (input problem, not zero)",
        sum(is.na(count))
      )
    )
  }
  count_ok <- count[!is.na(count)]
  if (any(!is.finite(count_ok))) {
    reasons <- c(reasons, "article counts must be finite")
  }
  if (any(is.finite(count_ok) & count_ok < 0)) {
    reasons <- c(reasons, "negative article counts")
  }
  if (any(is.finite(count_ok) & count_ok != round(count_ok))) {
    reasons <- c(reasons, "non-integer article counts")
  }
  list(
    status = if (length(reasons) == 0L) "passed" else "failed",
    reasons = reasons,
    n_rows = nrow(monthly),
    n_months = length(unique(key)),
    n_articles = if (length(reasons) == 0L) sum(count) else NA_real_,
    first_month = if (length(reasons) == 0L && nrow(monthly) > 0L) {
      sprintf(
        "%04d-%02d",
        as.integer(min(year)),
        as.integer(month[which.min(year * 12 + month)])
      )
    } else {
      NA_character_
    },
    last_month = if (length(reasons) == 0L && nrow(monthly) > 0L) {
      sprintf(
        "%04d-%02d",
        as.integer(max(year)),
        as.integer(month[which.max(year * 12 + month)])
      )
    } else {
      NA_character_
    }
  )
}

load_article_monthly <- function(path = CONFIG$articles_path) {
  cols <- c("year", "month", "article_count")
  info <- parquet_file_info(path, "search1_monthly")
  missing <- setdiff(cols, info$columns)
  if (length(missing) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "Monthly article file lacks columns: ",
      paste(missing, collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  monthly <- arrow::read_parquet(path, col_select = tidyselect::all_of(cols)) |>
    as.data.frame()
  list(
    monthly = monthly,
    provenance = capture_input_provenance("search1_monthly", path, cols)
  )
}

# ---- Export evidence and coverage ----------------------------------------------

# List one LexisNexis export zip without extracting it: the number of entries, the
# number of `.docx` entries (one article each) and the export date from the entry
# timestamps. An unlistable zip gives NA counts and no export date.
parse_export_zip <- function(path) {
  entries <- tryCatch(
    utils::unzip(path, list = TRUE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  stamps <- if (is.null(entries)) {
    as.POSIXct(character())
  } else {
    entries$Date[!is.na(entries$Date)]
  }
  tibble::tibble(
    file = basename(path),
    n_entries = if (is.null(entries)) NA_integer_ else nrow(entries),
    n_docx = if (is.null(entries)) {
      NA_integer_
    } else {
      sum(grepl("\\.docx$", entries$Name, ignore.case = TRUE))
    },
    export_date = if (length(stamps) > 0L) {
      format(min(stamps), "%Y-%m-%d")
    } else {
      NA_character_
    },
    content_hash = digest::digest(file = path, algo = "xxhash64")
  )
}

# ---- Export zip provenance ------------------------------------------------------

EXPORT_ZIP_LISTING_INPUT <- "export_zip_listing"

list_export_zips <- function(zip_dir) {
  if (!dir.exists(zip_dir)) {
    return(character())
  }
  sort(list.files(
    zip_dir,
    pattern = "\\.zip$",
    ignore.case = TRUE,
    full.names = TRUE
  ))
}

export_zip_input_name <- function(zip_path) {
  paste0(
    "export_zip_",
    sub("\\.zip$", "", basename(zip_path), ignore.case = TRUE)
  )
}

# Directory membership is part of the corpus identity: the listing hash covers the
# sorted zip basenames, so an added or removed export changes the input fingerprint
# even when every remaining file is unchanged. A missing directory hashes the
# empty listing.
export_zip_listing_hash <- function(zip_dir) {
  digest::digest(
    paste(basename(list_export_zips(zip_dir)), collapse = "\n"),
    algo = "xxhash64",
    serialize = FALSE
  )
}

# Provenance rows for the article corpus: the article-level parquet (tolerant of
# absence), the listing row and one row per zip (hashed from the bytes).
export_zip_provenance <- function(
  zip_dir,
  articles_path,
  zips = list_export_zips(zip_dir)
) {
  listing <- tibble::tibble(
    input = EXPORT_ZIP_LISTING_INPUT,
    path = as.character(zip_dir),
    content_hash = export_zip_listing_hash(zip_dir),
    generation_id = NA_character_,
    n_rows = as.numeric(length(zips)),
    columns_used = "sorted zip basenames",
    mtime = file_mtime_utc(zip_dir),
    readable = dir.exists(zip_dir)
  )
  per_file <- tibble::tibble(
    input = export_zip_input_name(zips),
    path = zips,
    content_hash = vapply(
      zips,
      function(p) digest::digest(file = p, algo = "xxhash64"),
      character(1),
      USE.NAMES = FALSE
    ),
    generation_id = NA_character_,
    n_rows = NA_real_,
    columns_used = "entry names; entry timestamps",
    mtime = vapply(zips, file_mtime_utc, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE),
    readable = TRUE
  )
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    input_provenance_row("search1_articles", articles_path, "date"),
    listing,
    per_file
  )
}

# Recomputes, at render time, whether the fixed search corpus's coverage is
# established: every extracted article has a date, the `.docx` entries across the
# export zips (one article each) equal the article-level rows, the article-level
# monthly n() reproduces the monthly file, and the export date is readable from
# the zip entry timestamps. "unavailable" when the zips or parquet files are
# missing; observed first/last dates never substitute for evidence. Provenance is
# captured before every early return so the bundle always names the corpus it
# depended on.
article_export_evidence <- function(
  zip_dir = CONFIG$article_zip_dir,
  articles_path = CONFIG$article_records_path,
  monthly_path = CONFIG$articles_path
) {
  zips <- list_export_zips(zip_dir)
  out <- list(
    status = "unavailable",
    reasons = character(),
    files = tibble::tibble(),
    n_docx_entries = NA_integer_,
    n_articles_file = NA_integer_,
    records_reconciled = NA,
    monthly_reproduced = NA,
    n_months_compared = NA_integer_,
    n_months_mismatched = NA_integer_,
    article_date_min = as.Date(NA),
    article_date_max = as.Date(NA),
    export_date_min = as.Date(NA),
    coverage_end = as.Date(NA),
    provenance = export_zip_provenance(zip_dir, articles_path, zips)
  )
  if (length(zips) == 0L) {
    out$reasons <- sprintf("no export zips found under %s", zip_dir)
    return(out)
  }
  if (!file.exists(articles_path) || !file.exists(monthly_path)) {
    out$reasons <- "article-level or monthly parquet missing"
    return(out)
  }
  files <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(zips, parse_export_zip))
  out$files <- files
  out$status <- "failed"
  at <- match(export_zip_input_name(files$file), out$provenance$input)
  out$provenance$n_rows[at] <- as.numeric(files$n_docx)

  articles <- arrow::read_parquet(
    articles_path,
    col_select = tidyselect::all_of("date")
  ) |>
    as.data.frame()
  monthly <- arrow::read_parquet(
    monthly_path,
    col_select = tidyselect::all_of(c("year", "month", "article_count"))
  ) |>
    as.data.frame()
  dates <- as.Date(articles$date)
  reasons <- character()
  if (anyNA(dates)) {
    reasons <- c(
      reasons,
      sprintf("%d article records lack a date", sum(is.na(dates)))
    )
  }
  if (anyNA(files$n_docx)) {
    reasons <- c(reasons, "could not list the entries of every export zip")
  }
  out$n_docx_entries <- sum(files$n_docx)
  out$n_articles_file <- nrow(articles)
  out$records_reconciled <- isTRUE(out$n_docx_entries == out$n_articles_file)
  if (!out$records_reconciled) {
    reasons <- c(
      reasons,
      sprintf(
        "export .docx entries (%d) differ from extracted article rows (%d)",
        out$n_docx_entries,
        out$n_articles_file
      )
    )
  }
  recomputed <- data.table::data.table(
    year = lubridate::year(dates),
    month = lubridate::month(dates)
  )[!is.na(year), .(n = .N), by = .(year, month)]
  comparison <- merge(
    recomputed,
    data.table::as.data.table(monthly),
    by = c("year", "month"),
    all = TRUE
  )
  out$n_months_compared <- nrow(comparison)
  out$n_months_mismatched <- sum(
    is.na(comparison$n) |
      is.na(comparison$article_count) |
      comparison$n != comparison$article_count
  )
  out$monthly_reproduced <- out$n_months_mismatched == 0L
  if (!out$monthly_reproduced) {
    reasons <- c(
      reasons,
      sprintf(
        "article-level monthly n() differs from the monthly file in %d month(s)",
        out$n_months_mismatched
      )
    )
  }
  out$article_date_min <- suppressWarnings(min(dates, na.rm = TRUE))
  out$article_date_max <- suppressWarnings(max(dates, na.rm = TRUE))
  export_dates <- suppressWarnings(as.Date(files$export_date))
  if (anyNA(export_dates)) {
    reasons <- c(reasons, "export date unreadable from the zip entry timestamps")
  }
  out$export_date_min <- suppressWarnings(min(export_dates, na.rm = TRUE))
  out$reasons <- reasons
  if (length(reasons) == 0L) {
    out$status <- "established"
    # The corpus is the full holding at export time: coverage runs through the
    # month before the earliest export date (the export month itself is partial).
    out$coverage_end <- lubridate::floor_date(out$export_date_min, "month") - 1L
  }
  out
}

# ---- Attention calendar (KTD4, KTD5) --------------------------------------------

# Complete monthly calendar from the article origin through the market's end
# month. `post` is set from CONFIG$event_month alone. Article columns are filled
# only when validation passes, coverage is established through the calendar end,
# and the origin-month stock is positive; otherwise they are NA and
# article_status = "blocked" with an explicit reason.
build_attention_calendar <- function(
  market,
  monthly,
  evidence,
  validation = validate_article_input(monthly),
  cfg = CONFIG
) {
  mcfg <- market_config(market)
  origin <- lubridate::floor_date(cfg$article_origin, "month")
  end_month <- lubridate::floor_date(mcfg$end, "month")
  event_start <- lubridate::floor_date(cfg$event_month, "month")
  months <- seq(origin, end_month, by = "month")
  calendar <- tibble::tibble(
    market = market,
    year = as.integer(lubridate::year(months)),
    month = as.integer(lubridate::month(months)),
    month_index = seq_along(months),
    post = as.integer(months >= event_start),
    article_count = NA_real_,
    article_stock = NA_real_,
    log_articles = NA_real_
  )
  reason <- NA_character_
  if (validation$status != "passed") {
    reason <- paste(
      "article input validation failed:",
      paste(validation$reasons, collapse = "; ")
    )
  } else if (!identical(evidence$status, "established")) {
    reason <- paste0(
      "article coverage not established (",
      evidence$status,
      "): ",
      paste(evidence$reasons, collapse = "; "),
      "; absent months cannot be distinguished from zero months"
    )
  } else if (
    is.na(evidence$coverage_end) || evidence$coverage_end < end_month
  ) {
    reason <- sprintf(
      "established coverage ends %s, before the calendar end %s",
      evidence$coverage_end,
      end_month
    )
  } else {
    monthly <- as.data.frame(monthly)
    key <- paste(calendar$year, calendar$month)
    idx <- match(key, paste(monthly$year, monthly$month))
    counts <- as.numeric(monthly$article_count[idx])
    counts[is.na(idx)] <- 0
    calendar$article_count <- counts
    calendar$article_stock <- cumsum(counts)
    if (calendar$article_stock[[1L]] <= 0) {
      reason <- sprintf(
        "stock in the origin month %s is %s, so log(stock) is undefined there; no offset, log1p or later origin is substituted",
        format(origin, "%Y-%m"),
        calendar$article_stock[[1L]]
      )
    } else {
      calendar$log_articles <- log(calendar$article_stock)
    }
  }
  calendar$article_status <- if (is.na(reason)) "valid" else "blocked"
  calendar$article_reason <- reason
  attr(calendar, "article_reason") <- reason
  calendar
}

# Join post and log_articles by month_index; every panel row must match one row.
attach_attention <- function(panel, calendar) {
  if (!"month_index" %in% names(panel)) {
    stop("`panel` lacks month_index.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  idx <- match(panel$month_index, calendar$month_index)
  if (anyNA(idx)) {
    stop(
      sprintf(
        "%d panel rows have no calendar month (month_index outside 1..%d).",
        sum(is.na(idx)),
        nrow(calendar)
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  panel[, post := as.integer(calendar$post[idx])]
  panel[, log_articles := as.numeric(calendar$log_articles[idx])]
  panel[]
}

# ---- Attention history figure --------------------------------------------------

plot_attention_history <- function(calendar, event_month = CONFIG$event_month) {
  if (!all(calendar$article_status == "valid")) {
    stop("plot_attention_history() needs a valid calendar.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  plot_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    tibble::tibble(
      month = as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-01", calendar$year, calendar$month)),
      measure = "Monthly article count",
      value = calendar$article_count
    ),
    tibble::tibble(
      month = as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-01", calendar$year, calendar$month)),
      measure = "log cumulative stock since January 2014",
      value = calendar$log_articles
    )
  )
  plot_data$measure <- factor(
    plot_data$measure,
    levels = c(
      "Monthly article count",
      "log cumulative stock since January 2014"
    )
  )
  ggplot2::ggplot(plot_data, ggplot2::aes(x = month, y = value)) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(
      xintercept = lubridate::floor_date(event_month, "month"),
      linetype = "dashed",
      colour = "#b03a2e"
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(colour = "#2c5f8a") +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~measure, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    ggplot2::scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      title = sprintf("Search-1 articles, %s calendar", calendar$market[[1L]]),
      subtitle = sprintf(
        "Dashed line: %s (first post-event month)",
        format(event_month, "%B %Y")
      )
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: helpers-models
#| include: false

# U3: variants, sequential fitting, extraction, residual support, profiles, joint tests.

# ---- Model grid ------------------------------------------------------------------

MODEL_VARIANTS <- c(
  "headline",
  "exclude_changes",
  "complete_case",
  "complete_case_controls",
  "short_window"
)
MODEL_FE <- c(
  property_month = "repeat_id + month_index",
  property_month_msoa_year = "repeat_id + month_index + msoa^year"
)
MODEL_ATTENTION <- c("post", "log_articles")
CELL_STATUSES <- c(
  "estimated",
  "estimated_inference_unavailable",
  "unidentified",
  "unsupported_sample",
  "blocked_input"
)
ESTIMATED_STATUSES <- c("estimated", "estimated_inference_unavailable")
CONTROL_FACTOR_COLS <- c("property_type", "old_new", "duration") # other controls enter as numeric
COLLINEAR_FE_PATTERN <- "collinear with the fixed effects"
INFERENCE_WARNING_PATTERN <- "(?i)variance|covariance|vcov|positive[- ]?(semi-)?definite|singular|infinite"
# Only a covariance failure whose message matches this pattern becomes the status
# estimated_inference_unavailable; any other summariser error is a programming or
# environment fault and stops the run with the model key (KTD7).
VCOV_UNAVAILABLE_PATTERN <- paste(
  "singular",
  "not positive[- ]?(semi-)?definite",
  "cluster",
  "degrees of freedom",
  "vcov",
  "eigen",
  "infinite or missing values in 'x'",
  "NA/NaN/Inf",
  "non-conformable",
  "system is exactly singular",
  sep = "|"
)

model_key <- function(market, variant, fe, attention) {
  paste(market, variant, fe, attention, sep = "__")
}
profile_key <- function(market, fe) {
  paste(market, "headline", fe, "profile", sep = "__")
}
focal_term <- function(attention) paste0("near:", attention)

# Sequential order: market -> variant -> fe -> attention (attention varies fastest).
model_grid <- function(markets = MARKETS) {
  grid <- expand.grid(
    attention = MODEL_ATTENTION,
    fe = names(MODEL_FE),
    variant = MODEL_VARIANTS,
    market = markets,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )[, c("market", "variant", "fe", "attention")]
  grid$model_key <- model_key(
    grid$market,
    grid$variant,
    grid$fe,
    grid$attention
  )
  tibble::as_tibble(grid)
}

expected_model_keys <- function(markets = MARKETS) {
  list(
    scalar = model_grid(markets)$model_key,
    profile = as.vector(t(outer(markets, names(MODEL_FE), profile_key)))
  )
}

# ---- Cell and profile skeletons ------------------------------------------------------

empty_cell <- function(
  market,
  variant,
  fe,
  attention,
  status,
  reason = NA_character_
) {
  tibble::tibble(
    model_key = model_key(market, variant, fe, attention),
    market = market,
    variant = variant,
    fe = fe,
    attention = attention,
    status = status,
    reason = reason,
    term = focal_term(attention),
    estimate = NA_real_,
    std_error = NA_real_,
    t_df = NA_real_,
    conf_low = NA_real_,
    conf_high = NA_real_,
    p_value = NA_real_,
    nobs = NA_real_,
    n_properties = NA_real_,
    n_clusters = NA_real_,
    n_near_properties = NA_real_,
    n_far_properties = NA_real_,
    n_properties_both_sides_event = NA_real_,
    n_removed_by_estimator = NA_real_,
    n_controls_absorbed = NA_real_,
    warnings = NA_character_
  )
}

empty_profile <- function(
  market,
  fe,
  status,
  reason = NA_character_,
  reference_year = CONFIG$profile_reference_year,
  joint_years = CONFIG$profile_joint_years
) {
  list(
    model_key = profile_key(market, fe),
    market = market,
    fe = fe,
    status = status,
    reason = reason,
    reference_year = reference_year,
    coefficients = tibble::tibble(
      year = integer(),
      term = character(),
      estimate = numeric(),
      std_error = numeric(),
      t_df = numeric(),
      conf_low = numeric(),
      conf_high = numeric(),
      p_value = numeric(),
      available = logical()
    ),
    joint_test = list(
      status = "unavailable",
      statistic = NA_real_,
      df1 = NA_real_,
      df2 = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      reason = reason,
      years = joint_years,
      rank = NA_integer_
    ),
    nobs = NA_real_,
    n_properties = NA_real_,
    n_clusters = NA_real_,
    n_removed_by_estimator = NA_real_,
    warnings = NA_character_,
    vcov = NULL,
    ssc = NULL
  )
}

# Every scalar and profile key of a market that cannot be estimated (market blocked upstream).
blocked_cells_for_market <- function(market, reason) {
  grid <- model_grid(market)
  cells <- dplyr::bind_rows(Map(
    function(v, f, a) empty_cell(market, v, f, a, "blocked_input", reason),
    grid$variant,
    grid$fe,
    grid$attention
  ))
  profiles <- lapply(names(MODEL_FE), function(fe) {
    empty_profile(market, fe, "blocked_input", reason)
  })
  names(profiles) <- profile_key(market, names(MODEL_FE))
  list(
    cells = cells,
    profiles = profiles,
    residual_support = empty_residual_support(),
    residual_support_by_year = tibble::tibble(
      model_key = character(),
      year = integer(),
      share = numeric()
    ),
    samples = list(
      ids = character(),
      variants = list(),
      estimated = list(),
      profile = empty_profile_samples()
    ),
    models = stats::setNames(
      vector("list", nrow(cells) + length(profiles)),
      c(cells$model_key, names(profiles))
    ),
    fit_log = tibble::tibble(
      model_key = character(),
      status = character(),
      seconds = numeric(),
      peak_gc_mb = numeric()
    ),
    ledger = new_variant_ledger()
  )
}

empty_residual_support <- function() {
  tibble::tibble(
    model_key = character(),
    rss = numeric(),
    centred_raw_variation = numeric(),
    ratio = numeric(),
    lsoa_share_top1 = numeric(),
    lsoa_share_top5 = numeric(),
    lsoa_share_top10 = numeric(),
    largest_cluster_share = numeric(),
    n_clusters = numeric(),
    n_rows = numeric()
  )
}

# ---- Variant samples (index vectors into the eligible panel; no panel copies) -------------

# The variant ledger has the exclusion-ledger columns plus `variant` and `fe`. Chains are
# checked within (market, variant, fe): every variant branches from the headline panel,
# and complete_case_controls branches (per FE) from the complete_case sample.
new_variant_ledger <- function() {
  dplyr::mutate(new_ledger(), variant = character(), fe = character())
}

restrict_rows <- function(panel, idx, keep, ledger, market, step, note = "") {
  if (length(keep) != length(idx)) {
    stop("`keep` must have one entry per selected row.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  keep <- !is.na(keep) & keep
  new_idx <- idx[keep]
  ledger <- ledger_append(
    ledger,
    market,
    step,
    length(idx),
    length(new_idx),
    count_groups(panel$repeat_id[idx]),
    count_groups(panel$repeat_id[new_idx]),
    note
  )
  list(idx = new_idx, ledger = ledger)
}

recompute_repeat_rows <- function(panel, idx, ledger, market, variant) {
  eligible <- repeat_eligible_ids(panel[
    idx,
    c("repeat_id", "date"),
    with = FALSE
  ])
  restrict_rows(
    panel,
    idx,
    panel$repeat_id[idx] %chin% eligible,
    ledger,
    market,
    paste0("variant:", variant, ":recompute_repeats"),
    "at least two distinct surviving dates per property (recomputed after the restriction)"
  )
}

assert_variant_ledger_identity <- function(
  ledger,
  headline_rows,
  complete_case_rows = NULL
) {
  if (nrow(ledger) == 0L) {
    return(invisible(TRUE))
  }
  key <- paste(
    ledger$market,
    ledger$variant,
    ifelse(is.na(ledger$fe), "", ledger$fe)
  )
  for (k in unique(key)) {
    rows <- ledger[key == k, ]
    rows <- rows[order(rows$step_order), ]
    origin <- if (rows$variant[[1L]] == "complete_case_controls") {
      complete_case_rows
    } else {
      headline_rows
    }
    if (!is.null(origin) && rows$n_rows_before[[1L]] != origin) {
      stop(
        "Variant ledger for ",
        k,
        " does not branch from its parent sample.",
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
    if (!all(rows$n_rows_removed == rows$n_rows_before - rows$n_rows_after)) {
      stop(
        "Variant ledger removed counts do not reconcile for ",
        k,
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
    if (
      nrow(rows) > 1L &&
        (!all(rows$n_rows_after[-nrow(rows)] == rows$n_rows_before[-1L]) ||
          !all(rows$n_groups_after[-nrow(rows)] == rows$n_groups_before[-1L]))
    ) {
      stop("Variant ledger rows do not chain for ", k, call. = FALSE)
    }
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

# Returns list(ids, variants = list(<variant> = index into ids), ledger (variant ledger),
# metadata). `complete_case_controls` shares the complete_case input sample; its per-FE
# estimation rows are fixed in estimate_market_models() from the comparator fit.
build_variant_samples <- function(
  entry,
  market,
  cfg = market_config(market),
  config = CONFIG
) {
  panel <- entry$panel
  if (!data.table::is.data.table(panel)) {
    stop("`entry$panel` must be a data.table.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  if (anyDuplicated(panel$id) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "Panel ids must be unique to serve as the sample dictionary.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  if (!is.logical(panel$any_change) || anyNA(panel$any_change)) {
    stop("`any_change` must be a complete logical column.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  ids <- as.character(panel$id)
  all_idx <- seq_len(nrow(panel))
  variants <- list(headline = all_idx)
  ledgers <- list()

  step <- restrict_rows(
    panel,
    all_idx,
    !panel$any_change,
    new_ledger(),
    market,
    "variant:exclude_changes:drop_flagged_groups",
    sprintf(
      "drop whole properties with any observed change in %s (flags frozen on the eligible panel)",
      paste(cfg$change_cols, collapse = ", ")
    )
  )
  step <- recompute_repeat_rows(
    panel,
    step$idx,
    step$ledger,
    market,
    "exclude_changes"
  )
  variants$exclude_changes <- step$idx
  ledgers$exclude_changes <- step$ledger

  complete <- stats::complete.cases(panel[, cfg$control_cols, with = FALSE])
  step <- restrict_rows(
    panel,
    all_idx,
    complete,
    new_ledger(),
    market,
    "variant:complete_case:nonmissing_controls",
    sprintf("rows with nonmissing %s", paste(cfg$control_cols, collapse = ", "))
  )
  step <- recompute_repeat_rows(
    panel,
    step$idx,
    step$ledger,
    market,
    "complete_case"
  )
  variants$complete_case <- step$idx
  variants$complete_case_controls <- step$idx
  ledgers$complete_case <- step$ledger

  step <- restrict_rows(
    panel,
    all_idx,
    panel$date >= config$short_window_start,
    new_ledger(),
    market,
    "variant:short_window:date_from_start",
    sprintf(
      "dates on or after %s (article stock unchanged: KTD4 origin %s)",
      format(config$short_window_start),
      format(config$article_origin)
    )
  )
  step <- recompute_repeat_rows(
    panel,
    step$idx,
    step$ledger,
    market,
    "short_window"
  )
  variants$short_window <- step$idx
  ledgers$short_window <- step$ledger
  # KTD4: the short window keeps the long-run stock. Compare row values with the calendar.
  calendar <- entry$calendar
  expected <- calendar$log_articles[match(
    panel$month_index[step$idx],
    calendar$month_index
  )]
  observed <- panel$log_articles[step$idx]
  if (
    !identical(is.na(expected), is.na(observed)) ||
      !isTRUE(all(expected[!is.na(expected)] == observed[!is.na(observed)]))
  ) {
    stop(
      "Short-window article values differ from the long-run calendar for the same months.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  ledger <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(ledgers), function(v) {
    dplyr::mutate(ledgers[[v]], variant = v, fe = NA_character_)
  }))
  ledger$step_order <- seq_len(nrow(ledger))
  assert_variant_ledger_identity(ledger, nrow(panel))
  metadata <- lapply(variants, function(idx) {
    list(
      n_rows = length(idx),
      n_properties = count_groups(panel$repeat_id[idx])
    )
  })
  metadata$short_window$article_values_match_long_run <- TRUE
  metadata$short_window$start <- config$short_window_start
  list(ids = ids, variants = variants, ledger = ledger, metadata = metadata)
}

# ---- Fitting one scalar cell -----------------------------------------------------------

capture_conditions <- function(expr, store) {
  withCallingHandlers(
    expr,
    warning = function(w) {
      store(paste0("warning: ", conditionMessage(w)))
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    },
    message = function(m) {
      store(paste0("message: ", trimws(conditionMessage(m))))
      invokeRestart("muffleMessage")
    }
  )
}

sample_counts <- function(dt, retained, event_month = CONFIG$event_month) {
  event_start <- lubridate::floor_date(event_month, "month")
  rid <- dt$repeat_id[retained]
  near <- dt$near[retained]
  pre <- dt$date[retained] < event_start
  sides <- data.table::data.table(rid = rid, pre = pre)[,
    .(both = any(pre) & any(!pre)),
    by = rid
  ]
  list(
    nobs = length(retained),
    n_properties = data.table::uniqueN(rid),
    n_clusters = data.table::uniqueN(dt$lsoa[retained]),
    n_near_properties = data.table::uniqueN(rid[near == 1L]),
    n_far_properties = data.table::uniqueN(rid[near == 0L]),
    n_properties_both_sides_event = sum(sides$both),
    n_removed_by_estimator = nrow(dt) - length(retained)
  )
}

# Model-specific inference pieces from a clustered vcov matrix (fixest attributes).
inference_from_vcov <- function(V, coefs, term) {
  se <- sqrt(diag(V))[term]
  df <- as.numeric(attr(V, "df.t"))
  est <- unname(coefs[term])
  list(
    estimate = est,
    std_error = unname(se),
    t_df = df,
    conf_low = est - stats::qt(0.975, df) * unname(se),
    conf_high = est + stats::qt(0.975, df) * unname(se),
    p_value = 2 * stats::pt(-abs(est / unname(se)), df)
  )
}

cluster_summariser <- function(fit) summary(fit, vcov = ~lsoa)

# Clustered inference shared by fit_cell() and fit_profile(). Returns list(status,
# reason, V, t_df, inference, summarised, vcov_warnings): `summarised` is the summary
# object when the summariser succeeded; `inference` holds the focal-term pieces when
# `term` is given. V and inference are NULL whenever inference is unavailable. A
# summariser error becomes estimated_inference_unavailable only when its message
# matches VCOV_UNAVAILABLE_PATTERN; anything else stops the run with the model key.
resolve_inference <- function(
  fit,
  coefs,
  term,
  model_key,
  summariser = cluster_summariser
) {
  vcov_warnings <- character()
  store <- function(text) vcov_warnings <<- c(vcov_warnings, text)
  summarised <- tryCatch(
    capture_conditions(summariser(fit), store),
    error = function(e) e
  )
  unavailable <- function(reason, summarised = NULL) {
    list(
      status = "estimated_inference_unavailable",
      reason = reason,
      V = NULL,
      t_df = NA_real_,
      inference = NULL,
      summarised = summarised,
      vcov_warnings = vcov_warnings
    )
  }
  if (inherits(summarised, "error")) {
    msg <- conditionMessage(summarised)
    if (
      !grepl(VCOV_UNAVAILABLE_PATTERN, msg, perl = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
    ) {
      stop("Inference error for ", model_key, ": ", msg, call. = FALSE)
    }
    return(unavailable(paste0(
      "clustered covariance could not be computed: ",
      msg
    )))
  }
  V <- stats::vcov(summarised)
  t_df <- as.numeric(attr(V, "df.t"))
  inference <- if (is.null(term)) NULL else inference_from_vcov(V, coefs, term)
  finite_inference <- is.null(inference) ||
    (is.finite(inference$std_error) && is.finite(inference$t_df))
  if (!all(is.finite(V)) || !is.finite(t_df) || t_df < 1 || !finite_inference) {
    return(unavailable(
      "clustered covariance or its degrees of freedom are not finite",
      summarised
    ))
  }
  if (any(grepl(INFERENCE_WARNING_PATTERN, vcov_warnings, perl = TRUE))) {
    return(unavailable(
      paste0(
        "covariance warning invalidates inference: ",
        paste(vcov_warnings, collapse = "; ")
      ),
      summarised
    ))
  }
  list(
    status = "estimated",
    reason = NA_character_,
    V = V,
    t_df = t_df,
    inference = inference,
    summarised = summarised,
    vcov_warnings = vcov_warnings
  )
}

# KTD11: focal column residualised on the fixed effects (fixest's demeaned X) and, for
# controlled fits, projected off the other demeaned columns that carry an estimated
# coefficient, with a rank-aware qr(). fixest keeps collinearity-removed columns in
# X_demeaned; they are outside the model and must not enter the projection.
compute_residual_support <- function(
  fit,
  term,
  raw_focal,
  year,
  lsoa,
  model_key
) {
  Xd <- fit$X_demeaned
  if (is.null(dim(Xd))) {
    Xd <- matrix(Xd, ncol = 1L, dimnames = list(NULL, names(stats::coef(fit))))
  }
  if (is.null(colnames(Xd)) && ncol(Xd) == 1L) {
    colnames(Xd) <- term
  }
  j <- match(term, colnames(Xd))
  if (is.na(j)) {
    stop(
      "Demeaned design lacks the focal column for ",
      model_key,
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  if (nrow(Xd) != length(raw_focal)) {
    stop(
      "Demeaned design rows do not match the retained sample for ",
      model_key,
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  r <- Xd[, j]
  others <- setdiff(names(stats::coef(fit)), term)
  if (length(others) > 0L) {
    at <- match(others, colnames(Xd))
    if (anyNA(at)) {
      stop(
        "Demeaned design lacks estimated columns for ",
        model_key,
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
    q <- qr(Xd[, at, drop = FALSE])
    if (q$rank > 0L) r <- r - qr.fitted(q, r)
  }
  r2 <- r^2
  rss <- sum(r2)
  centred <- sum((raw_focal - mean(raw_focal))^2)
  by_year <- tapply(r2, year, sum)
  by_lsoa <- sort(tapply(r2, lsoa, sum), decreasing = TRUE)
  share_top <- function(k) {
    if (rss > 0) {
      sum(by_lsoa[seq_len(min(k, length(by_lsoa)))]) / rss
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  }
  list(
    summary = tibble::tibble(
      model_key = model_key,
      rss = rss,
      centred_raw_variation = centred,
      ratio = if (centred > 0) rss / centred else NA_real_,
      lsoa_share_top1 = share_top(1L),
      lsoa_share_top5 = share_top(5L),
      lsoa_share_top10 = share_top(10L),
      largest_cluster_share = share_top(1L),
      n_clusters = length(by_lsoa),
      n_rows = length(r)
    ),
    by_year = tibble::tibble(
      model_key = model_key,
      year = as.integer(names(by_year)),
      share = if (rss > 0) as.numeric(by_year) / rss else NA_real_
    )
  )
}

# Formulas inside a fixest object carry the environment of the call that made them
# (fit_cell's frame, summary()'s frame), which references the working data and fit.
# Rebinding them to the global environment keeps serialisation small. Closures and
# environments have no place in a compact model and stop the run.
strip_environments <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, "formula")) {
    environment(x) <- globalenv()
    return(x)
  }
  if (is.function(x) || is.environment(x)) {
    stop("Compact model holds a closure or environment.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  if (is.list(x) && !is.data.frame(x)) {
    attrs <- attributes(x)
    x <- lapply(x, strip_environments)
    attributes(x) <- attrs
  }
  x
}

# Strip the large per-observation elements; keep what reproduces the coefficient table.
# Size is checked on the serialised object, which counts formula environments.
compact_model <- function(fit, max_element_bytes = 2e6) {
  drop <- c(
    "X_demeaned",
    "y_demeaned",
    "residuals",
    "fitted.values",
    "scores",
    "fixef_id",
    "obs_selection",
    "sumFE",
    "working_residuals",
    "irls_weights",
    "weights",
    "call_env",
    "summary_from_fit",
    "data",
    "y",
    "X",
    "hessian"
  )
  for (nm in intersect(drop, names(fit))) {
    fit[[nm]] <- NULL
  }
  fit <- strip_environments(fit)
  sizes <- vapply(fit, function(e) length(serialize(e, NULL)), numeric(1))
  big <- names(sizes)[sizes > max_element_bytes]
  if (length(big) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "Compact model still holds large elements: ",
      paste(big, collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  fit
}

# Controls: factors with fewer than two observed levels cannot enter the design and are
# recorded as absorbed before fitting; numeric controls without variation likewise.
prepare_controls <- function(dt, controls) {
  rhs <- character()
  absorbed <- character()
  for (col in controls) {
    values <- dt[[col]][!is.na(dt[[col]])]
    if (data.table::uniqueN(values) < 2L) {
      absorbed <- c(absorbed, col)
      next
    }
    if (col %in% CONTROL_FACTOR_COLS) {
      data.table::set(dt, j = col, value = factor(dt[[col]]))
    }
    rhs <- c(rhs, col)
  }
  list(rhs = rhs, absorbed = absorbed)
}

# Fits one scalar cell on `data` (a panel subset). Returns list(cell (one-row tibble),
# retained (row index into `data`), model (compact list or NULL), support, support_by_year,
# seconds). Only the diagnosable conditions become statuses; other errors stop the run.
fit_cell <- function(
  data,
  market,
  variant,
  fe,
  attention,
  controls = character(),
  article_status = "valid",
  article_reason = NA_character_,
  event_month = CONFIG$event_month,
  summariser = cluster_summariser
) {
  key <- model_key(market, variant, fe, attention)
  term <- focal_term(attention)
  out <- list(
    cell = NULL,
    retained = integer(),
    model = NULL,
    support = NULL,
    support_by_year = NULL
  )
  finish <- function(status, reason = NA_character_) {
    out$cell <- empty_cell(market, variant, fe, attention, status, reason)
    out
  }
  if (attention == "log_articles" && !identical(article_status, "valid")) {
    return(finish(
      "blocked_input",
      paste0("article cells blocked: ", article_reason)
    ))
  }
  if (nrow(data) == 0L) {
    return(finish(
      "unsupported_sample",
      "no rows after the variant restrictions"
    ))
  }
  if (length(repeat_eligible_ids(data)) == 0L) {
    return(finish(
      "unsupported_sample",
      "no property observed on two distinct dates"
    ))
  }
  near_values <- unique(data$near)
  if (!1L %in% near_values) {
    return(finish(
      "unidentified",
      "no near properties in the sample (no near/far contrast)"
    ))
  }
  if (!0L %in% near_values) {
    return(finish(
      "unidentified",
      "no far properties in the sample (no near/far contrast)"
    ))
  }
  if (attention == "log_articles" && all(is.na(data$log_articles))) {
    return(finish("blocked_input", "log_articles missing for every row"))
  }

  cols <- unique(c(
    "repeat_id",
    "date",
    "year",
    "month_index",
    "log_price",
    "lsoa",
    "msoa",
    "near",
    attention,
    controls
  ))
  dt <- data[, cols, with = FALSE]
  ctrl <- prepare_controls(dt, controls)
  fml <- stats::as.formula(paste(
    "log_price ~",
    paste(c(term, ctrl$rhs), collapse = " + "),
    "|",
    MODEL_FE[[fe]]
  ))
  captured <- character()
  store <- function(text) captured <<- c(captured, text)
  fit <- tryCatch(
    capture_conditions(
      fixest::feols(fml, data = dt, demeaned = TRUE, notes = TRUE),
      store
    ),
    error = function(e) e
  )
  if (inherits(fit, "error")) {
    if (grepl(COLLINEAR_FE_PATTERN, conditionMessage(fit), fixed = TRUE)) {
      return(finish(
        "unidentified",
        paste0(
          "focal term collinear with the fixed effects (no within-property variation): ",
          gsub("\\s+", " ", conditionMessage(fit))
        )
      ))
    }
    stop(
      "Estimation error for ",
      key,
      ": ",
      conditionMessage(fit),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  retained <- as.integer(fixest::obs(fit))
  if (length(retained) != stats::nobs(fit)) {
    stop("Retained rows do not match nobs for ", key, call. = FALSE)
  }
  coefs <- stats::coef(fit)
  collin <- as.character(fit$collin.var %||% character())
  controls_absorbed <- c(ctrl$absorbed, setdiff(collin, term))
  counts <- sample_counts(dt, retained, event_month)
  warnings_text <- if (length(captured) > 0L) {
    paste(captured, collapse = "; ")
  } else {
    NA_character_
  }
  fill <- function(cell, inference = NULL) {
    cell[names(counts)] <- lapply(counts, as.numeric)
    cell$n_controls_absorbed <- length(controls_absorbed)
    cell$warnings <- warnings_text
    if (!is.null(inference)) {
      cell[names(inference)] <- inference
    }
    cell
  }
  if (!term %in% names(coefs)) {
    reason <- paste0(
      "focal term removed for collinearity with the fixed effects and controls (collin.var: ",
      paste(collin, collapse = ", "),
      ")"
    )
    out$cell <- fill(empty_cell(
      market,
      variant,
      fe,
      attention,
      "unidentified",
      reason
    ))
    out$retained <- retained
    rm(fit)
    invisible(gc())
    return(out)
  }
  estimate <- unname(coefs[term])
  if (!is.finite(estimate)) {
    stop("Non-finite focal coefficient for ", key, call. = FALSE)
  }
  # Inference is resolved separately so a covariance failure keeps the coefficient.
  inf <- resolve_inference(fit, coefs, term, key, summariser)
  captured <- c(captured, inf$vcov_warnings)
  status <- inf$status
  reason <- inf$reason
  warnings_text <- if (length(captured) > 0L) {
    paste(captured, collapse = "; ")
  } else {
    NA_character_
  }
  cell <- fill(
    empty_cell(market, variant, fe, attention, status, reason),
    inf$inference
  )
  cell$estimate <- estimate
  raw_focal <- as.numeric(dt$near[retained]) *
    as.numeric(dt[[attention]][retained])
  support <- compute_residual_support(
    fit,
    term,
    raw_focal,
    dt$year[retained],
    dt$lsoa[retained],
    key
  )
  keep <- inf$summarised %||% fit
  out$model <- list(
    model_key = key,
    term = term,
    formula = paste(deparse(fml), collapse = ""),
    status = status,
    fit = compact_model(keep),
    vcov = inf$V,
    ssc = if (is.null(inf$V)) NULL else attr(inf$V, "ssc"),
    t_df = cell$t_df,
    nobs = stats::nobs(fit),
    fixef_sizes = fit$fixef_sizes,
    collin_var = collin,
    controls = controls,
    controls_absorbed = controls_absorbed,
    warnings = captured
  )
  out$cell <- cell
  out$retained <- retained
  out$support <- support$summary
  out$support_by_year <- support$by_year
  rm(fit, inf, keep, dt)
  invisible(gc())
  out
}

assert_identical_estimation_rows <- function(
  controlled_ids,
  comparator_ids,
  key
) {
  if (
    length(controlled_ids) != length(comparator_ids) ||
      !setequal(controlled_ids, comparator_ids)
  ) {
    stop(
      "Complete-case controlled fit ",
      key,
      " did not retain the comparator's estimation rows (",
      length(controlled_ids),
      " vs ",
      length(comparator_ids),
      ").",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

# ---- Annual profiles and the joint test ---------------------------------------------------

profile_term <- function(year) sprintf("year::%d:near", year)

is_profile_key <- function(key) endsWith(key, "__profile")

# Membership record of a market's annual-profile panel (KTD5). `panel` says
# whether the profiles were fitted on the scalar headline panel ("shared": the
# ids are the scalar dictionary) or on a separate wider-window panel
# ("separate": `ids` is its own dictionary). Profile retained rows always index
# this record, never the scalar variants.
empty_profile_samples <- function() {
  list(
    panel = "shared",
    ids = NULL,
    n_rows = 0L,
    start = NA_character_,
    end = NA_character_,
    estimated = list(),
    metadata = list()
  )
}

# The columns the annual-profile fits and their membership record read. A
# separate profile panel is reduced to these after its exposure step so that
# the nine-million-row sales profile panel does not carry coordinates,
# postcodes, controls or change flags through estimation.
PROFILE_PANEL_COLUMNS <- c(
  "id",
  "repeat_id",
  "date",
  "year",
  "month_index",
  "log_price",
  "lsoa",
  "msoa",
  "near",
  "band"
)

prune_profile_panel <- function(panel) {
  missing <- setdiff(PROFILE_PANEL_COLUMNS, names(panel))
  if (length(missing) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "Profile panel lacks columns: ",
      paste(missing, collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  drop <- setdiff(names(panel), PROFILE_PANEL_COLUMNS)
  if (length(drop) > 0L) {
    panel[, (drop) := NULL]
  }
  panel[]
}

# Annual support of a banded panel: rows and properties per year and band, so
# the report can show where the expanded profiles draw their near-far contrast.
profile_support_by_year <- function(panel) {
  if (nrow(panel) == 0L) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      year = integer(),
      band = character(),
      n_rows = numeric(),
      n_properties = numeric()
    ))
  }
  out <- panel[,
    .(n_rows = .N, n_properties = data.table::uniqueN(repeat_id)),
    by = .(year, band)
  ][order(year, band)]
  tibble::tibble(
    year = as.integer(out$year),
    band = as.character(out$band),
    n_rows = as.numeric(out$n_rows),
    n_properties = as.numeric(out$n_properties)
  )
}

# Full joint restriction only: every requested coefficient available, full-rank
# residualised annual-interaction matrix, finite positive-definite covariance block.
joint_test <- function(coefs, V, t_df, Xd, joint_years) {
  unavailable <- function(reason, rank = NA_integer_) {
    list(
      status = "unavailable",
      statistic = NA_real_,
      df1 = length(joint_years),
      df2 = t_df,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      reason = reason,
      years = joint_years,
      rank = rank
    )
  }
  terms <- profile_term(joint_years)
  missing <- setdiff(terms, names(coefs))
  if (length(missing) > 0L) {
    return(unavailable(paste0(
      "coefficient(s) not estimable: ",
      paste(missing, collapse = ", ")
    )))
  }
  if (is.null(V)) {
    return(unavailable("clustered covariance unavailable"))
  }
  cols <- match(names(coefs), colnames(Xd))
  if (anyNA(cols)) {
    return(unavailable("demeaned annual-interaction columns missing"))
  }
  # Rank of the residualised annual-interaction matrix through its k x k Gram
  # matrix: a QR of the n x k demeaned design copies the nine-million-row
  # expanded sales profile panel and exceeds R's vector memory limit. The
  # tolerance is the square of qr()'s default so the decision matches a QR of
  # the design itself (singular values enter the Gram matrix squared).
  rank <- qr(crossprod(Xd)[cols, cols, drop = FALSE], tol = 1e-14)$rank
  if (rank < length(cols)) {
    return(unavailable(
      sprintf(
        "residualised annual-interaction matrix has rank %d < %d",
        rank,
        length(cols)
      ),
      rank
    ))
  }
  V5 <- V[terms, terms, drop = FALSE]
  if (!all(is.finite(V5))) {
    return(unavailable(
      "covariance block of the restricted coefficients is not finite",
      rank
    ))
  }
  eig <- eigen((V5 + t(V5)) / 2, symmetric = TRUE, only.values = TRUE)$values
  if (min(eig) <= 0 || min(eig) <= 1e-12 * max(eig)) {
    return(unavailable(
      "covariance block of the restricted coefficients is not positive definite",
      rank
    ))
  }
  if (!is.finite(t_df) || t_df < 1) {
    return(unavailable("clustered degrees of freedom unavailable", rank))
  }
  b <- coefs[terms]
  statistic <- as.numeric(crossprod(b, solve(V5, b))) / length(terms)
  list(
    status = "available",
    statistic = statistic,
    df1 = length(terms),
    df2 = t_df,
    p_value = stats::pf(statistic, length(terms), t_df, lower.tail = FALSE),
    reason = NA_character_,
    years = joint_years,
    rank = rank
  )
}

fit_profile <- function(
  data,
  market,
  fe,
  reference_year = CONFIG$profile_reference_year,
  joint_years = CONFIG$profile_joint_years,
  event_month = CONFIG$event_month,
  summariser = cluster_summariser
) {
  key <- profile_key(market, fe)
  out <- list(profile = NULL, retained = integer(), model = NULL)
  finish <- function(status, reason = NA_character_) {
    out$profile <- empty_profile(
      market,
      fe,
      status,
      reason,
      reference_year,
      joint_years
    )
    out
  }
  if (nrow(data) == 0L) {
    return(finish("unsupported_sample", "no rows in the headline sample"))
  }
  if (length(repeat_eligible_ids(data)) == 0L) {
    return(finish(
      "unsupported_sample",
      "no property observed on two distinct dates"
    ))
  }
  near_values <- unique(data$near)
  if (!1L %in% near_values) {
    return(finish(
      "unidentified",
      "no near properties in the sample (no near/far contrast)"
    ))
  }
  if (!0L %in% near_values) {
    return(finish(
      "unidentified",
      "no far properties in the sample (no near/far contrast)"
    ))
  }
  if (!reference_year %in% data$year) {
    return(finish(
      "unsupported_sample",
      sprintf("reference year %d absent from the sample", reference_year)
    ))
  }
  dt <- data[,
    c(
      "repeat_id",
      "date",
      "year",
      "month_index",
      "log_price",
      "lsoa",
      "msoa",
      "near"
    ),
    with = FALSE
  ]
  fml <- stats::as.formula(sprintf(
    "log_price ~ i(year, near, ref = %d) | %s",
    reference_year,
    MODEL_FE[[fe]]
  ))
  captured <- character()
  store <- function(text) captured <<- c(captured, text)
  fit <- tryCatch(
    capture_conditions(
      fixest::feols(fml, data = dt, demeaned = TRUE, notes = TRUE),
      store
    ),
    error = function(e) e
  )
  if (inherits(fit, "error")) {
    if (grepl(COLLINEAR_FE_PATTERN, conditionMessage(fit), fixed = TRUE)) {
      return(finish(
        "unidentified",
        paste0(
          "annual interactions collinear with the fixed effects: ",
          gsub("\\s+", " ", conditionMessage(fit))
        )
      ))
    }
    stop(
      "Estimation error for ",
      key,
      ": ",
      conditionMessage(fit),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  retained <- as.integer(fixest::obs(fit))
  coefs <- stats::coef(fit)
  collin <- as.character(fit$collin.var %||% character())
  counts <- sample_counts(dt, retained, event_month)
  inf <- resolve_inference(fit, coefs, NULL, key, summariser)
  captured <- c(captured, inf$vcov_warnings)
  V <- inf$V
  t_df <- inf$t_df
  status <- inf$status
  reason <- inf$reason
  years <- sort(setdiff(unique(dt$year[retained]), reference_year))
  coefficients <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(years, function(y) {
    term <- profile_term(y)
    available <- term %in% names(coefs) && is.finite(coefs[[term]])
    est <- if (available) unname(coefs[term]) else NA_real_
    inf <- if (available && !is.null(V)) {
      inference_from_vcov(V, coefs, term)
    } else {
      NULL
    }
    tibble::tibble(
      year = as.integer(y),
      term = term,
      estimate = est,
      std_error = inf$std_error %||% NA_real_,
      t_df = inf$t_df %||% NA_real_,
      conf_low = inf$conf_low %||% NA_real_,
      conf_high = inf$conf_high %||% NA_real_,
      p_value = inf$p_value %||% NA_real_,
      available = available
    )
  }))
  Xd <- fit$X_demeaned
  if (is.null(dim(Xd))) {
    Xd <- matrix(Xd, ncol = 1L, dimnames = list(NULL, names(coefs)))
  }
  test <- joint_test(coefs, V, t_df, Xd, joint_years)
  if (test$status == "available") {
    # The manual Wald statistic must reproduce fixest's under the same vcov and df conventions.
    reference <- fixest::wald(
      inf$summarised,
      keep = paste0(
        "^(",
        paste(profile_term(joint_years), collapse = "|"),
        ")$"
      ),
      print = FALSE
    )
    if (
      !isTRUE(all.equal(
        unname(reference$stat),
        test$statistic,
        tolerance = 1e-8
      )) ||
        !isTRUE(all.equal(as.numeric(reference$df2), test$df2)) ||
        reference$df1 != test$df1
    ) {
      stop(
        "Manual joint test does not reproduce fixest::wald() for ",
        key,
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
  if (status == "estimated" && !any(coefficients$available)) {
    status <- "unidentified"
    reason <- paste0(
      "no annual interaction estimable (collin.var: ",
      paste(collin, collapse = ", "),
      ")"
    )
  }
  keep <- inf$summarised %||% fit
  out$profile <- list(
    model_key = key,
    market = market,
    fe = fe,
    status = status,
    reason = reason,
    reference_year = reference_year,
    coefficients = coefficients,
    joint_test = test,
    nobs = counts$nobs,
    n_properties = counts$n_properties,
    n_clusters = counts$n_clusters,
    n_removed_by_estimator = counts$n_removed_by_estimator,
    warnings = if (length(captured) > 0L) {
      paste(captured, collapse = "; ")
    } else {
      NA_character_
    },
    vcov = V,
    ssc = if (is.null(V)) NULL else attr(V, "ssc"),
    t_df = t_df,
    collin_var = collin
  )
  out$model <- list(
    model_key = key,
    term = profile_term(years),
    formula = paste(deparse(fml), collapse = ""),
    status = status,
    fit = compact_model(keep),
    vcov = V,
    ssc = if (is.null(V)) NULL else attr(V, "ssc"),
    t_df = t_df,
    nobs = counts$nobs,
    fixef_sizes = fit$fixef_sizes,
    collin_var = collin,
    controls = character(),
    controls_absorbed = character(),
    warnings = captured
  )
  out$retained <- retained
  rm(fit, inf, keep, dt, Xd)
  invisible(gc())
  out
}

# ---- Driver: one market, sequential, one working fit at a time -----------------------------

estimate_market_models <- function(
  entry,
  market,
  cfg = market_config(market),
  config = CONFIG,
  verbose = TRUE
) {
  say <- function(...) if (verbose) cat(sprintf(...))
  if (!identical(entry$status, "ready")) {
    return(blocked_cells_for_market(market, entry$reason))
  }
  started <- Sys.time()
  vs <- build_variant_samples(entry, market, cfg, config)
  panel <- entry$panel
  ids <- vs$ids
  # KTD1: the annual profiles fit their own panel when the market has a wider
  # profile window; otherwise they fit the scalar headline panel unchanged.
  separate_profile <- !is.null(entry$profile_panel)
  profile_panel <- if (separate_profile) entry$profile_panel else panel
  if (!data.table::is.data.table(profile_panel)) {
    stop("`entry$profile_panel` must be a data.table.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  if (separate_profile && anyDuplicated(profile_panel$id) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "Profile panel ids must be unique to serve as the profile dictionary.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  profile_window <- profile_config(cfg)
  profile_estimated <- list()
  calendar <- entry$calendar
  article_status <- if (all(calendar$article_status == "valid")) {
    "valid"
  } else {
    "blocked"
  }
  article_reason <- attr(calendar, "article_reason") %||%
    calendar$article_reason[[1L]]
  cells <- list()
  models <- list()
  support <- list()
  support_by_year <- list()
  estimated <- list()
  fit_log <- list()
  ledger <- vs$ledger
  controls_rows <- list() # per FE: the comparator estimation rows fixed for complete_case_controls
  grid <- model_grid(market)
  say(
    "[%s] variants: %s; profile panel: %s (%s rows, %s-%s)\n",
    market,
    paste(
      sprintf("%s=%s", names(vs$variants), format_count(lengths(vs$variants))),
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    if (separate_profile) "separate" else "shared",
    format_count(nrow(profile_panel)),
    format(profile_window$start),
    format(profile_window$end)
  )
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(grid))) {
    variant <- grid$variant[[i]]
    fe <- grid$fe[[i]]
    attention <- grid$attention[[i]]
    key <- grid$model_key[[i]]
    controls <- character()
    if (variant == "complete_case_controls") {
      comparator_key <- model_key(market, "complete_case", fe, attention)
      comparator <- cells[[comparator_key]]
      if (!comparator$status %in% ESTIMATED_STATUSES) {
        cells[[key]] <- empty_cell(
          market,
          variant,
          fe,
          attention,
          comparator$status,
          paste0(
            "comparator ",
            comparator_key,
            " not estimated: ",
            comparator$reason
          )
        )
        models[key] <- list(NULL)
        fit_log[[key]] <- tibble::tibble(
          model_key = key,
          status = comparator$status,
          seconds = 0,
          peak_gc_mb = NA_real_
        )
        say("  %-72s %-32s (comparator)\n", key, comparator$status)
        next
      }
      idx <- estimated[[comparator_key]]
      if (is.null(controls_rows[[fe]])) {
        controls_rows[[fe]] <- idx
        ledger <- dplyr::bind_rows(
          ledger,
          dplyr::mutate(
            ledger_append(
              new_ledger(),
              market,
              paste0(
                "variant:complete_case_controls:",
                fe,
                ":comparator_estimation_rows"
              ),
              length(vs$variants$complete_case),
              length(idx),
              count_groups(panel$repeat_id[vs$variants$complete_case]),
              count_groups(panel$repeat_id[idx]),
              paste0(
                "rows the complete_case fit retained under ",
                fe,
                "; controlled fit uses exactly these"
              )
            ),
            variant = "complete_case_controls",
            fe = fe
          )
        )
      } else if (!identical(sort(controls_rows[[fe]]), sort(idx))) {
        stop(
          "complete_case comparator retained different rows across attention measures under ",
          fe,
          call. = FALSE
        )
      }
      controls <- cfg$control_cols
    } else {
      idx <- vs$variants[[variant]]
    }
    data <- if (length(idx) == nrow(panel)) panel else panel[idx]
    invisible(gc(reset = TRUE))
    t0 <- Sys.time()
    res <- fit_cell(
      data,
      market,
      variant,
      fe,
      attention,
      controls,
      article_status,
      article_reason,
      config$event_month
    )
    gc_info <- gc()
    seconds <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))
    peak_mb <- as.numeric(
      gc_info["Ncells", "max used"] * 56 + gc_info["Vcells", "max used"] * 8
    ) /
      1024^2
    if (
      variant == "complete_case_controls" &&
        res$cell$status %in% ESTIMATED_STATUSES
    ) {
      assert_identical_estimation_rows(ids[idx[res$retained]], ids[idx], key)
    }
    cells[[key]] <- res$cell
    estimated[[key]] <- if (length(res$retained) > 0L) {
      idx[res$retained]
    } else {
      integer()
    }
    models[key] <- list(res$model)
    support[[key]] <- res$support
    support_by_year[[key]] <- res$support_by_year
    fit_log[[key]] <- tibble::tibble(
      model_key = key,
      status = res$cell$status,
      seconds = seconds,
      peak_gc_mb = peak_mb
    )
    say(
      "  %-72s %-32s %7.1fs %6.0f MB\n",
      key,
      res$cell$status,
      seconds,
      peak_mb
    )
    rm(data, res)
    invisible(gc())
  }
  profiles <- list()
  for (fe in names(MODEL_FE)) {
    key <- profile_key(market, fe)
    invisible(gc(reset = TRUE))
    t0 <- Sys.time()
    res <- fit_profile(
      profile_panel,
      market,
      fe,
      config$profile_reference_year,
      config$profile_joint_years,
      config$event_month
    )
    gc_info <- gc()
    seconds <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))
    peak_mb <- as.numeric(
      gc_info["Ncells", "max used"] * 56 + gc_info["Vcells", "max used"] * 8
    ) /
      1024^2
    profiles[[key]] <- res$profile
    profile_estimated[[key]] <- res$retained
    models[key] <- list(res$model)
    fit_log[[key]] <- tibble::tibble(
      model_key = key,
      status = res$profile$status,
      seconds = seconds,
      peak_gc_mb = peak_mb
    )
    say(
      "  %-72s %-32s %7.1fs %6.0f MB  joint: %s\n",
      key,
      res$profile$status,
      seconds,
      peak_mb,
      res$profile$joint_test$status
    )
    rm(res)
    invisible(gc())
  }
  ledger$step_order <- seq_len(nrow(ledger))
  assert_variant_ledger_identity(
    ledger,
    nrow(panel),
    length(vs$variants$complete_case)
  )
  say(
    "[%s] fitted in %.0f s\n",
    market,
    as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), started, units = "secs"))
  )
  list(
    cells = dplyr::bind_rows(cells),
    profiles = profiles,
    residual_support = if (length(support) > 0L) {
      dplyr::bind_rows(support)
    } else {
      empty_residual_support()
    },
    residual_support_by_year = if (length(support_by_year) > 0L) {
      dplyr::bind_rows(support_by_year)
    } else {
      tibble::tibble(
        model_key = character(),
        year = integer(),
        share = numeric()
      )
    },
    samples = list(
      ids = ids,
      variants = vs$variants,
      estimated = estimated,
      metadata = vs$metadata,
      profile = list(
        panel = if (separate_profile) "separate" else "shared",
        ids = if (separate_profile) as.character(profile_panel$id) else NULL,
        n_rows = nrow(profile_panel),
        start = format(profile_window$start, "%Y-%m-%d"),
        end = format(profile_window$end, "%Y-%m-%d"),
        estimated = profile_estimated,
        metadata = list(
          n_rows = nrow(profile_panel),
          n_properties = count_groups(profile_panel$repeat_id),
          support_by_year = profile_support_by_year(profile_panel)
        )
      )
    ),
    models = models,
    fit_log = dplyr::bind_rows(fit_log),
    ledger = ledger
  )
}

assert_model_grid_complete <- function(cells, profiles, markets = MARKETS) {
  expected <- expected_model_keys(markets)
  if (
    !identical(sort(cells$model_key), sort(expected$scalar)) ||
      anyDuplicated(cells$model_key) > 0L
  ) {
    stop(
      "Scalar cells do not match the expected ",
      length(expected$scalar),
      " keys exactly once each.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  if (!identical(sort(names(profiles)), sort(expected$profile))) {
    stop(
      "Profiles do not match the expected ",
      length(expected$profile),
      " keys exactly once each.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  statuses <- c(
    cells$status,
    vapply(profiles, function(p) p$status, character(1))
  )
  bad <- setdiff(unique(statuses), CELL_STATUSES)
  if (length(bad) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "Statuses outside the vocabulary: ",
      paste(bad, collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  no_reason <- cells$status != "estimated" &
    (is.na(cells$reason) | cells$reason == "")
  if (any(no_reason)) {
    stop(
      "Non-estimated cells without a reason: ",
      paste(cells$model_key[no_reason], collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}
```
