```{r}
#| label: helpers-bundle
#| include: false

# U4: fingerprints, bundle validation, atomic save, load, artifact export.

# ---- Fingerprint contract (KTD8) ----------------------------------------------------
#
# Computational identity = the labelled computational chunks of this QMD + the four
# sourced helper files + canonical CONFIG + versions of the computational packages +
# content hashes of every consumed input. Prose, display chunks, display packages and
# the `reestimate` switch are outside the fingerprint.

COMPUTATIONAL_CHUNK_LABELS <- c(
  "setup",
  "helpers-inputs",
  "helpers-exposure",
  "helpers-models",
  "helpers-bundle",
  "fixture-checks",
  "estimate"
)
COMPUTATIONAL_PACKAGES <- c(
  "arrow",
  "data.table",
  "fixest",
  "sf",
  "dplyr",
  "tidyr",
  "digest",
  "lubridate",
  "tibble",
  "withr",
  "tidyselect"
)
DISPLAY_PACKAGES <- c("ggplot2", "knitr", "rmarkdown")
HELPER_FILES <- c(
  "hash_utils.R",
  "repeat_transactions_utils.R",
  "site_group_utils.R",
  "script_setup.R"
)
REPORT_QMD_NAME <- "2026-09-19-001-long-run-public-attention-repeat-properties.qmd"
FINGERPRINT_ALGO <- "sha256"

computational_chunk_labels <- function() COMPUTATIONAL_CHUNK_LABELS

helper_file_paths <- function() {
  stats::setNames(
    here::here("scripts", "R", "utils", HELPER_FILES),
    HELPER_FILES
  )
}

hash_text <- function(x) {
  digest::digest(
    paste(x, collapse = "\n"),
    algo = FINGERPRINT_ALGO,
    serialize = FALSE
  )
}

hash_file_content <- function(path) {
  digest::digest(file = path, algo = "xxhash64")
}

project_relative_path <- function(path, root = here::here()) {
  escaped <- gsub("([][{}()+*^$|\\\\?.])", "\\\\\\1", root)
  sub(paste0("^", escaped, "/"), "", path)
}

resolve_project_path <- function(path) {
  ifelse(file.exists(path), path, here::here(path))
}

render_command <- function(reestimate = TRUE) {
  sprintf(
    "quarto render docs/reports/%s --to html -P reestimate:%s",
    REPORT_QMD_NAME,
    if (reestimate) "true" else "false"
  )
}

# The source being rendered. Quarto knits an intermediate `<stem>.rmarkdown` copy next
# to the QMD; the sibling `.qmd` is preferred so the hash covers the committed source.
report_qmd_path <- function() {
  current <- tryCatch(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE), error = function(e) {
    NULL
  })
  candidates <- character()
  if (
    is.character(current) &&
      length(current) == 1L &&
      !is.na(current) &&
      nzchar(current)
  ) {
    candidates <- c(sub("\\.rmarkdown$", ".qmd", current), current)
  }
  candidates <- c(candidates, here::here("docs", "reports", REPORT_QMD_NAME))
  hit <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)]
  if (length(hit) == 0L) {
    stop(
      "Cannot locate the report source to fingerprint; looked for ",
      paste(candidates, collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  normalizePath(hit[[1L]])
}

# Code text of labelled R chunks: ```{r} fences plus `#| label:` option lines.
qmd_chunk_sources <- function(qmd_path, labels) {
  lines <- readLines(qmd_path, warn = FALSE)
  opens <- grep("^```\\{r[^}]*\\}\\s*$", lines)
  closes <- grep("^```\\s*$", lines)
  chunks <- list()
  for (open in opens) {
    close <- closes[closes > open][1L]
    if (is.na(close)) {
      stop(
        "Unterminated R chunk at line ",
        open,
        " of ",
        qmd_path,
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
    body <- lines[seq.int(open + 1L, length.out = max(0L, close - open - 1L))]
    label_line <- grep("^#\\|\\s*label:", body, value = TRUE)
    if (length(label_line) == 0L) {
      next
    }
    label <- trimws(sub("^#\\|\\s*label:\\s*", "", label_line[[1L]]))
    if (label %in% names(chunks)) {
      stop("Duplicate chunk label `", label, "` in ", qmd_path, call. = FALSE)
    }
    chunks[[label]] <- paste(body, collapse = "\n")
  }
  missing <- setdiff(labels, names(chunks))
  if (length(missing) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "Computational chunks not found in ",
      qmd_path,
      ": ",
      paste(missing, collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  chunks[labels]
}

code_fingerprint <- function(
  qmd_path = report_qmd_path(),
  helper_paths = helper_file_paths(),
  labels = computational_chunk_labels()
) {
  chunks <- qmd_chunk_sources(qmd_path, labels)
  helpers <- vapply(
    helper_paths,
    function(p) {
      if (!file.exists(p)) {
        stop(
          "Helper file for the code fingerprint is missing: ",
          p,
          call. = FALSE
        )
      }
      paste(readLines(p, warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n")
    },
    character(1)
  )
  parts <- c(
    stats::setNames(
      vapply(chunks, hash_text, character(1)),
      paste0("chunk:", names(chunks))
    ),
    stats::setNames(
      vapply(helpers, hash_text, character(1)),
      paste0("helper:", names(helper_paths))
    )
  )
  list(hash = hash_text(paste(names(parts), parts, sep = "=")), parts = parts)
}

# Dates become ISO strings, absolute project paths become project-relative, integer and
# double vectors are both serialised as numbers. `params$reestimate` is not in CONFIG.
canonical_settings <- function(config, root = here::here()) {
  walk <- function(x) {
    if (inherits(x, "Date")) {
      return(format(x, "%Y-%m-%d"))
    }
    if (is.list(x)) {
      return(lapply(x, walk))
    }
    if (is.character(x)) {
      return(project_relative_path(x, root))
    }
    if (is.numeric(x)) {
      return(as.numeric(x))
    }
    x
  }
  walk(config)
}

settings_json <- function(x) {
  as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(
    x,
    auto_unbox = TRUE,
    digits = NA,
    null = "null",
    na = "null"
  ))
}

settings_fingerprint <- function(config = CONFIG) {
  canon <- canonical_settings(config)
  if (is.null(names(canon)) || any(names(canon) == "")) {
    stop("CONFIG entries must all be named.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  parts <- vapply(
    names(canon),
    function(k) hash_text(settings_json(canon[k])),
    character(1)
  )
  list(hash = hash_text(settings_json(canon)), parts = parts)
}

# An uninstalled package records "absent" rather than stopping: its installation
# state is part of the computational identity.
package_versions <- function(packages) {
  vapply(
    packages,
    function(p) {
      tryCatch(as.character(utils::packageVersion(p)), error = function(e) {
        "absent"
      })
    },
    character(1)
  )
}

package_fingerprint <- function() {
  versions <- c(R = R.version.string, package_versions(COMPUTATIONAL_PACKAGES))
  list(
    hash = hash_text(paste(names(versions), versions, sep = "=")),
    versions = versions
  )
}

quarto_version_string <- function() {
  out <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(system2(
      "quarto",
      "--version",
      stdout = TRUE,
      stderr = TRUE
    )),
    error = function(e) character()
  )
  if (length(out) == 0L || is.na(out[[1L]]) || !nzchar(out[[1L]])) {
    NA_character_
  } else {
    trimws(out[[1L]])
  }
}

display_package_versions <- function() {
  c(package_versions(DISPLAY_PACKAGES), quarto = quarto_version_string())
}

# The hash an input has now: file bytes for a file input, the directory listing for
# the export-zip listing row; a missing or unreadable file hashes to NA.
current_input_hash <- function(input, path) {
  path <- resolve_project_path(path)
  if (identical(input, EXPORT_ZIP_LISTING_INPUT)) {
    return(export_zip_listing_hash(path))
  }
  if (file.exists(path) && !dir.exists(path)) {
    hash_file_content(path)
  } else {
    NA_character_
  }
}

# `inputs`: tibble(input, path, content_hash, generation_id, ...). With `rehash`, the file
# bytes are hashed again now (missing files hash to NA and surface as differences).
input_fingerprint <- function(inputs, rehash = TRUE) {
  if (anyDuplicated(inputs$input) > 0L) {
    stop("Input names must be unique for the fingerprint.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  hashes <- if (rehash) {
    vapply(
      seq_len(nrow(inputs)),
      function(i) current_input_hash(inputs$input[[i]], inputs$path[[i]]),
      character(1)
    )
  } else {
    as.character(inputs$content_hash)
  }
  names(hashes) <- inputs$input
  ordering <- order(names(hashes))
  hashes <- hashes[ordering]
  generation_ids <- stats::setNames(
    as.character(inputs$generation_id),
    inputs$input
  )[names(hashes)]
  list(
    hash = hash_text(paste(names(hashes), hashes, sep = "=")),
    hashes = hashes,
    generation_ids = generation_ids
  )
}

combined_fingerprint <- function(
  inputs_hash,
  code_hash,
  settings_hash,
  packages_hash
) {
  hash_text(c(
    inputs = inputs_hash,
    code = code_hash,
    settings = settings_hash,
    packages = packages_hash
  ))
}

compute_fingerprint <- function(
  inputs,
  rehash = TRUE,
  config = CONFIG,
  qmd_path = report_qmd_path(),
  helper_paths = helper_file_paths()
) {
  inp <- input_fingerprint(inputs, rehash = rehash)
  code <- code_fingerprint(qmd_path, helper_paths)
  settings <- settings_fingerprint(config)
  packages <- package_fingerprint()
  list(
    inputs = inp$hashes,
    inputs_hash = inp$hash,
    generation_ids = inp$generation_ids,
    code = code$hash,
    code_parts = code$parts,
    settings = settings$hash,
    settings_parts = settings$parts,
    packages = packages$hash,
    package_versions = packages$versions,
    combined = combined_fingerprint(
      inp$hash,
      code$hash,
      settings$hash,
      packages$hash
    )
  )
}

differing_names <- function(saved, current) {
  keys <- sort(union(names(saved), names(current)))
  keys[vapply(
    keys,
    function(k) !identical(unname(saved[k]), unname(current[k])),
    logical(1)
  )]
}

# Character vector naming every component that differs (empty when compatible).
fingerprint_differences <- function(saved, current) {
  out <- character()
  for (n in sort(union(names(saved$inputs), names(current$inputs)))) {
    s <- if (n %in% names(saved$inputs)) saved$inputs[[n]] else NA_character_
    now <- if (n %in% names(current$inputs)) {
      current$inputs[[n]]
    } else {
      NA_character_
    }
    if (identical(s, now)) {
      next
    }
    what <- if (is.na(now)) {
      "now missing or unreadable"
    } else if (!n %in% names(saved$inputs)) {
      "absent from the saved bundle"
    } else if (is.na(s)) {
      "unreadable when the bundle was built, now readable"
    } else {
      "content changed"
    }
    out <- c(out, sprintf("input `%s` (%s)", n, what))
  }
  if (!identical(saved$code, current$code)) {
    parts <- differing_names(saved$code_parts, current$code_parts)
    out <- c(
      out,
      sprintf(
        "code (%s)",
        if (length(parts) > 0L) {
          paste(parts, collapse = ", ")
        } else {
          "computational chunks or helper files"
        }
      )
    )
  }
  if (!identical(saved$settings, current$settings)) {
    parts <- differing_names(saved$settings_parts, current$settings_parts)
    out <- c(
      out,
      sprintf(
        "settings (%s)",
        if (length(parts) > 0L) paste(parts, collapse = ", ") else "CONFIG"
      )
    )
  }
  if (!identical(saved$packages, current$packages)) {
    parts <- differing_names(saved$package_versions, current$package_versions)
    detail <- vapply(
      parts,
      function(p) {
        sprintf(
          "%s %s -> %s",
          p,
          saved$package_versions[p] %||% "absent",
          current$package_versions[p] %||% "absent"
        )
      },
      character(1)
    )
    out <- c(
      out,
      sprintf(
        "packages (%s)",
        if (length(detail) > 0L) {
          paste(detail, collapse = ", ")
        } else {
          "computational versions"
        }
      )
    )
  }
  if (length(out) == 0L && !identical(saved$combined, current$combined)) {
    out <- "combined fingerprint"
  }
  out
}

# ---- Sample membership: compact storage --------------------------------------------
#
# Per market: the id dictionary once, each variant's input index, and for every fitted
# key only the rows the estimator REMOVED from its variant input (plus the retained
# count). Retained rows are a subsequence of the variant input, so the input less the
# removed rows reconstructs them; the reconstruction is asserted before saving. When a
# retained index is not such a subsequence the full index is stored instead.

sample_variant_of_key <- function(key) {
  parts <- strsplit(key, "__", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
  if (length(parts) != 4L) {
    stop("Malformed model key: ", key, call. = FALSE)
  }
  if (parts[[4L]] == "profile") {
    stop(
      "Profile key ",
      key,
      " indexes the profile membership, not a scalar variant.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  parts[[2L]]
}

# The input rows a fitted key was estimated from: a scalar variant index for
# scalar keys, every row of the profile panel for profile keys.
sample_input_rows <- function(market_samples, key) {
  if (is_profile_key(key)) {
    return(seq_len(as.integer(market_samples$profile$n_rows %||% 0L)))
  }
  input <- market_samples$variants[[sample_variant_of_key(key)]]
  if (is.null(input)) {
    stop("No variant input sample for ", key, call. = FALSE)
  }
  as.integer(input)
}

# The dictionary a fitted key's row indices refer to.
sample_dictionary <- function(market_samples, key) {
  if (!is_profile_key(key)) {
    return(as.character(market_samples$ids))
  }
  pr <- market_samples$profile
  if (identical(pr$panel, "separate")) as.character(pr$ids) else as.character(market_samples$ids)
}

compress_estimated_rows <- function(retained, input, key) {
  retained <- as.integer(retained)
  if (length(retained) == 0L) {
    return(list(n_retained = 0L))
  }
  if (!all(retained %in% input)) {
    stop(
      "Estimated rows for ",
      key,
      " fall outside the ",
      if (is_profile_key(key)) "profile panel." else "variant input sample.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  removed <- input[!(input %in% retained)]
  if (identical(input[!(input %in% removed)], retained)) {
    list(n_retained = length(retained), removed = removed)
  } else {
    list(n_retained = length(retained), retained = retained)
  }
}

compress_profile_samples <- function(s) {
  pr <- s$profile %||% empty_profile_samples()
  input <- seq_len(as.integer(pr$n_rows %||% 0L))
  estimated <- lapply(names(pr$estimated), function(key) {
    if (!is_profile_key(key)) {
      stop("Non-profile key in the profile membership: ", key, call. = FALSE)
    }
    compress_estimated_rows(pr$estimated[[key]], input, key)
  })
  names(estimated) <- names(pr$estimated)
  list(
    panel = pr$panel,
    ids = if (is.null(pr$ids)) NULL else as.character(pr$ids),
    n_rows = as.integer(pr$n_rows %||% 0L),
    start = pr$start,
    end = pr$end,
    estimated = estimated,
    metadata = pr$metadata
  )
}

compress_market_samples <- function(s) {
  if (length(s$ids) == 0L) {
    return(list(
      ids = character(),
      variants = list(),
      estimated = list(),
      metadata = s$metadata,
      profile = compress_profile_samples(s)
    ))
  }
  estimated <- lapply(names(s$estimated), function(key) {
    if (is_profile_key(key)) {
      stop("Profile key in the scalar membership: ", key, call. = FALSE)
    }
    compress_estimated_rows(s$estimated[[key]], sample_input_rows(s, key), key)
  })
  names(estimated) <- names(s$estimated)
  list(
    ids = as.character(s$ids),
    variants = lapply(s$variants, as.integer),
    estimated = estimated,
    metadata = s$metadata,
    profile = compress_profile_samples(s)
  )
}

compress_samples <- function(samples) lapply(samples, compress_market_samples)

expand_estimated_rows <- function(market_samples, key) {
  e <- if (is_profile_key(key)) {
    market_samples$profile$estimated[[key]]
  } else {
    market_samples$estimated[[key]]
  }
  if (is.null(e) || e$n_retained == 0L) {
    return(integer())
  }
  retained <- if (!is.null(e$retained)) {
    e$retained
  } else {
    input <- sample_input_rows(market_samples, key)
    input[!(input %in% e$removed)]
  }
  if (length(retained) != e$n_retained) {
    stop("Retained rows for ", key, " do not reconstruct.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  retained
}

expand_samples <- function(samples) {
  lapply(samples, function(s) {
    estimated <- lapply(names(s$estimated), function(key) {
      expand_estimated_rows(s, key)
    })
    names(estimated) <- names(s$estimated)
    profile <- s$profile
    profile_estimated <- lapply(names(profile$estimated), function(key) {
      expand_estimated_rows(s, key)
    })
    names(profile_estimated) <- names(profile$estimated)
    profile$estimated <- profile_estimated
    list(
      ids = s$ids,
      variants = s$variants,
      estimated = estimated,
      metadata = s$metadata,
      profile = profile
    )
  })
}

sample_retained_count <- function(market_samples, key) {
  e <- if (is_profile_key(key)) {
    market_samples$profile$estimated[[key]]
  } else {
    market_samples$estimated[[key]]
  }
  if (is.null(e)) 0L else as.integer(e$n_retained)
}

# The transaction ids a fitted key retained, resolved against the right dictionary.
sample_retained_ids <- function(market_samples, key) {
  sample_dictionary(market_samples, key)[expand_estimated_rows(market_samples, key)]
}

assert_samples_roundtrip <- function(samples, compressed) {
  expanded <- expand_samples(compressed)
  for (m in names(samples)) {
    if (!identical(as.character(samples[[m]]$ids), expanded[[m]]$ids)) {
      stop("Sample ids changed in compression for ", m, call. = FALSE)
    }
    for (v in names(samples[[m]]$variants)) {
      if (
        !identical(
          as.integer(samples[[m]]$variants[[v]]),
          expanded[[m]]$variants[[v]]
        )
      ) {
        stop(
          "Variant sample ",
          v,
          " changed in compression for ",
          m,
          call. = FALSE
        )
      }
    }
    for (key in names(samples[[m]]$estimated)) {
      if (
        !identical(
          as.integer(samples[[m]]$estimated[[key]]),
          expanded[[m]]$estimated[[key]]
        )
      ) {
        stop(
          "Estimated rows for ",
          key,
          " do not survive compression.",
          call. = FALSE
        )
      }
    }
    pr <- samples[[m]]$profile %||% empty_profile_samples()
    ex <- expanded[[m]]$profile
    if (
      !identical(pr$panel, ex$panel) ||
        !identical(
          if (is.null(pr$ids)) NULL else as.character(pr$ids),
          ex$ids
        ) ||
        !identical(as.integer(pr$n_rows %||% 0L), ex$n_rows)
    ) {
      stop("Profile membership changed in compression for ", m, call. = FALSE)
    }
    for (key in names(pr$estimated)) {
      if (!identical(as.integer(pr$estimated[[key]]), ex$estimated[[key]])) {
        stop(
          "Profile rows for ",
          key,
          " do not survive compression.",
          call. = FALSE
        )
      }
    }
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

# ---- Bundle assembly and validation ------------------------------------------------

BUNDLE_COMPONENTS <- c(
  "metadata",
  "inputs",
  "readiness",
  "markets",
  "exclusions",
  "observation_diagnostics",
  "site_projection",
  "calendar",
  "article_evidence",
  "article_validation",
  "change_prevalence",
  "exposure_summaries",
  "samples",
  "cells",
  "profiles",
  "residual_support",
  "residual_support_by_year",
  "models",
  "fit_log",
  "fixture_checks",
  "runtime"
)
METADATA_FIELDS <- c(
  "bundle_version",
  "report_id",
  "created_at",
  "r_version",
  "platform",
  "packages",
  "display_packages",
  "fingerprint",
  "status",
  "runtime_seconds",
  "qmd_source"
)
FINGERPRINT_FIELDS <- c("inputs", "code", "settings", "packages", "combined")

market_status_rows <- function(market_data) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(market_data), function(m) {
    md <- market_data[[m]]
    tibble::tibble(
      market = m,
      status = md$status,
      reason = md$reason %||% NA_character_,
      runtime_seconds = as.numeric(md$runtime_seconds %||% NA_real_)
    )
  }))
}

assemble_bundle <- function(
  site_projection,
  article_validation,
  article_evidence,
  attention_calendars,
  input_provenance,
  readiness,
  observation_diagnostics,
  exclusion_ledger,
  variant_ledger,
  market_data,
  cells,
  profiles,
  residual_support,
  residual_support_by_year,
  samples,
  models,
  fit_log,
  fixture_checks,
  runtime,
  fingerprint,
  profile_ledger = new_ledger(),
  qmd_path = report_qmd_path(),
  config = CONFIG
) {
  compressed <- compress_samples(samples)
  assert_samples_roundtrip(samples, compressed)
  calendar <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(attention_calendars), function(m) {
    cal <- attention_calendars[[m]]
    cal$article_reason <- attr(cal, "article_reason") %||% cal$article_reason
    tibble::as_tibble(cal)
  }))
  change_prevalence <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(market_data), function(m) {
    s <- market_data[[m]]$exposure_summary
    if (is.null(s)) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    dplyr::mutate(s$change_prevalence, market = m, .before = 1L)
  }))
  exposure_summaries <- lapply(market_data, function(md) md$exposure_summary)
  spatial_evidence <- lapply(market_data, function(md) md$distance_summary_all)
  inputs <- dplyr::mutate(input_provenance, path = project_relative_path(path))
  projection <- site_projection[setdiff(names(site_projection), "provenance")]
  projection$spatial_evidence <- spatial_evidence
  list(
    metadata = list(
      bundle_version = config$bundle_version,
      report_id = config$report_id,
      created_at = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", tz = "UTC"),
      r_version = R.version.string,
      platform = R.version$platform,
      packages = fingerprint$package_versions,
      display_packages = display_package_versions(),
      fingerprint = fingerprint,
      status = "pending",
      runtime_seconds = runtime$total_seconds,
      peak_memory_note = runtime$peak_memory_note,
      qmd_source = project_relative_path(qmd_path)
    ),
    inputs = inputs,
    readiness = readiness,
    markets = market_status_rows(market_data),
    exclusions = list(
      ledger = exclusion_ledger,
      variants = variant_ledger,
      profile_ledger = profile_ledger
    ),
    observation_diagnostics = observation_diagnostics,
    site_projection = projection,
    calendar = calendar,
    article_evidence = article_evidence,
    article_validation = article_validation,
    change_prevalence = change_prevalence,
    exposure_summaries = exposure_summaries,
    samples = compressed,
    cells = cells,
    profiles = profiles,
    residual_support = residual_support,
    residual_support_by_year = residual_support_by_year,
    models = models,
    fit_log = fit_log,
    fixture_checks = fixture_checks,
    runtime = runtime
  )
}

validate_bundle <- function(bundle, require_complete = TRUE, config = CONFIG) {
  fail <- function(...) {
    stop("Bundle validation failed: ", sprintf(...), call. = FALSE)
  }
  if (!is.list(bundle)) {
    fail("the object is not a list")
  }
  missing <- setdiff(BUNDLE_COMPONENTS, names(bundle))
  if (length(missing) > 0L) {
    fail("missing components: %s", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  }
  md <- bundle$metadata
  missing <- setdiff(METADATA_FIELDS, names(md))
  if (length(missing) > 0L) {
    fail("metadata lacks: %s", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  }
  if (!identical(md$bundle_version, config$bundle_version)) {
    fail(
      "bundle_version `%s` does not match the expected `%s`",
      md$bundle_version,
      config$bundle_version
    )
  }
  if (!identical(md$report_id, config$report_id)) {
    fail("report_id `%s` is not `%s`", md$report_id, config$report_id)
  }
  missing <- setdiff(FINGERPRINT_FIELDS, names(md$fingerprint))
  if (length(missing) > 0L) {
    fail("fingerprint lacks: %s", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  }
  if (require_complete && !identical(md$status, "complete")) {
    fail(
      "metadata status is `%s`, not `complete` (the run did not finish)",
      md$status %||% "NULL"
    )
  }
  expected <- expected_model_keys()
  keys <- bundle$cells$model_key
  describe_keys <- function(keys, expected, what) {
    dup <- unique(keys[duplicated(keys)])
    miss <- setdiff(expected, keys)
    extra <- setdiff(keys, expected)
    if (length(dup) + length(miss) + length(extra) > 0L) {
      fail(
        "%s must carry the %d expected keys exactly once each (duplicated: %s; missing: %s; unexpected: %s)",
        what,
        length(expected),
        paste(c(dup, "none")[1L], collapse = ""),
        paste(c(miss, "none")[1L], collapse = ""),
        paste(c(extra, "none")[1L], collapse = "")
      )
    }
  }
  describe_keys(keys, expected$scalar, "scalar cells")
  describe_keys(names(bundle$profiles), expected$profile, "profiles")
  profile_status <- vapply(
    bundle$profiles,
    function(p) p$status %||% NA_character_,
    character(1)
  )
  bad <- setdiff(unique(c(bundle$cells$status, profile_status)), CELL_STATUSES)
  if (length(bad) > 0L) {
    fail("statuses outside the vocabulary: %s", paste(bad, collapse = ", "))
  }
  no_reason <- bundle$cells$status != "estimated" &
    (is.na(bundle$cells$reason) | bundle$cells$reason == "")
  if (any(no_reason)) {
    fail(
      "non-estimated cells without a reason: %s",
      paste(keys[no_reason], collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  missing <- setdiff(c(expected$scalar, expected$profile), names(bundle$models))
  if (length(missing) > 0L) {
    fail("models lack entries for: %s", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  }
  missing <- setdiff(MARKETS, names(bundle$samples))
  if (length(missing) > 0L) {
    fail("samples lack markets: %s", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  }
  # KTD5: every market carries an explicit profile membership. A separate panel
  # brings its own dictionary; a shared panel points at the scalar dictionary.
  # Distinct memberships cannot be confused because profile keys are never
  # stored beside scalar keys.
  for (m in MARKETS) {
    ms <- bundle$samples[[m]]
    pr <- ms$profile
    if (is.null(pr) || !identical(pr$panel %||% NA_character_, "shared") && !identical(pr$panel %||% NA_character_, "separate")) {
      fail(
        "samples for %s lack the annual-profile membership (profile$panel must be `shared` or `separate`); this bundle predates the separate profile window",
        m
      )
    }
    if (identical(pr$panel, "separate")) {
      if (is.null(pr$ids) || length(pr$ids) != as.integer(pr$n_rows) || anyDuplicated(pr$ids) > 0L) {
        fail("profile dictionary for %s must hold %s unique ids", m, pr$n_rows)
      }
      if (is.na(pr$start) || is.na(pr$end)) {
        fail("separate profile panel for %s lacks its window", m)
      }
    } else if (!is.null(pr$ids)) {
      fail("shared profile panel for %s must not carry its own dictionary", m)
    } else if (length(ms$ids) > 0L && !identical(as.integer(pr$n_rows), length(ms$ids))) {
      fail("shared profile panel for %s must have the scalar dictionary size", m)
    }
    misplaced <- c(
      names(ms$estimated)[vapply(names(ms$estimated), is_profile_key, logical(1))],
      names(pr$estimated)[!vapply(names(pr$estimated), is_profile_key, logical(1))]
    )
    if (length(misplaced) > 0L) {
      fail("sample membership for %s stores keys in the wrong dictionary: %s", m, paste(misplaced, collapse = ", "))
    }
  }
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(bundle$cells))) {
    cell <- bundle$cells[i, ]
    retained <- sample_retained_count(
      bundle$samples[[cell$market]],
      cell$model_key
    )
    model <- bundle$models[[cell$model_key]]
    if (cell$status %in% ESTIMATED_STATUSES) {
      if (is.null(model)) {
        fail("estimated cell %s has no model", cell$model_key)
      }
      if (!isTRUE(model$nobs == cell$nobs)) {
        fail(
          "model nobs %s differs from the cell nobs %s for %s",
          model$nobs,
          cell$nobs,
          cell$model_key
        )
      }
    }
    if (!is.na(cell$nobs) && !isTRUE(retained == cell$nobs)) {
      fail(
        "retained sample rows (%s) do not reconcile with nobs (%s) for %s",
        retained,
        cell$nobs,
        cell$model_key
      )
    }
    if (is.na(cell$nobs) && retained != 0L) {
      fail("cell %s has no nobs but %s retained rows", cell$model_key, retained)
    }
  }
  for (key in names(bundle$profiles)) {
    p <- bundle$profiles[[key]]
    retained <- sample_retained_count(bundle$samples[[p$market]], key)
    if (p$status %in% ESTIMATED_STATUSES) {
      model <- bundle$models[[key]]
      if (is.null(model) || !isTRUE(model$nobs == p$nobs)) {
        fail("profile %s nobs does not reconcile with its model", key)
      }
      if (!isTRUE(retained == p$nobs)) {
        fail(
          "profile %s retained rows (%s) do not reconcile with nobs (%s)",
          key,
          retained,
          p$nobs
        )
      }
    } else if (retained != 0L) {
      fail("profile %s is %s but has retained rows", key, p$status)
    }
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

complete_bundle <- function(bundle) {
  bundle$metadata$status <- "pending"
  validate_bundle(bundle, require_complete = FALSE)
  bundle$metadata$status <- "complete"
  bundle
}

# ---- Atomic save and guarded load --------------------------------------------------

read_bundle_file <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    stop(
      "No saved results bundle at ",
      project_relative_path(path),
      ". Build it with `",
      render_command(TRUE),
      "` (the default `reestimate: true` also builds it).",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  bundle <- tryCatch(readRDS(path), error = function(e) {
    stop(
      "The saved results bundle at ",
      project_relative_path(path),
      " could not be read (",
      conditionMessage(e),
      "); it is partial or corrupted. Regenerate it with `",
      render_command(TRUE),
      "`.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  })
  bundle
}

# Stage in the destination directory, then rename into place. `write(tmp)` produces
# the staged file; any failure leaves the previous file untouched and removes the
# staged one.
atomic_write <- function(path, write, fileext = ".tmp") {
  dir.create(dirname(path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  tmp <- tempfile(
    pattern = paste0(".", basename(path), "-"),
    tmpdir = dirname(path),
    fileext = fileext
  )
  on.exit(unlink(tmp), add = TRUE)
  write(tmp)
  if (!file.rename(tmp, path)) {
    stop("Failed to write ", path, call. = FALSE)
  }
  invisible(path)
}

# Preflight for the estimation path: every output directory must accept a probe
# file before the (long) run starts. R signals "cannot open file" as a warning
# before the error, so a warning counts as failure.
assert_output_dirs_writable <- function(dirs) {
  for (d in unlist(dirs, use.names = FALSE)) {
    dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    probe <- tempfile(pattern = ".write-probe-", tmpdir = d)
    ok <- tryCatch(
      {
        writeLines("probe", probe)
        TRUE
      },
      warning = function(w) FALSE,
      error = function(e) FALSE
    )
    unlink(probe)
    if (!ok) {
      stop(
        "Output directory is not writable: ",
        d,
        " (check that output/ resolves to a mounted, writable location before estimating).",
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

save_bundle_atomic <- function(bundle, path, writer = saveRDS) {
  validate_bundle(bundle, require_complete = TRUE)
  atomic_write(path, function(tmp) {
    writer(bundle, tmp)
    reread <- tryCatch(readRDS(tmp), error = function(e) {
      stop(
        "Staged bundle could not be re-read (",
        conditionMessage(e),
        "); the previous bundle is untouched.",
        call. = FALSE
      )
    })
    validate_bundle(reread, require_complete = TRUE)
    if (
      !identical(reread$cells, bundle$cells) ||
        !identical(
          reread$metadata$fingerprint$combined,
          bundle$metadata$fingerprint$combined
        )
    ) {
      stop(
        "Staged bundle does not reproduce the in-memory cells; the previous bundle is untouched.",
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
  })
}

# Every input name the current configuration consumes: the three files of each
# market, the crosswalk, the two article files, the export-zip listing and one row
# per export zip present now. A bundle must name them all before its own input
# table can be trusted to drive the re-hash (a blocked market or an added zip
# would otherwise escape the gate).
expected_input_names <- function(config = CONFIG, markets = MARKETS) {
  c(
    unname(unlist(lapply(markets, market_input_names))),
    "site_group_crosswalk",
    "search1_monthly",
    "search1_articles",
    EXPORT_ZIP_LISTING_INPUT,
    export_zip_input_name(list_export_zips(config$article_zip_dir))
  )
}

# `expected_fingerprint` is a fingerprint list or a function of the bundle's inputs table
# that computes the current one (so the bundle itself names the files to re-hash).
# `expected_inputs` are the input names the bundle must carry for that re-hash to
# cover every current dependency.
load_bundle <- function(
  path,
  expected_fingerprint,
  expected_inputs = expected_input_names()
) {
  bundle <- read_bundle_file(path)
  tryCatch(
    validate_bundle(bundle, require_complete = TRUE),
    error = function(e) {
      stop(
        conditionMessage(e),
        ". The saved bundle at ",
        project_relative_path(path),
        " cannot be presented as current results; regenerate it with `",
        render_command(TRUE),
        "`.",
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
  )
  missing_inputs <- setdiff(expected_inputs, bundle$inputs$input)
  if (length(missing_inputs) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "The saved results bundle (created ",
      bundle$metadata$created_at,
      ") does not name input(s) the current ",
      "configuration consumes: ",
      paste(missing_inputs, collapse = ", "),
      ". Their content cannot be verified ",
      "against the bundle, so the whole model grid needs re-estimation: run `",
      render_command(TRUE),
      "`.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  expected <- if (is.function(expected_fingerprint)) {
    expected_fingerprint(bundle$inputs)
  } else {
    expected_fingerprint
  }
  differences <- fingerprint_differences(bundle$metadata$fingerprint, expected)
  if (length(differences) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "The saved results bundle (created ",
      bundle$metadata$created_at,
      ") is stale. Components that differ from the current render: ",
      paste(differences, collapse = "; "),
      ". Every model cell depends on these, so the whole model grid needs re-estimation: run `",
      render_command(TRUE),
      "`.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  bundle
}

# ---- Artifact export (estimation path only) -----------------------------------------

write_csv_atomic <- function(df, path) {
  atomic_write(path, function(tmp) {
    utils::write.csv(as.data.frame(df), tmp, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
  })
}

write_lines_atomic <- function(lines, path) {
  atomic_write(path, function(tmp) writeLines(lines, tmp))
}

save_figure_pdf <- function(plot, path, width_cm, height_cm) {
  device <- if (isTRUE(capabilities("cairo"))) {
    grDevices::cairo_pdf
  } else {
    grDevices::pdf
  }
  atomic_write(
    path,
    function(tmp) {
      ggplot2::ggsave(
        tmp,
        plot = plot,
        device = device,
        width = width_cm,
        height = height_cm,
        units = "cm"
      )
    },
    fileext = ".pdf"
  )
}

sample_support_rows <- function(samples) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(samples), function(m) {
    meta <- samples[[m]]$metadata
    if (length(meta) == 0L) {
      return(tibble::tibble(
        market = m,
        variant = NA_character_,
        n_rows = NA_real_,
        n_properties = NA_real_
      ))
    }
    rows <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(meta), function(v) {
      tibble::tibble(
        market = m,
        variant = v,
        n_rows = as.numeric(meta[[v]]$n_rows),
        n_properties = as.numeric(meta[[v]]$n_properties)
      )
    }))
    pr <- samples[[m]]$profile
    if (!is.null(pr) && length(pr$metadata) > 0L) {
      rows <- dplyr::bind_rows(
        rows,
        tibble::tibble(
          market = m,
          variant = paste0("annual_profile_", pr$panel),
          n_rows = as.numeric(pr$metadata$n_rows),
          n_properties = as.numeric(pr$metadata$n_properties)
        )
      )
    }
    rows
  }))
}

FIGURE_EXPORTS <- list(
  coefficient_comparison = list(
    file = "coefficient_comparison.pdf",
    width_cm = 14.5,
    height_cm = 10
  ),
  annual_profiles = list(
    file = "annual_profiles.pdf",

  ),
  attention_history = list(
    file = "attention_history_sales.pdf",
    width_cm = 14.5,

  )
)

# The CSV tables exported from a bundle, keyed by file name; the export and the
# cached render's coherence check share this list.
artifact_tables <- function(bundle) {
  list(
    "cells.csv" = bundle$cells,
    "profile_coefficients.csv" = profile_rows(bundle$profiles),
    "joint_tests.csv" = joint_test_rows(bundle$profiles),
    "residual_support.csv" = bundle$residual_support,
    "residual_support_by_year.csv" = bundle$residual_support_by_year,
    "exclusion_ledger.csv" = bundle$exclusions$ledger,
    "variant_ledger.csv" = bundle$exclusions$variants,
    "sample_support.csv" = sample_support_rows(bundle$samples),
    "readiness_summary.csv" = readiness_status_rows(bundle$readiness),
    "calendar.csv" = bundle$calendar,
    "inputs.csv" = bundle$inputs
  )
}

RUN_FINGERPRINT_FILE <- "run_fingerprint.txt"
RUN_LOG_FILE <- "run_log.txt"

export_artifacts <- function(bundle, config = CONFIG) {
  fingerprint <- bundle$metadata$fingerprint$combined
  stamp <- function(df) {
    dplyr::mutate(tibble::as_tibble(df), fingerprint = fingerprint)
  }
  tables <- artifact_tables(bundle)
  written <- vapply(
    names(tables),
    function(file) {
      write_csv_atomic(
        stamp(tables[[file]]),
        file.path(config$output$tables, file)
      )
    },
    character(1),
    USE.NAMES = FALSE
  )
  figures <- config$output$figures
  spec <- FIGURE_EXPORTS$coefficient_comparison
  written <- c(
    written,
    save_figure_pdf(
      plot_coefficients(
        bundle$cells,
        base_size = 8,
        point_size = 1.6,
        text_size = 2.2
      ),
      file.path(figures, spec$file),
      spec$width_cm,
      spec$height_cm
    )
  )
  profile_plot <- plot_profiles(
    bundle$profiles,
    base_size = 8,
    point_size = 1.5
  )
  if (!is.null(profile_plot)) {
    spec <- FIGURE_EXPORTS$annual_profiles
    written <- c(
      written,
      save_figure_pdf(
        profile_plot,
        file.path(figures, spec$file),
        spec$width_cm,
        spec$height_cm
      )
    )
  }
  history <- attention_history_display(
    bundle$calendar[bundle$calendar$market == "sales", ],
    base_size = 8
  )
  if (!is.null(history$plot)) {
    spec <- FIGURE_EXPORTS$attention_history
    written <- c(
      written,
      save_figure_pdf(
        history$plot,
        file.path(figures, spec$file),
        spec$width_cm,
        spec$height_cm
      )
    )
  }
  written <- c(
    written,
    write_lines_atomic(
      c(
        sprintf("run_fingerprint: %s", fingerprint),
        sprintf("created_at: %s", bundle$metadata$created_at),
        sprintf(
          "figures: %s",
          paste(basename(written[grepl("\\.pdf$", written)]), collapse = ", ")
        )
      ),
      file.path(figures, RUN_FINGERPRINT_FILE)
    )
  )
  written <- c(
    written,
    write_lines_atomic(
      run_log_lines(bundle),
      file.path(config$output$log, RUN_LOG_FILE)
    )
  )
  invisible(written)
}

# Whether every exported artifact carries the bundle's combined fingerprint: each
# CSV's `fingerprint` column, the figure fingerprint file (and the PDFs it lists)
# and the run log. Returns list(current, reasons).
artifact_fingerprint_status <- function(bundle, config = CONFIG) {
  fingerprint <- bundle$metadata$fingerprint$combined
  reasons <- character()
  for (file in names(artifact_tables(bundle))) {
    path <- file.path(config$output$tables, file)
    if (!file.exists(path)) {
      reasons <- c(reasons, paste0(file, " missing"))
      next
    }
    df <- tryCatch(
      utils::read.csv(path, colClasses = "character"),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (
      is.null(df) ||
        !"fingerprint" %in% names(df) ||
        !all(df$fingerprint == fingerprint)
    ) {
      reasons <- c(reasons, paste0(file, " carries a different fingerprint"))
    }
  }
  fp_path <- file.path(config$output$figures, RUN_FINGERPRINT_FILE)
  fp_lines <- if (file.exists(fp_path)) {
    readLines(fp_path, warn = FALSE)
  } else {
    character()
  }
  if (!sprintf("run_fingerprint: %s", fingerprint) %in% fp_lines) {
    reasons <- c(
      reasons,
      paste0(
        RUN_FINGERPRINT_FILE,
        " missing or carries a different fingerprint"
      )
    )
  }
  figures_line <- grep("^figures: ", fp_lines, value = TRUE)
  listed <- if (length(figures_line) == 1L) {
    trimws(strsplit(sub("^figures: ", "", figures_line), ",")[[1L]])
  } else {
    character()
  }
  absent <- listed[
    nzchar(listed) & !file.exists(file.path(config$output$figures, listed))
  ]
  if (length(absent) > 0L) {
    reasons <- c(
      reasons,
      paste0("figure(s) missing: ", paste(absent, collapse = ", "))
    )
  }
  log_path <- file.path(config$output$log, RUN_LOG_FILE)
  log_lines <- if (file.exists(log_path)) {
    readLines(log_path, warn = FALSE)
  } else {
    character()
  }
  if (!sprintf("  combined: %s", fingerprint) %in% log_lines) {
    reasons <- c(
      reasons,
      paste0(RUN_LOG_FILE, " missing or carries a different fingerprint")
    )
  }
  list(current = length(reasons) == 0L, reasons = reasons)
}

# The bundle is authoritative: when the artifact set on disk is missing, partial or
# stamped with another fingerprint, every artifact is re-exported from the loaded
# bundle (each writer is atomic). Returns list(regenerated, reason).
ensure_artifacts_current <- function(bundle, config = CONFIG) {
  before <- artifact_fingerprint_status(bundle, config)
  if (before$current) {
    return(list(regenerated = FALSE, reason = NA_character_))
  }
  export_artifacts(bundle, config)
  after <- artifact_fingerprint_status(bundle, config)
  if (!after$current) {
    stop(
      "Artifacts are still incoherent after re-export: ",
      paste(after$reasons, collapse = "; "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  list(regenerated = TRUE, reason = paste(before$reasons, collapse = "; "))
}

run_log_lines <- function(bundle) {
  md <- bundle$metadata
  fp <- md$fingerprint
  fit <- as.data.frame(bundle$fit_log)
  c(
    sprintf("report_id: %s", md$report_id),
    sprintf("bundle_version: %s", md$bundle_version),
    sprintf("status: %s", md$status),
    sprintf("created_at: %s", md$created_at),
    sprintf("qmd_source: %s", md$qmd_source),
    sprintf("r_version: %s", md$r_version),
    sprintf("platform: %s", md$platform),
    sprintf("runtime_seconds: %.1f", md$runtime_seconds),
    sprintf("peak_memory_note: %s", md$peak_memory_note),
    "",
    "fingerprint:",
    sprintf("  combined: %s", fp$combined),
    sprintf("  inputs: %s", fp$inputs_hash),
    sprintf("  code: %s", fp$code),
    sprintf("  settings: %s", fp$settings),
    sprintf("  packages: %s", fp$packages),
    "",
    "input content hashes (xxhash64):",
    sprintf("  %s: %s", names(fp$inputs), fp$inputs),
    "",
    "computational packages:",
    sprintf("  %s: %s", names(md$packages), md$packages),
    "",
    "display packages:",
    sprintf("  %s: %s", names(md$display_packages), md$display_packages),
    "",
    "market runtimes (seconds):",
    sprintf(
      "  %s: %s (%.1f s)",
      bundle$markets$market,
      bundle$markets$status,
      bundle$markets$runtime_seconds
    ),
    "",
    "fit log:",
    utils::capture.output(print(fit, row.names = FALSE))
  )
}

#| label: helpers-display

# Display helpers: labels, plot builders, and table shapers shared by the report body

# readiness_status_rows() and the plot builders here, so a change to their shape

options(knitr.kable.NA = "") # empty cells for missing values in HTML tables

# Emit an HTML table from inside loops/conditionals (not auto-printed).

label_cells <- function(cells) {

    cells,
    market_label = factor(MARKET_LABELS[market], levels = MARKET_LABELS),

percent_change <- function(beta) 100 * (exp(beta) - 1)

format_p <- function(p) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(p),
    NA_character_,
    ifelse(p < 0.001, "< 0.001", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3))
  )
}

format_ci <- function(low, high, digits = 4) {

    is.na(low),

profile_rows <- function(profiles) {
  rows <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(profiles, function(p) {
    if (nrow(p$coefficients) == 0L) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    dplyr::mutate(
      p$coefficients,
      model_key = p$model_key,
      market = p$market,
      fe = p$fe,
      status = p$status,
      .before = 1L
    )
  }))
  if (nrow(rows) == 0L) {
    rows <- tibble::tibble(
      model_key = character(),
      market = character(),
      fe = character(),
      status = character(),
      year = integer(),
      term = character(),
      estimate = numeric(),
      std_error = numeric(),
      t_df = numeric(),
      conf_low = numeric(),
      conf_high = numeric(),
      p_value = numeric(),
      available = logical()
    )
  }
  rows
}

joint_test_rows <- function(profiles) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(profiles, function(p) {
    j <- p$joint_test
    tibble::tibble(
      model_key = p$model_key,
      market = p$market,
      fe = p$fe,
      profile_status = p$status,
      profile_reason = p$reason,
      joint_status = j$status,
      statistic = j$statistic,
      df1 = j$df1,
      df2 = j$df2,
      p_value = j$p_value,
      joint_reason = j$reason,
      nobs = p$nobs,
      n_properties = p$n_properties,
      n_clusters = p$n_clusters,
      n_removed_by_estimator = p$n_removed_by_estimator
    )
  }))
}

# Every cell stays in the plot data: `supported` rows draw points, `unsupported` rows draw
# their status as a label at zero so no planned comparison silently disappears.
coefficient_plot_data <- function(cells) {
  labelled <- label_cells(cells)
  supported <- labelled[!is.na(labelled$estimate), ]
  unsupported <- labelled[is.na(labelled$estimate), ]
  unsupported$label <- paste0(
    FE_SHORT_LABELS[unsupported$fe],
    ": ",
    unsupported$status
  )
  list(supported = supported, unsupported = unsupported)
}

plot_coefficients <- function(
  cells,
  base_size = 11,

) {
  parts <- coefficient_plot_data(cells)

    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_errorbar(
      ggplot2::aes(xmin = conf_low, xmax = conf_high),
      width = 0.25,
      position = dodge,
      orientation = "y"
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size = point_size, position = dodge) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +

    ) +

    ggplot2::facet_grid(market_label ~ attention_label, scales = "free_x") +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x = "Coefficient on Near x attention (log points)",

    ) +

}

# Year ticks for one panel: every fifth year over a long history, every second
# year over a short one, always including the reference year (and dropping a
# neighbour that would collide with it at manuscript size).
profile_year_breaks <- function(reference_year) {
  function(limits) {
    years <- seq(ceiling(limits[[1L]]), floor(limits[[2L]]))
    by <- if (length(years) > 16L) 5L else 2L
    breaks <- years[years %% by == 0L]
    sort(unique(c(breaks[abs(breaks - reference_year) > 1], reference_year)))
  }
}

# Blank rows that fix each market's year domain (its actual supported history
# plus the reference year) and its vertical bounds across both specifications,
# so the two panels of a market share axes while markets keep their own.
profile_panel_domain <- function(points, reference_year, limits = NULL) {
  domain <- points |>
    dplyr::group_by(market_label) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      start = min(c(year, reference_year)),
      end = max(c(year, reference_year)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(c(start, end), values_to = "year")
  bounds <- limits %||% (points |>
    dplyr::group_by(market_label) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      lower = min(c(0, estimate, conf_low), na.rm = TRUE),
      upper = max(c(0, estimate, conf_high), na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(c(lower, upper), values_to = "bound"))
  domain |>
    dplyr::inner_join(
      bounds[, c("market_label", "bound")],
      by = "market_label",
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) |>
    dplyr::cross_join(tibble::tibble(fe_label = factor(FE_LABELS, levels = FE_LABELS)))
}

profile_facets <- function() {
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(
    ggplot2::vars(market_label, fe_label),
    nrow = length(MARKET_LABELS),
    scales = "free",
    labeller = ggplot2::labeller(.multi_line = FALSE)
  )
}

plot_profiles <- function(
  profiles,
  base_size = 11,
  point_size = 2.2,
  reference_year = CONFIG$profile_reference_year,
  event_month = CONFIG$event_month
) {
  points <- profile_rows(profiles)
  if (nrow(points) == 0L) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  points <- dplyr::mutate(
    points,
    market_label = factor(MARKET_LABELS[market], levels = MARKET_LABELS),
    fe_label = factor(FE_LABELS[fe], levels = FE_LABELS)
  )
  reference <- dplyr::distinct(points, market_label, fe_label) |>
    dplyr::mutate(year = reference_year, estimate = 0)
  event_position <- lubridate::year(event_month) +
    (lubridate::month(event_month) - 1) / 12
  ggplot2::ggplot(
    points,
    ggplot2::aes(x = year, y = estimate, colour = fe_label)
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_blank(
      data = profile_panel_domain(points, reference_year),
      ggplot2::aes(x = year, y = bound),
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      colour = "grey55"
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = event_position, colour = "grey40") +
    ggplot2::geom_errorbar(
      ggplot2::aes(ymin = conf_low, ymax = conf_high),
      width = 0.3
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size = point_size) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      data = reference,
      shape = 21,
      fill = "white",
      size = point_size + 0.4
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(
      values = c("#2c5f8a", "#b03a2e"),
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    profile_facets() +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = profile_year_breaks(reference_year),
      expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = 0.02)
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = sprintf(
        "Near x year coefficient relative to %d (log points)",
        reference_year
      )
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(4, 8, 4, 4)
    )
}

# A validated attention plot, or NULL with the recorded diagnosis when article cells are blocked.
attention_history_display <- function(calendar, base_size = 11) {
  if (nrow(calendar) > 0L && all(calendar$article_status == "valid")) {
    plot <- plot_attention_history(calendar) +
      ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = base_size)
    return(list(plot = plot, message = NA_character_))
  }
  reason <- attr(calendar, "article_reason") %||%
    calendar$article_reason[!is.na(calendar$article_reason)][1L]
  list(
    plot = NULL,
    message = paste0(
      "Attention history not plotted: article cells are blocked (",
      reason %||% "no reason recorded",
      ")."
    )
  )
}

readiness_status_rows <- function(readiness) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(readiness), function(m) {
    r <- readiness[[m]]
    tibble::tibble(
      market = m,
      status = r$status,
      blocked_stage = r$blocked_stage %||% NA_character_,
      reason = r$reason %||% NA_character_,
      rows_pre_band = r$n_rows_pre_band %||% NA_real_,
      groups_pre_band = r$n_groups_pre_band %||% NA_real_,
      rows_repeat_eligible_pre_band = r$n_rows_repeat_eligible_pre_band %||%
        NA_real_,
      groups_repeat_eligible_pre_band = r$n_groups_repeat_eligible_pre_band %||%
        NA_real_,
      runtime_seconds = round(r$runtime_seconds %||% NA_real_, 1),
      peak_memory_mb = round(r$peak_memory_mb %||% NA_real_)
    )
  }))
}

# Headline cells only: both markets x both FE structures x both attention measures.

format_seconds <- function(seconds) {
  vapply(
    as.numeric(seconds),
    function(s) {
      if (is.na(s)) {
        "unknown"
      } else if (s < 90) {
        sprintf("%.0f s", s)
      } else {
        sprintf("%.1f min", s / 60)
      }
    },
    character(1)
  )
}

#| label: helpers-profile-references
#| include: false

# Display contrasts only: the saved 2019 models and joint tests remain unchanged.
profile_reference_rows <- function(profiles, reference_year) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(profiles, function(p) {
    original <- p$coefficients
    years <- sort(unique(c(original$year, p$reference_year, reference_year)))
    coefficient <- function(year) {
      if (year == p$reference_year) return(0)
      row <- original[original$year == year, ]
      if (nrow(row) != 1L || !isTRUE(row$available)) return(NA_real_)
      row$estimate
    }
    baseline <- coefficient(reference_year)
    baseline_available <- nrow(original) > 0L && is.finite(baseline)
    dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(years, function(year) {
      estimate <- if (baseline_available) coefficient(year) - baseline else NA_real_
      se <- low <- high <- NA_real_
      # The omitted original year has zero variance and covariance. All other
      # contrasts use Var(b_y - b_ref), including the cross-covariance term.
      if (is.finite(estimate) && year != reference_year && !is.null(p$vcov)) {
        weights <- c(1, -1)
        contrast_years <- c(year, reference_year)
        keep <- contrast_years != p$reference_year
        terms <- profile_term(contrast_years[keep])
        if (all(terms %in% rownames(p$vcov)) && all(terms %in% colnames(p$vcov))) {
          V <- p$vcov[terms, terms, drop = FALSE]
          variance <- as.numeric(crossprod(weights[keep], V %*% weights[keep]))
          if (is.finite(variance) && variance >= 0) se <- sqrt(variance)
        }
        if (is.finite(se) && length(p$t_df) == 1L && is.finite(p$t_df) && p$t_df >= 1) {
          margin <- stats::qt(0.975, p$t_df) * se
          low <- estimate - margin
          high <- estimate + margin
        }
      }
      tibble::tibble(
        model_key = p$model_key,
        market = p$market,
        fe = p$fe,
        reference_year = reference_year,
        year = year,
        estimate = estimate,
        std_error = se,
        conf_low = low,
        conf_high = high,
        is_reference = year == reference_year,
        baseline_available = baseline_available
      )
    }))
  })) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      market_label = factor(MARKET_LABELS[market], levels = MARKET_LABELS),
      fe_label = factor(FE_LABELS[fe], levels = FE_LABELS)
    )
}

profile_reference_limits <- function(rows) {
  # Share each market's scale across both specifications and both reference views.
  rows |>
    dplyr::group_by(market_label) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      lower = min(c(0, estimate, conf_low), na.rm = TRUE),
      upper = max(c(0, estimate, conf_high), na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(c(lower, upper), values_to = "bound")
}

plot_profile_reference <- function(rows, reference_year, limits, base_size = 11) {
  points <- dplyr::filter(rows, .data$reference_year == .env$reference_year)
  # Year domains come from every reference view of the same profiles, so both
  # alternative figures share each market's horizontal and vertical scales.
  domain <- profile_panel_domain(
    dplyr::mutate(rows, year = as.integer(year)),
    reference_year,
    limits
  )
  unavailable <- points |>
    dplyr::filter(!baseline_available) |>
    dplyr::distinct(market_label, fe_label)
  ggplot2::ggplot(points, ggplot2::aes(year, estimate, colour = fe_label)) +
    ggplot2::geom_blank(
      data = domain, ggplot2::aes(x = year, y = bound), inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey55") +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(
      xintercept = lubridate::year(CONFIG$event_month) +
        (lubridate::month(CONFIG$event_month) - 1) / 12,
      colour = "grey40"
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_errorbar(
      ggplot2::aes(ymin = conf_low, ymax = conf_high), width = 0.3, na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      data = dplyr::filter(points, !is_reference), size = 2, na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      data = dplyr::filter(points, is_reference),
      shape = 21, fill = "white", size = 2.4, na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    (if (nrow(unavailable) > 0L) ggplot2::geom_text(
      data = unavailable,
      ggplot2::aes(x = 2019, y = 0),
      label = sprintf("%d contrast unavailable", reference_year),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "grey30", size = 3
    )) +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = c("#2c5f8a", "#b03a2e"), drop = FALSE) +
    profile_facets() +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = profile_year_breaks(reference_year),
      expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = 0.02)
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = sprintf("Near x year contrast relative to %d (log points)", reference_year)
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(4, 8, 4, 4)
    )
}

```{r}
#| label: fixture-checks
#| include: false

assert_true <- function(condition, message) {
  if (!isTRUE(condition)) stop(message, call. = FALSE)
}

assert_error_matching <- function(expr, pattern, message) {
  err <- tryCatch(
    {
      force(expr)
      NULL
    },
    error = identity
  )
  assert_true(
    inherits(err, "error") && grepl(pattern, conditionMessage(err)),
    paste0(
      message,
      if (inherits(err, "error")) {
        paste0("\nGot error: ", conditionMessage(err))
      } else {
        "\nNo error was raised."
      }
    )
  )
  invisible(err)
}

# Every scenario must end by returning TRUE (a silently truncated scenario is a
# failure); a duplicated scenario name would run one definition twice, so it is refused.
run_fixture_checks <- function(checks) {
  if (
    length(checks) == 0L || any(lengths(checks) == 0L) || is.null(names(checks))
  ) {
    stop("The fixture suite has no fixture checks to run.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  rows <- list()
  for (unit in names(checks)) {
    scenarios <- names(checks[[unit]])
    dup <- unique(scenarios[duplicated(scenarios)])
    if (is.null(scenarios) || any(!nzchar(scenarios)) || length(dup) > 0L) {
      stop(
        "Unnamed or duplicated scenario name(s) in ",
        unit,
        ": ",
        paste(dup, collapse = ", "),
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
    for (scenario in scenarios) {
      outcome <- tryCatch(
        {
          result <- checks[[unit]][[scenario]]()
          if (!isTRUE(result)) {
            stop("scenario did not return TRUE", call. = FALSE)
          }
          list(passed = TRUE, message = "")
        },
        error = function(e) list(passed = FALSE, message = conditionMessage(e))
      )
      rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- tibble::tibble(
        unit = unit,
        scenario = scenario,
        passed = outcome$passed,
        message = outcome$message
      )
    }
  }
  results <- dplyr::bind_rows(rows)
  failed <- results[!results$passed, ]
  if (nrow(failed) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "Fixture checks failed:\n",
      paste(
        sprintf("  %s / %s: %s", failed$unit, failed$scenario, failed$message),
        collapse = "\n"
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  results
}

fixture_mapping_from_history <- function(
  history,
  cfg,
  exclude_ids = character()
) {
  keyed <- history[!house_id %chin% exclude_ids]
  key <- build_address_key(keyed, repeat_key_config(cfg))
  keyed <- keyed[!is.na(key)]
  key <- key[!is.na(key)]
  mapping <- data.table::data.table(
    house_id = keyed$house_id,
    repeat_id = hash_serialized_values(key)
  )
  mapping[, repeat_count := as.integer(.N), by = repeat_id]
  mapping[]
}

    repeat_manifest_version = "1",

    excluded_count = as.character(excluded_count),
    same_day_excluded_count = as.character(same_day_count),
    run_timestamp = "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    input_mtime = "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    largest_group_size = "3"
  )
}

# A 1995-2024 history for the separate profile window: the base fixture, one
# filler single per requested year (every year must be observed), property P
# sold in 1998 and 2023 only (AE1), and property Q sold in 1998 (type D), 2015
# and 2023 (type T), so its type change is confined to 1998 (AE2).
fixture_cross_window_history <- function() {
  base <- fixture_sales_history()
  years <- 1995:2024
  filler <- data.table::data.table(
    house_id = sprintf("f%02d", seq_along(years)),
    postcode = sprintf("ZZ%d 1AA", seq_along(years)),
    paon = as.character(100L + seq_along(years)),

    country = "England",
    easting = 400000,
    northing = 300000,

  extra <- data.table::data.table(
    house_id = c("h17", "h18", "h19", "h20", "h21"),
    postcode = c("AB1 2CL", "AB1 2CL", "AB1 2CM", "AB1 2CM", "AB1 2CM"),
    paon = c("9", "9", "10", "10", "10"),
    saon = NA_character_,

    date_of_transfer = as.Date(c(
      "1998-05-05", "2023-05-05", "1998-06-06", "2015-06-06", "2023-06-06"
    )),
    price = c(60000, 400000, 70000, 250000, 420000),

fixture_cross_window_cfg <- function() {
  cfg <- fixture_sales_cfg(start = "2014-01-01", end = "2024-12-31")
  cfg$profile_start <- as.Date("1995-01-01")
  cfg
}

fixture_site_at <- function(e) {
  tibble::tibble(site_id = 1L, easting = e, northing = 300000, usable = TRUE)
}

FIXTURE_CHECKS <- list()
FIXTURE_CHECKS$u1 <- list(
  ae1_ae2_cross_window_histories_keep_the_scalar_sample = function() {
    cfg <- fixture_cross_window_cfg()
    history <- fixture_cross_window_history()
    mapping <- fixture_mapping_from_history(history, cfg)
    shared_cfg <- cfg
    shared_cfg$profile_start <- shared_cfg$start
    assert_true(
      separate_profile_window(cfg) && !separate_profile_window(shared_cfg),
      "a wider profile_start marks a separate profile window"
    )
    scalar <- apply_sample_contract(history, mapping, "sales", cfg)
    profile <- apply_sample_contract(history, mapping, "sales", profile_config(cfg))
    assert_true(
      scalar$ledger$note[[1L]] == "2014-01-01 to 2024-12-31 inclusive" &&
        profile$ledger$note[[1L]] == "1995-01-01 to 2024-12-31 inclusive",
      "each panel records its own requested window"
    )
    assert_true(
      min(profile$panel$year) == 1995L && min(scalar$panel$year) == 2014L,
      "the profile panel reaches 1995; the scalar panel starts in 2014"
    )
    s_out <- apply_exposure(scalar$panel, fixture_site_at(400000), scalar$ledger, "sales", cfg)
    p_out <- apply_exposure(profile$panel, fixture_site_at(400000), profile$ledger, "sales", profile_config(cfg))
    # AE1: P (h17 1998, h18 2023) is a profile repeat and a scalar single.
    assert_true(
      all(c("h17", "h18") %in% p_out$panel$id) && !any(c("h17", "h18") %in% s_out$panel$id),
      "AE1: a 1998/2023 property enters the profile sample only"
    )
    # AE2: Q contributes three dates to the profiles and two to the scalar panel;
    # the 1998 type change does not flag the scalar property.
    assert_true(
      all(c("h19", "h20", "h21") %in% p_out$panel$id) &&
        all(c("h20", "h21") %in% s_out$panel$id) && !"h19" %in% s_out$panel$id,
      "AE2: three profile dates, two scalar dates"
    )
    assert_true(
      !any(s_out$panel[id %in% c("h20", "h21"), any_change]) &&
        all(p_out$panel[id %in% c("h19", "h20", "h21"), any_change]),
      "AE2: the type change confined to 1998 flags the profile property, not the scalar one"
    )
    # R2: the scalar panel is what a 2014-2024-only history would give.
    recent <- history[lubridate::year(date_of_transfer) >= 2014L]
    recent_mapping <- fixture_mapping_from_history(recent, cfg)
    recent_out <- apply_exposure(
      apply_sample_contract(recent, recent_mapping, "sales", cfg)$panel,
      fixture_site_at(400000), new_ledger(), "sales", cfg
    )
    assert_true(
      identical(sort(s_out$panel$id), sort(recent_out$panel$id)) &&
        identical(
          s_out$panel[order(id), .(id, repeat_id, any_change, change_property_type)],
          recent_out$panel[order(id), .(id, repeat_id, any_change, change_property_type)]
        ),
      "R2: scalar ids, repeat ids and change flags do not depend on the earlier history"
    )
    assert_ledger_identity(s_out$ledger)
    assert_ledger_identity(p_out$ledger)
    assert_true(
      nrow(p_out$panel) > nrow(s_out$panel) &&
        all(s_out$panel$id %in% p_out$panel$id),
      "the profile sample is a superset of the scalar sample here"
    )
    # A property losing its second distinct date after banding drops from that panel only.
    site_far_for_p <- tibble::tibble(site_id = 1L, easting = 400000, northing = 300000, usable = TRUE)
    history2 <- data.table::copy(history)[house_id == "h18", easting := 399250] # h18 falls in the omitted band
    mapping2 <- fixture_mapping_from_history(history2, cfg)
    profile2 <- apply_sample_contract(history2, mapping2, "sales", profile_config(cfg))
    p2 <- apply_exposure(profile2$panel, site_far_for_p, profile2$ledger, "sales", profile_config(cfg))
    assert_true(
      !any(c("h17", "h18") %in% p2$panel$id) && all(c("h19", "h20", "h21") %in% p2$panel$id),
      "P loses its second banded date and leaves the profile panel; Q stays"
    )
    # Manifest totals validate against the full history, not either panel.
    manifest <- fixture_manifest(history, mapping, nrow(history) - nrow(mapping), 0L)
    assert_true(
      validate_mapping(history, mapping, manifest, character(), "sales", cfg)$status == "passed",
      "full-generation manifest reconciles"
    )
    corrupt <- manifest
    corrupt$input_row_count <- as.character(sum(lubridate::year(history$date_of_transfer) >= 2014L))
    assert_error_matching(
      validate_mapping(history, mapping, corrupt, character(), "sales", cfg),
      "input_row_count",
      "a manifest describing only the scalar window fails against the full history"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  ae1_one_date_after_restriction_drops = function() {
    cfg <- fixture_sales_cfg()
    history <- fixture_sales_history()
    mapping <- fixture_mapping_from_history(history, cfg)
    contract <- apply_sample_contract(history, mapping, "sales", cfg)
    panel <- contract$panel
    assert_true(
      !"h09" %in% panel$id,
      "h09 (2014) must be outside the requested window"
    )
    assert_true(
      "h10" %in% panel$id,
      "h10 survives the common requirements before the repeat recount"
    )
    eligible <- recompute_repeats(panel)
    assert_true(
      !"h10" %in% eligible$id,
      "AE1: property E keeps one distinct date and must drop from the repeat panel"
    )
    assert_true(
      all(c("h01", "h02") %in% eligible$id),
      "property A remains a repeat"
    )
    assert_true(
      all(c("h03", "h04") %in% eligible$id),
      "two dates within one calendar month meet the repeat criterion"
    )
    assert_true(
      !"h08" %in% eligible$id,
      "window single D drops at the repeat recount"
    )
    # C loses its missing-country row but keeps two dates; G and H lose one row and drop.
    assert_true(
      all(c("h05", "h06") %in% eligible$id) && !"h07" %in% eligible$id,
      "C keeps two England dates"
    )
    assert_true(
      !any(c("h13", "h14", "h15", "h16") %in% eligible$id),
      "G and H retain one date each and drop"
    )
    assert_ledger_identity(contract$ledger)
    TRUE
  },

  ledger_chains_and_names_steps = function() {
    cfg <- fixture_sales_cfg()
    history <- fixture_sales_history()
    mapping <- fixture_mapping_from_history(history, cfg)
    ledger <- apply_sample_contract(history, mapping, "sales", cfg)$ledger
    expected <- c(
      "requested_dates",
      "mapped_rows",
      "address_key_verification",
      "geography_contradictions",
      "finite_positive_outcome",
      "england",
      "projected_coordinates",
      "lsoa_msoa_nonmissing"
    )
    assert_true(
      identical(ledger$step, expected),
      "ledger steps follow the plan order"
    )
    assert_true(
      ledger$n_rows_before[[1]] == nrow(history),
      "first ledger row starts from the full history"
    )
    assert_true(
      ledger$n_rows_removed[ledger$step == "requested_dates"] == 1,
      "one row outside the window"
    )
    assert_true(
      ledger$n_rows_removed[ledger$step == "geography_contradictions"] == 2,
      "F's two rows leave as a group"
    )
    assert_true(
      ledger$n_rows_removed[ledger$step == "finite_positive_outcome"] == 1,
      "one nonpositive price"
    )
    assert_true(
      ledger$n_rows_removed[ledger$step == "england"] == 1,
      "one missing-country row remains after F left"
    )
    assert_true(
      ledger$n_rows_removed[ledger$step == "lsoa_msoa_nonmissing"] == 1,
      "one missing LSOA"
    )
    assert_ledger_identity(ledger)
    assert_true(
      all(ledger$market == "sales") &&
        identical(ledger$step_order, seq_len(nrow(ledger))),
      "ledger keys"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  mapping_duplicate_id_fails_without_multiplying = function() {
    cfg <- fixture_sales_cfg()
    history <- fixture_sales_history()
    mapping <- fixture_mapping_from_history(history, cfg)
    manifest <- fixture_manifest(history, mapping, 0, 0)
    n_before <- nrow(history)
    duplicated_mapping <- rbind(mapping, mapping[house_id == "h01"])
    err <- assert_error_matching(
      validate_mapping(
        history,
        duplicated_mapping,
        manifest,
        character(),
        "sales",
        cfg
      ),
      "duplicated transaction ids",
      "duplicated mapping id must fail validation"
    )
    assert_true(
      identical(err$details$n_duplicated_mapping_ids, 1L),
      "duplicate count is reported"
    )
    assert_true(nrow(history) == n_before, "history rows are untouched")
    # A clean mapping passes and the candidate count equals the history count (no multiplication).
    ok <- validate_mapping(
      history,
      mapping,
      manifest,
      character(),
      "sales",
      cfg
    )
    assert_true(
      ok$status == "passed" && ok$n_history == n_before,
      "clean mapping validates"
    )
    contract <- apply_sample_contract(history, mapping, "sales", cfg)
    assert_true(
      contract$ledger$n_rows_after[[2]] == n_before - 1,
      "mapped rows equal window rows: no multiplication or silent drop"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  mapping_id_absent_from_history_fails = function() {
    cfg <- fixture_sales_cfg()
    history <- fixture_sales_history()
    mapping <- fixture_mapping_from_history(history, cfg)
    extra <- rbind(
      mapping,
      data.table::data.table(
        house_id = "h99",

        repeat_count = 1L
      )
    )
    manifest <- fixture_manifest(history, extra, 0, 0)
    err <- assert_error_matching(

      "absent from history",

    )
    assert_true(
      identical(err$details$n_mapping_absent_from_history, 1L),
      "absent count is reported"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  stale_repeat_id_after_address_correction = function() {
    cfg <- fixture_sales_cfg()
    history <- fixture_sales_history()
    mapping <- fixture_mapping_from_history(history, cfg)
    corrected <- data.table::copy(history)
    corrected[house_id == "h02", street := "HIGH STREET"] # id unchanged, key changes
    err <- assert_error_matching(
      verify_current_address_keys(corrected, mapping, "sales", cfg),
      "mismatched repeat ids",
      "a corrected address must be caught as a stale mapping"
    )
    assert_true(
      identical(err$details$n_mismatched, 1L) &&
        identical(err$details$n_missing_keys, 0L),
      "exactly one mismatched row, no missing keys"
    )
    assert_true(
      identical(err$details$example_mismatched_ids, "h02"),
      "the corrected id is named"
    )
    # The mapping object is untouched (read-only verification, no rebuild).
    assert_true(
      identical(mapping, fixture_mapping_from_history(history, cfg)),
      "mapping was not rebuilt"
    )
    # The uncorrected history passes.
    ok <- verify_current_address_keys(history, mapping, "sales", cfg)
    assert_true(
      ok$status == "passed" &&
        ok$n_mismatched == 0L &&
        ok$n_candidates == nrow(history),
      "unchanged history verifies"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  stale_repeat_id_on_mapped_singleton = function() {
    cfg <- fixture_sales_cfg()
    history <- fixture_sales_history()
    mapping <- fixture_mapping_from_history(history, cfg)
    corrected <- data.table::copy(history)
    corrected[house_id == "h08", paon := "4A"] # D is a mapped single
    err <- assert_error_matching(
      verify_current_address_keys(corrected, mapping, "sales", cfg),
      "mismatched repeat ids",
      "a corrected singleton must be caught"
    )
    assert_true(
      identical(err$details$example_mismatched_ids, "h08"),
      "the singleton id is named"
    )
    assert_true(
      err$details$n_window_singles >= 1L,
      "singles are counted among candidates"
    )
    # A missing current key (blank postcode) is also a failure.
    blank <- data.table::copy(history)
    blank[house_id == "h05", postcode := ""]
    err2 <- assert_error_matching(
      verify_current_address_keys(blank, mapping, "sales", cfg),
      "missing current keys",
      "a missing current key must be caught"
    )
    assert_true(identical(err2$details$n_missing_keys, 1L), "one missing key")
    # The contract stops at the verification step, before any row-level restriction.
    assert_error_matching(
      apply_sample_contract(corrected, mapping, "sales", cfg),
      "address_keys",
      "the sample contract blocks the market on a stale mapping"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  geography_contradiction_detected_before_row_restriction = function() {
    cfg <- fixture_sales_cfg()
    history <- fixture_sales_history()
    mapping <- fixture_mapping_from_history(history, cfg)
    history[, repeat_id := mapping$repeat_id[match(house_id, mapping$house_id)]]
    geo <- check_group_geography_contradictions(history)
    f_id <- history[house_id == "h11", repeat_id]
    g_id <- history[house_id == "h13", repeat_id]
    assert_true(
      identical(geo$group_ids, f_id),
      "only F is contradictory (distinct nonmissing LSOA and country)"
    )
    assert_true(
      geo$n_groups_lsoa == 1L &&
        geo$n_groups_country == 1L &&
        geo$n_groups_coordinates == 0L &&
        geo$n_groups_msoa == 0L,
      "contradiction types are counted"
    )
    assert_true(
      !g_id %in% geo$group_ids,
      "missing-to-observed LSOA is not a contradiction"
    )
    history[, repeat_id := NULL]
    contract <- apply_sample_contract(history, mapping, "sales", cfg)
    assert_true(
      !any(c("h11", "h12") %in% contract$panel$id),
      "F leaves as a whole group"
    )
    assert_true(
      "h14" %in% contract$panel$id,
      "G's observed row survives the LSOA step"
    )
    # Had the England step run first, h12 would have gone and F would look consistent.
    england_first <- history[country == "England"]
    england_first[,
      repeat_id := mapping$repeat_id[match(house_id, mapping$house_id)]
    ]
    assert_true(
      length(check_group_geography_contradictions(england_first)$group_ids) ==
        0L,
      "the England row restriction would have hidden the contradiction"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  same_day_and_unkeyed_reconcile_with_manifest = function() {
    cfg <- fixture_sales_cfg()
    history <- fixture_sales_history()
    # Add an unkeyed row (blank postcode) and a same-day conflict pair at a new address.
    extra <- history[house_id %in% c("h01", "h03", "h04")]
    extra[, house_id := c("h90", "h91", "h92")]
    extra[house_id == "h90", postcode := ""]
    extra[
      house_id %in% c("h91", "h92"),
      `:=`(
        postcode = "AB1 2CZ",
        paon = "9",
        saon = NA_character_,
        date_of_transfer = as.Date("2017-03-03")
      )
    ]
    history <- rbind(history, extra)
    mapping <- fixture_mapping_from_history(
      history,
      cfg,
      exclude_ids = c("h90", "h91", "h92")
    )
    manifest <- fixture_manifest(
      history,
      mapping,
      excluded_count = 1,
      same_day_count = 2
    )
    ok <- validate_mapping(
      history,
      mapping,
      manifest,
      c("h91", "h92"),
      "sales",
      cfg
    )
    assert_true(
      ok$reconciled &&
        ok$n_history_absent_from_mapping == 3L &&
        ok$n_unkeyed_recomputed == 1L &&
        ok$n_same_day_recomputed == 2L,
      "absent rows reconcile as unkeyed + same-day"
    )
    # Wrong manifest count.
    bad_manifest <- fixture_manifest(
      history,
      mapping,
      excluded_count = 2,
      same_day_count = 2
    )
    assert_error_matching(
      validate_mapping(
        history,
        mapping,
        bad_manifest,
        c("h91", "h92"),
        "sales",
        cfg
      ),
      "do not reconcile",
      "a manifest count mismatch fails"
    )
    # Same-day review naming a row that is in the mapping.
    assert_error_matching(
      validate_mapping(
        history,
        mapping,
        manifest,
        c("h91", "h01"),
        "sales",
        cfg
      ),
      "do not reconcile",
      "a same-day id present in the mapping fails"
    )
    # Manifest row count disagreement with the history.
    short_manifest <- manifest
    short_manifest$input_row_count <- "5"
    assert_error_matching(
      validate_mapping(
        history,
        mapping,
        short_manifest,
        c("h91", "h92"),
        "sales",
        cfg
      ),
      "input_row_count",
      "manifest input_row_count must equal history rows"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  unreadable_input_and_missing_year_are_named = function() {
    missing_path <- file.path(tempdir(), "no-such-history-2026.parquet")
    err <- assert_error_matching(
      load_history("sales", path = missing_path),
      "no-such-history-2026",
      "an unreadable input names the file"
    )
    assert_true(
      inherits(err, "market_blocked") && err$stage == "input",
      "unreadable input blocks the market"
    )
    assert_error_matching(
      capture_input_provenance("x", missing_path, "a"),
      "unreadable",
      "provenance refuses an unreadable file"
    )
    cfg <- fixture_sales_cfg(end = "2019-12-31")
    history <- fixture_sales_history()
    mapping <- fixture_mapping_from_history(history, cfg)
    err2 <- assert_error_matching(

      grepl("synthetic-sales-history", conditionMessage(err2)),

    )
    assert_true(
