  change_flags_ignore_missing_to_observed = function() {
    panel <- data.table::data.table(
      repeat_id = c("a", "a", "b", "b", "c", "c"),
      property_type = c("T", "T", "F", "S", NA, "D"),
      bedrooms = c(2, NA, 3, 3, 1, 2)
    )
    flags <- freeze_change_flags(panel, c("property_type", "bedrooms"))
    assert_true(
      identical(flags[repeat_id == "a", any_change], FALSE),
      "missing-to-observed is not a change"
    )
    assert_true(
      identical(flags[repeat_id == "b", change_property_type], TRUE) &&
        identical(flags[repeat_id == "b", change_bedrooms], FALSE),
      "two distinct observed types flag the type only"
    )
    assert_true(
      identical(flags[repeat_id == "c", change_property_type], FALSE) &&
        identical(flags[repeat_id == "c", change_bedrooms], TRUE),
      "NA-to-D is not a type change; 1-to-2 is a bedroom change"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  rental_unit_evidence_flags_conversion_break = function() {
    dates <- as.Date(c(rep("2022-06-01", 50), rep("2023-06-01", 50)))
    ids <- rep(sprintf("p%02d", 1:50), 2)
    steady <- rental_unit_evidence(rep(c(200, 210), each = 50), dates, ids)
    assert_true(
      steady$status == "consistent_within_property_comparable",
      "a 5% shift is not a unit break"
    )
    broken <- rental_unit_evidence(
      c(rep(200, 50), rep(200 * 52 / 12, 50)),
      dates,
      ids
    )
    assert_true(
      broken$status == "blocked" &&
        abs(broken$median_ratio_2023_2022 - 52 / 12) < 1e-9,
      "a weekly-to-monthly jump is flagged"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  diagnostics_run_with_and_without_grouping = function() {
    cfg <- fixture_sales_cfg()
    history <- fixture_sales_history()
    mapping <- fixture_mapping_from_history(history, cfg)
    panel <- recompute_repeats(
      apply_sample_contract(history, mapping, "sales", cfg)$panel
    )
    d <- compute_observation_diagnostics(panel, "sales", NULL, cfg)
    assert_true(
      d$n_groups == 3L && d$n_rows == 6L,
      "diagnostics see the eligible pre-band panel (A, B, C)"
    )
    assert_true(
      d$same_month$n_same_month_pairs == 1L,
      "B is the single same-month pair"
    )
    assert_true(d$extreme_ratio_total$n_pairs == 3L, "three consecutive pairs")
    panel[,
      band := data.table::fifelse(
        repeat_id == panel$repeat_id[[1]],
        "near",
        "far"
      )
    ]
    dg <- compute_observation_diagnostics(panel, "sales", "band", cfg)
    assert_true(
      all(c("near", "far") %in% dg$outcome_by_year$band),
      "grouping column is honoured"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  blocked_market_still_records_input_provenance = function() {
    cfg <- fixture_sales_cfg()
    dir <- tempfile("provenance-")
    dir.create(dir)
    cfg$history_path <- file.path(dir, "no-such-history.parquet")
    cfg$mapping_path <- file.path(dir, "mapping.parquet")
    history <- fixture_sales_history()
    arrow::write_parquet(
      fixture_mapping_from_history(history, fixture_sales_cfg()),
      cfg$mapping_path
    )
    prepared <- prepare_market_panel("sales", cfg)
    assert_true(
      prepared$status == "blocked" &&
        identical(prepared$readiness$blocked_stage, "input") &&
        grepl("no-such-history", prepared$reason),
      "the missing history blocks the market at the input stage"
    )
    prov <- prepared$provenance
    assert_true(
      identical(prov$input, unname(market_input_names("sales"))),
      "the blocked market still names its three inputs"
    )
    hist_row <- prov[prov$input == "sales_history", ]
    map_row <- prov[prov$input == "sales_mapping", ]
    assert_true(
      !hist_row$readable &&
        is.na(hist_row$content_hash) &&
        grepl("no-such-history", hist_row$path),
      "the unreadable history carries no hash and readable = FALSE"
    )
    assert_true(
      map_row$readable &&
        identical(
          map_row$content_hash,
          digest::digest(file = cfg$mapping_path, algo = "xxhash64")
        ),
      "the readable mapping is hashed from its bytes"
    )
    assert_true(
      !prov$readable[prov$input == "sales_same_day_review"],
      "the missing same-day review is unreadable too"
    )
    # The unreadable input hashes to NA at build time and now; the file appearing later is named.
    saved <- input_fingerprint(prov, rehash = FALSE)
    assert_true(
      identical(saved$hashes, input_fingerprint(prov, rehash = TRUE)$hashes),
      "NA hashes agree while the file is still missing"
    )
    arrow::write_parquet(history, cfg$history_path)
    later <- input_fingerprint(prov, rehash = TRUE)
    assert_true(
      saved$hash != later$hash,
      "the history appearing changes the input fingerprint"
    )
    diffs <- fingerprint_differences(
      list(inputs = saved$hashes),
      list(inputs = later$hashes)
    )
    assert_true(
      identical(
        diffs,
        "input `sales_history` (unreadable when the bundle was built, now readable)"
      ),
      "the newly readable input is named"
    )
    TRUE
  }
)

# ---- U2 fixtures ------------------------------------------------------------------

# Two-site crosswalk over the configured years. Site 1 at (400000, 300000), site 2
# at (403000, 300000); `status_by_year` lets AE3 vary the monitoring history.
fixture_crosswalk <- function(
  status_by_year = rep("reported_positive", length(CONFIG$crosswalk_years)),
  sites = tibble::tibble(
    site_id = 1:2,
    easting = c(400000, 403000),
    northing = 300000
  )
) {
  years <- CONFIG$crosswalk_years
  tidyr::expand_grid(site_id = sites$site_id, year = years) |>
    dplyr::left_join(sites, by = "site_id") |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      water_company = "Fixture Water",
      annual_status = status_by_year[match(.data$year, years)],
      ngr = "TQ000000"
    ) |>
    as.data.frame()
}

fixture_monthly <- function(jan_2014 = 2L) {
  # Sparse positive-count months, as in the real file: Feb 2014 absent, Oct 2014 absent.
  data.frame(
    year = c(2013L, 2014L, 2014L, 2014L, 2022L, 2022L, 2024L),
    month = c(12L, 1L, 3L, 4L, 7L, 8L, 12L),
    article_count = c(5L, jan_2014, 1L, 2L, 4L, 6L, 3L)
  )
}

fixture_evidence <- function(
  status = "established",
  coverage_end = as.Date("2025-06-01")
) {
  list(
    status = status,
    reasons = if (status == "established") {
      character()
    } else {
      "fixture: coverage unknown"
    },
    coverage_end = if (status == "established") coverage_end else as.Date(NA)
  )
}

fixture_export_zip <- function(dir, name, n_docx) {
  src <- tempfile("docx-")
  dir.create(src)
  entries <- sprintf("article_%03d.DOCX", seq_len(n_docx))
  file.create(file.path(src, entries))
  path <- file.path(dir, name)
  withr::with_dir(src, utils::zip(path, entries, flags = "-q"))
  unlink(src, recursive = TRUE)
  path
}

FIXTURE_CHECKS$u2 <- list(
  band_boundaries_exact = function() {
    d <- c(0, 250, 500, 500.001, 750, 1000, 1000.001, 1500, 2000, 2000.001, NA)
    got <- assign_bands(d, CONFIG$bands)
    want <- c(1L, 1L, 1L, NA, NA, NA, 0L, 0L, 0L, NA, NA)
    assert_true(
      identical(got, want),
      sprintf("KTD5 boundaries: got %s", paste(got, collapse = ","))
    )
    assert_true(is.integer(got), "bands are integer")
    TRUE
  },

  nearest_matches_exhaustive_distances = function() {
    sites <- tibble::tibble(
      site_id = c(11L, 12L, 13L, 14L),
      easting = c(400000, 401500, 404000, 399000),
      northing = c(300000, 300800, 299500, 302500),
      usable = TRUE
    )
    props <- data.table::data.table(
      easting = c(400100, 401600, 403950, 399100, 402500, 400750),
      northing = c(300050, 300700, 299600, 302400, 300200, 300400)
    )
    got <- nearest_site_distance(props, sites)
    full <- outer(seq_len(nrow(props)), seq_len(nrow(sites)), function(i, j) {
      sqrt(
        (props$easting[i] - sites$easting[j])^2 +
          (props$northing[i] - sites$northing[j])^2
      )
    })
    want_site <- sites$site_id[apply(full, 1L, which.min)]
    want_dist <- apply(full, 1L, min)
    assert_true(
      identical(got$site_id, want_site),
      "nearest site equals the exhaustive minimum"
    )
    assert_true(
      max(abs(got$distance_m - want_dist)) < 1e-6,
      "distance equals the exhaustive minimum"
    )
    assert_true(nrow(got) == nrow(props), "one row per unique coordinate")
    TRUE
  },

  ae3_monitoring_history_leaves_exposure_unchanged = function() {
    always <- project_sites(fixture_crosswalk(rep("reported_positive", 4L)))
    late <- project_sites(fixture_crosswalk(c(
      "absent",
      "absent",
      "absent",
      "reported_positive"
    )))
    assert_true(
      identical(always$projection, late$projection),
      "AE3: projection identical when monitoring starts later"
    )
    assert_true(
      !any(grepl("available", names(late$projection))),
      "no availability columns in the projection"
    )
    props <- data.table::data.table(
      easting = c(400300, 401500),
      northing = 300000
    )
    a <- nearest_site_distance(props, always$projection)
    b <- nearest_site_distance(props, late$projection)
    assert_true(identical(a, b), "AE3: distances identical")
    assert_true(
      identical(assign_bands(a$distance_m), c(1L, 0L)),
      "300 m near; 1500 m far, regardless of monitoring"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  unusable_site_counted_and_omitted = function() {
    sites <- tibble::tibble(
      site_id = 1:3,
      easting = c(400000, 403000, NA),
      northing = c(300000, 300000, NA)
    )
    out <- project_sites(fixture_crosswalk(sites = sites))
    assert_true(
      out$n_sites == 3L && out$n_usable == 2L && out$n_unusable == 1L,
      "unusable site counted"
    )
    assert_true(
      identical(out$unusable_site_ids, 3L),
      "site 3 is the unusable one"
    )
    # A property that would sit on site 3 (had it a location) matches site 2 instead.
    got <- nearest_site_distance(
      data.table::data.table(easting = 405000, northing = 300000),
      out$projection
    )
    assert_true(
      got$site_id == 2L && abs(got$distance_m - 2000) < 1e-9,
      "unusable site omitted from matching"
    )
    none <- tibble::tibble(
      site_id = 1:2,
      easting = NA_real_,
      northing = NA_real_
    )
    assert_error_matching(
      project_sites(fixture_crosswalk(sites = none)),
      "zero usable",
      "zero usable sites stop matching"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  zero_month_within_coverage_carries_stock_forward = function() {
    cal <- build_attention_calendar(
      "sales",
      fixture_monthly(2L),
      fixture_evidence("established")
    )
    assert_true(
      all(cal$article_status == "valid"),
      "calendar valid under established coverage"
    )
    feb <- cal[cal$year == 2014L & cal$month == 2L, ]
    assert_true(
      feb$article_count == 0 &&
        feb$article_stock == 2 &&
        feb$log_articles == log(2),
      "absent Feb 2014 is zero and carries the stock"
    )
    assert_true(
      cal$article_stock[cal$year == 2014L & cal$month == 4L] == 5,
      "stock cumulates 2+1+2"
    )
    assert_true(
      !any(cal$article_stock > 5 + 4 + 6 + 3),
      "2013 articles are excluded from the stock"
    )
    unknown <- build_attention_calendar(
      "sales",
      fixture_monthly(2L),
      fixture_evidence("unavailable")
    )
    assert_true(
      all(unknown$article_status == "blocked") &&
        all(is.na(unknown$article_count)) &&
        all(is.na(unknown$log_articles)),
      "unknown coverage blocks rather than zero-fills"
    )
    assert_true(
      grepl("coverage not established", attr(unknown, "article_reason")),
      "reason names coverage"
    )
    short <- build_attention_calendar(
      "sales",
      fixture_monthly(2L),
      fixture_evidence("established", as.Date("2020-12-01"))
    )
    assert_true(
      all(short$article_status == "blocked") &&
        grepl("coverage ends", short$article_reason[[1L]]),
      "coverage ending before the calendar end blocks"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  article_input_validation_failures = function() {
    base <- fixture_monthly(2L)
    assert_true(
      validate_article_input(base)$status == "passed",
      "fixture passes validation"
    )
    dup <- rbind(base, data.frame(year = 2014L, month = 3L, article_count = 1L))
    v <- validate_article_input(dup)
    assert_true(
      v$status == "failed" && any(grepl("duplicated", v$reasons)),
      "duplicate keys fail"
    )
    miss <- base
    miss$article_count[2] <- NA
    v <- validate_article_input(miss)
    assert_true(
      v$status == "failed" && any(grepl("missing article counts", v$reasons)),
      "missing counts fail"
    )
    neg <- base
    neg$article_count[2] <- -1L
    assert_true(
      any(grepl("negative", validate_article_input(neg)$reasons)),
      "negative counts fail"
    )
    frac <- base
    frac$article_count <- as.numeric(frac$article_count)
    frac$article_count[2] <- 1.5
    assert_true(
      any(grepl("non-integer", validate_article_input(frac)$reasons)),
      "non-integer counts fail"
    )
    bad_month <- base
    bad_month$month[2] <- 13L
    assert_true(
      any(grepl("month must be", validate_article_input(bad_month)$reasons)),
      "invalid month fails"
    )
    blocked <- build_attention_calendar(
      "sales",
      dup,
      fixture_evidence("established")
    )
    assert_true(
      all(blocked$article_status == "blocked") &&
        grepl("validation failed", blocked$article_reason[[1L]]),
      "validation failure blocks the calendar"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  missing_export_evidence_is_not_replaced_by_observed_dates = function() {
    ev <- article_export_evidence(
      zip_dir = file.path(tempdir(), "no-such-export-dir"),
      articles_path = "no-such-articles.parquet",
      monthly_path = "no-such-monthly.parquet"
    )
    assert_true(
      ev$status == "unavailable" && is.na(ev$coverage_end),
      "missing export zips give unavailable evidence"
    )
    # The monthly fixture spans 2013-2024, yet the calendar stays blocked.
    cal <- build_attention_calendar("sales", fixture_monthly(2L), ev)
    assert_true(
      all(cal$article_status == "blocked") && all(is.na(cal$log_articles)),
      "observed first/last dates do not establish coverage"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  positive_initial_stock_required = function() {
    ok <- build_attention_calendar(
      "sales",
      fixture_monthly(2L),
      fixture_evidence()
    )
    assert_true(
      ok$article_stock[[1L]] == 2 && ok$log_articles[[1L]] == log(2),
      "January 2014 stock of two is logged"
    )
    zero <- build_attention_calendar(
      "sales",
      fixture_monthly(0L),
      fixture_evidence()
    )
    assert_true(
      all(zero$article_status == "blocked") &&
        grepl("origin month 2014-01", zero$article_reason[[1L]]),
      "zero initial stock blocks article cells"
    )
    assert_true(
      zero$year[[1L]] == 2014L &&
        zero$month[[1L]] == 1L &&
        zero$article_stock[[1L]] == 0 &&
        zero$article_stock[[3L]] == 1,
      "origin and cumulation unchanged; no offset or later origin"
    )
    assert_true(all(is.na(zero$log_articles)), "no log1p substitute")
    TRUE
  },

  event_month_boundary_and_calendar_length = function() {
    sales <- build_attention_calendar(
      "sales",
      fixture_monthly(2L),
      fixture_evidence()
    )
    rentals <- build_attention_calendar(
      "rentals",
      fixture_monthly(2L),
      fixture_evidence()
    )
    assert_true(
      nrow(sales) == 132L && nrow(rentals) == 120L,
      "132 sales months, 120 rental months"
    )
    assert_true(
      sales$post[sales$year == 2022L & sales$month == 7L] == 0L,
      "July 2022 is pre"
    )
    assert_true(
      sales$post[sales$year == 2022L & sales$month == 8L] == 1L,
      "August 2022 is post"
    )
    assert_true(
      sales$year[[1L]] == 2014L &&
        sales$month_index[[1L]] == 1L &&
        all(diff(sales$month_index) == 1L),
      "calendar starts January 2014 with month_index 1 (no 2021-based indexing)"
    )
    assert_true(
      sum(sales$post == 0L) == 103L && sum(sales$year < 2021L) == 84L,
      "earlier months intact"
    )
    assert_true(
      sales$year[[132L]] == 2024L &&
        sales$month[[132L]] == 12L &&
        rentals$year[[120L]] == 2023L,
      "market-specific end months"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  coverage_failure_keeps_post_columns_valid = function() {
    panel <- data.table::data.table(month_index = c(1L, 103L, 104L, 132L))
    blocked <- build_attention_calendar(
      "sales",
      fixture_monthly(2L),

    valid <- build_attention_calendar(
      "sales",
