  apply_exposure_bands_then_repeats_then_flags = function() {
    cfg <- fixture_sales_cfg()
    history <- fixture_sales_history()
    mapping <- fixture_mapping_from_history(history, cfg)
    contract <- apply_sample_contract(history, mapping, "sales", cfg)
    # Fixture eastings run 400000-400070 on one northing, so one site places every
    # row in the same band: 400000 -> near (0-70 m); 398500 -> far (1500-1570 m);
    # 399250 -> omitted band (750-820 m).
    site_at <- function(e) {
      tibble::tibble(
        site_id = 1L,
        easting = e,
        northing = 300000,
        usable = TRUE
      )
    }
    out <- apply_exposure(
      contract$panel,
      site_at(400000),
      contract$ledger,
      "sales",
      cfg
    )
    steps <- out$ledger$step
    assert_true(
      identical(
        utils::tail(steps, 2L),
        c("distance_bands", "two_distinct_dates")
      ),
      "band and repeat steps appended in order"
    )
    assert_ledger_identity(out$ledger)
    p <- out$panel
    assert_true(
      all(
        c(
          "site_id",
          "distance_m",
          "near",
          "band",
          "change_property_type",
          "any_change"
        ) %in%
          names(p)
      ),
      "exposure and flag columns present"
    )
    assert_true(
      all(is.finite(p$distance_m)) &&
        all(p$near == 1L) &&
        all(p$band == "near"),
      "every retained row has one exposure; all near"
    )
    assert_true(
      out$ledger$n_rows_removed[steps == "distance_bands"] == 0 &&
        out$ledger$n_rows_removed[steps == "two_distinct_dates"] == 4 &&
        nrow(p) == 6L &&
        data.table::uniqueN(p$repeat_id) == 3L,
      "bands keep 10 rows; singles D, E, G, H drop at two_distinct_dates"
    )
    assert_true(!"h10" %in% p$id, "AE1 single drops at two_distinct_dates")
    assert_true(
      nrow(out$change_flags) == 3L && all(!p$any_change),
      "no property changes type; flags joined without restriction"
    )
    far <- apply_exposure(
      contract$panel,
      site_at(398500),
      contract$ledger,
      "sales",
      cfg
    )
    assert_true(
      all(far$panel$near == 0L) && nrow(far$panel) == 6L,
      "all rows far with the shifted site"
    )
    omitted <- apply_exposure(
      contract$panel,
      site_at(399250),
      contract$ledger,
      "sales",
      cfg
    )
    assert_true(
      omitted$ledger$n_rows_removed[omitted$ledger$step == "distance_bands"] ==
        10 &&
        nrow(omitted$panel) == 0L,
      "rows in (500, 1000] leave at distance_bands"
    )
    # A property whose type changes is flagged but retained.
    history2 <- data.table::copy(history)[
      house_id == "h02",
      property_type := "D"
    ]
    out2 <- apply_exposure(
      apply_sample_contract(history2, mapping, "sales", cfg)$panel,
      site_at(400000),
      contract$ledger,
      "sales",
      cfg
    )
    assert_true(
      all(out2$panel[id %in% c("h01", "h02"), any_change]) &&
        nrow(out2$panel) == nrow(p),
      "changed property flagged and retained"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  export_zip_directory_membership_is_fingerprinted = function() {
    dir <- tempfile("zips-")
    dir.create(dir)
    fixture_export_zip(dir, "search_1_1.ZIP", 2L)
    ev <- article_export_evidence(
      zip_dir = dir,
      articles_path = file.path(dir, "no-articles.parquet"),
      monthly_path = file.path(dir, "no-monthly.parquet")
    )
    assert_true(
      ev$status == "unavailable" && length(ev$reasons) == 1L,
      "evidence unavailable without the parquet files"
    )
    prov <- ev$provenance
    assert_true(
      identical(
        prov$input,
        c("search1_articles", EXPORT_ZIP_LISTING_INPUT, "export_zip_search_1_1")
      ),
      "provenance is captured before the early return: articles, listing, one zip"
    )
    assert_true(
      !prov$readable[prov$input == "search1_articles"] &&
        all(prov$readable[prov$input != "search1_articles"]),
      "the missing parquet is recorded as unreadable"
    )
    assert_true(
      identical(
        prov$content_hash[prov$input == "export_zip_search_1_1"],
        digest::digest(
          file = file.path(dir, "search_1_1.ZIP"),
          algo = "xxhash64"
        )
      ),
      "the zip is hashed from its bytes without listing it"
    )
    saved <- input_fingerprint(prov, rehash = FALSE)
    assert_true(
      identical(saved$hashes, input_fingerprint(prov, rehash = TRUE)$hashes),
      "re-hashing the listing row from the directory reproduces the saved hash"
    )
    fixture_export_zip(dir, "search_1_2.ZIP", 1L)
    now <- input_fingerprint(prov, rehash = TRUE)
    assert_true(
      saved$hash != now$hash,
      "adding a zip changes the input fingerprint"
    )
    diffs <- fingerprint_differences(
      list(inputs = saved$hashes),
      list(inputs = now$hashes)
    )
    assert_true(
      identical(
        diffs,
        sprintf("input `%s` (content changed)", EXPORT_ZIP_LISTING_INPUT)
      ),
      "the listing row names the change"
    )
    cfg <- CONFIG
    cfg$article_zip_dir <- dir
    expected <- expected_input_names(cfg)
    wanted <- c(
      market_input_names("sales"),
      market_input_names("rentals"),
      "site_group_crosswalk",
      "search1_monthly",
      "search1_articles",
      EXPORT_ZIP_LISTING_INPUT,
      "export_zip_search_1_1",
      "export_zip_search_1_2"
    )
    assert_true(
      length(expected) == 12L && all(wanted %in% expected),
      "expected input names derive from CONFIG and the zips present now"
    )
    unlink(file.path(dir, "search_1_1.ZIP"))
    removed <- input_fingerprint(prov, rehash = TRUE)
    removed_diffs <- fingerprint_differences(
      list(inputs = saved$hashes),
      list(inputs = removed$hashes)
    )
    assert_true(
      is.na(removed$hashes[["export_zip_search_1_1"]]) &&
        any(grepl("export_zip_search_1_1` \\(now missing", removed_diffs)),
      "a removed zip is reported missing"
    )
    empty <- article_export_evidence(
      zip_dir = file.path(dir, "absent"),
      articles_path = file.path(dir, "no.parquet"),
      monthly_path = file.path(dir, "no.parquet")
    )
    assert_true(
      identical(
        empty$provenance$input,
        c("search1_articles", EXPORT_ZIP_LISTING_INPUT)
      ) &&
        !empty$provenance$readable[[2L]] &&
        !is.na(empty$provenance$content_hash[[2L]]),
      "a missing directory still yields a listing row (empty listing hash)"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  export_zip_entries_reconcile_with_article_rows = function() {
    dir <- tempfile("zips-")
    dir.create(dir)
    articles_path <- file.path(dir, "articles.parquet")
    monthly_path <- file.path(dir, "monthly.parquet")
    arrow::write_parquet(
      data.frame(
        date = as.POSIXct(
          c("2014-01-03", "2014-01-20", "2014-03-05"),
          tz = "UTC"
        )
      ),
      articles_path
    )
    arrow::write_parquet(
      data.frame(year = c(2014, 2014), month = c(1, 3), article_count = 2:1),
      monthly_path
    )
    fixture_export_zip(dir, "search_1_1.ZIP", 2L)
    fixture_export_zip(dir, "search_1_2.ZIP", 1L)
    ok <- article_export_evidence(dir, articles_path, monthly_path)
    assert_true(
      ok$status == "established" &&
        length(ok$reasons) == 0L &&
        identical(ok$n_docx_entries, 3L) &&
        isTRUE(ok$records_reconciled) &&
        isTRUE(ok$monthly_reproduced),
      "consistent zip entries and article rows establish coverage"
    )
    assert_true(
      !is.na(ok$export_date_min) &&
        identical(
          ok$coverage_end,
          lubridate::floor_date(ok$export_date_min, "month") - 1L
        ),
      "coverage runs through the month before the earliest export month"
    )
    assert_true(
      identical(
        ok$provenance$n_rows[match(
          c("export_zip_search_1_1", "export_zip_search_1_2"),
          ok$provenance$input
        )],
        c(2, 1)
      ),
      "per-zip provenance records the .docx entry counts"
    )
    fixture_export_zip(dir, "search_1_3.ZIP", 1L)
    bad <- article_export_evidence(dir, articles_path, monthly_path)
    assert_true(
      bad$status == "failed" &&
        is.na(bad$coverage_end) &&
        identical(bad$n_docx_entries, 4L) &&
        any(grepl("entries \\(4\\) differ from extracted article rows \\(3\\)", bad$reasons)),
      "a .docx entry count that differs from the article rows fails the evidence"
    )
    TRUE
  }
)

# ---- U3 fixtures ------------------------------------------------------------------

fixture_model_calendar <- function(market = "sales", blocked = FALSE) {
  evidence <- if (blocked) {
    fixture_evidence(status = "unavailable")
  } else {
    fixture_evidence()
  }
  build_attention_calendar(market, fixture_monthly(2L), evidence)
}

# Synthetic eligible panel: properties in 4 MSOAs (8 LSOAs of 5 properties), observed once a
# year in 2014-2018, four months in 2019, four pre-event months in 2022 and four post months
# in 2023. log price = property effect + month effect + beta_post * near * post +
# beta_articles * near * log_articles + small noise. Controls are constant within property
# unless `varying_controls`; `missing_control_ids` blanks one control on those transactions.
fixture_model_panel <- function(
  market = "sales",
  n_properties = 40L,
  beta_post = 0.05,
  beta_articles = 0,
  near_rule = c("alternate", "msoa", "all_near", "all_far", "one_lsoa"),
  months = c(6L, 18L, 30L, 42L, 54L, 61:64, 100:103, 109:112),
  single_lsoa = FALSE,
  varying_controls = FALSE,
  missing_control_ids = character(),
  noise_sd = 0.001,
  seed = 1L,
  calendar = fixture_model_calendar(market)
) {
  near_rule <- match.arg(near_rule)
  set.seed(seed)
  panel <- data.table::CJ(pid = seq_len(n_properties), month_index = months)
  panel[, repeat_id := sprintf("p%03d", pid)]
  panel[, id := sprintf("t%05d", seq_len(.N))]
  panel[, msoa := sprintf("E02%06d", (pid - 1L) %/% 10L + 1L)]
  panel[,
    lsoa := if (single_lsoa) {
      "E01000001"
    } else {
      sprintf("E01%06d", (pid - 1L) %/% 5L + 1L)
    }
  ]
  panel[,
    near := switch(
      near_rule,
      alternate = as.integer(pid %% 2L == 0L),
      msoa = as.integer(((pid - 1L) %/% 10L) %% 2L == 0L),
      all_near = 1L,
      all_far = 0L,
      one_lsoa = as.integer(pid <= 2L)
    )
  ]
  panel[, year := 2014L + (month_index - 1L) %/% 12L]
  panel[,
    date := as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-15", year, (month_index - 1L) %% 12L + 1L))
  ]
  idx <- match(panel$month_index, calendar$month_index)
  panel[, post := as.integer(calendar$post[idx])]
  panel[, log_articles := as.numeric(calendar$log_articles[idx])]
  alpha <- stats::rnorm(n_properties)
  lambda <- stats::rnorm(length(months), sd = 0.2)
  articles_term <- if (beta_articles != 0) {
    beta_articles * panel$near * panel$log_articles
  } else {
    0
  }
  panel[,
    log_price := alpha[pid] +
      lambda[match(month_index, months)] +
      beta_post * near * post +
      articles_term +
      stats::rnorm(.N, sd = noise_sd)
  ]
  panel[, property_type := c("F", "T", "D", "S")[(pid - 1L) %% 4L + 1L]]
  if (market == "sales") {
    panel[, old_new := "N"]
    panel[, duration := c("F", "L")[(pid - 1L) %% 2L + 1L]]
    if (varying_controls) panel[pid <= 4L & post == 1L, duration := "L"]
  } else {
    panel[, bedrooms := as.numeric((pid - 1L) %% 3L + 1L)]
    panel[, bathrooms := as.numeric((pid - 1L) %/% 20L + 1L)]
    if (varying_controls) {
      panel[pid <= 4L & post == 1L, bathrooms := bathrooms + 1]
    }
  }
  panel[, easting := 400000 + pid]
  panel[, northing := 300000]
  panel[, postcode := "AB1 2CD"]
  panel[, quality := 1L]
  panel[, site_id := 1L]
  panel[, distance_m := ifelse(near == 1L, 100, 1500)]
  panel[, band := band_label(near)]
  panel[, pid := NULL]
  control_cols <- market_config(market)$control_cols
  if (length(missing_control_ids) > 0L) {
    panel[
      id %chin% missing_control_ids,
      (control_cols[[length(control_cols)]]) := NA
    ]
  }
  flags <- freeze_change_flags(panel, market_config(market)$change_cols)
  panel <- merge(panel, flags, by = "repeat_id", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
  panel[]
}

fixture_model_entry <- function(
  panel,
  market = "sales",
  calendar = fixture_model_calendar(market)
) {
  list(
    market = market,
    status = "ready",
    reason = NA_character_,
    panel = panel,
    calendar = calendar
  )
}

# The scalar fixture panel plus one early observation per property (June 1995,
# month index -227), with fresh ids, as a separate annual-profile panel.
fixture_profile_panel <- function(panel, early_year = 1995L) {
  early <- data.table::copy(panel[month_index == 6L])
  early[, year := early_year]
  early[, date := as.Date(sprintf("%d-06-15", early_year))]
  early[, month_index := calendar_month_index(date)]
  early[, id := sprintf("e%05d", seq_len(.N))]
  early[, log_price := log_price - 0.5]
  early[, post := NA_integer_]
  early[, log_articles := NA_real_]
  data.table::rbindlist(list(early, panel), use.names = TRUE)
}

FIXTURE_CHECKS$u3 <- list(
  ae3_pre_2014_months_accepted_by_profile_preparation = function() {
    assert_true(
      calendar_month_index(as.Date("1995-01-15")) == -227L &&
        calendar_month_index(as.Date("2014-01-15")) == 1L &&
        calendar_month_index(as.Date("2013-12-31")) == 0L &&
        calendar_month_index(as.Date("2024-12-01")) == 132L,
      "month indices are consecutive calendar months with January 2014 = 1"
    )
    calendar <- fixture_model_calendar("sales")
    assert_true(
      calendar$month_index[[1L]] == 1L && calendar$year[[1L]] == 2014L &&
        min(calendar$month_index) == 1L,
      "the scalar calendar still starts at the January 2014 article origin"
    )
    panel <- fixture_model_panel("sales")
    profile_panel <- fixture_profile_panel(panel)
    early <- profile_panel[year == 1995L]
    assert_error_matching(
      attach_attention(data.table::copy(early), calendar),
      "no calendar month",
      "a 1995 month has no place in the attention calendar"
    )
    fit <- fit_profile(profile_panel, "sales", "property_month")$profile
    assert_true(
      fit$status == "estimated" && 1995L %in% fit$coefficients$year &&
        isTRUE(fit$coefficients$available[fit$coefficients$year == 1995L]),
      "a 1995 sale receives a calendar-month effect and an annual contrast without any article record"
    )
    assert_true(
      identical(sort(unique(profile_panel$year)), c(1995L, 2014:2019, 2022L, 2023L)),
      "the profile panel spans 1995 and the scalar years"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  separate_profile_panel_fits_its_own_dictionary = function() {
    panel <- fixture_model_panel("sales")
    cfg <- market_config("sales")
    baseline <- estimate_market_models(fixture_model_entry(panel, "sales"), "sales", cfg, verbose = FALSE)
    assert_true(
      baseline$samples$profile$panel == "shared" && is.null(baseline$samples$profile$ids) &&
        baseline$samples$profile$n_rows == nrow(panel) &&
        !any(vapply(names(baseline$samples$estimated), is_profile_key, logical(1))) &&
        all(vapply(names(baseline$samples$profile$estimated), is_profile_key, logical(1))),
      "without a profile panel the profiles share the scalar dictionary and keep their own key list"
    )
    entry <- fixture_model_entry(panel, "sales")
    entry$profile_panel <- fixture_profile_panel(panel)
    out <- estimate_market_models(entry, "sales", cfg, verbose = FALSE)
    pr <- out$samples$profile
    assert_true(
      pr$panel == "separate" && identical(pr$ids, entry$profile_panel$id) &&
        pr$n_rows == nrow(entry$profile_panel) && pr$start == "1995-01-01",
      "a separate profile panel brings its own dictionary and window"
    )
    for (key in names(pr$estimated)) {
      assert_true(
        length(pr$estimated[[key]]) == out$profiles[[key]]$nobs &&
          all(pr$estimated[[key]] %in% seq_len(pr$n_rows)),
        paste("profile rows index the profile dictionary:", key)
      )
      assert_true(
        1995L %in% out$profiles[[key]]$coefficients$year &&
          identical(out$profiles[[key]]$joint_test$years, CONFIG$profile_joint_years),
        paste("expanded profile with the unchanged 2014-2018 joint restriction:", key)
      )
    }
    assert_true(
      isTRUE(all.equal(out$cells, baseline$cells)) &&
        identical(out$samples$ids, baseline$samples$ids) &&
        identical(out$samples$variants, baseline$samples$variants) &&
        identical(out$samples$estimated, baseline$samples$estimated),
      "scalar cells and their samples are unchanged by the separate profile panel"
    )
    support <- pr$metadata$support_by_year
    assert_true(
      all(c("near", "far") %in% support$band[support$year == 1995L]) &&
        sum(support$n_rows) == nrow(entry$profile_panel),
      "annual near/far support covers the whole profile panel"
    )
    compressed <- compress_samples(list(sales = out$samples))
    assert_samples_roundtrip(list(sales = out$samples), compressed)
    key <- profile_key("sales", "property_month")
    assert_true(
      identical(
        sample_retained_ids(compressed$sales, key),
        entry$profile_panel$id[pr$estimated[[key]]]
      ),
      "retained profile ids resolve through the profile dictionary"
    )
    # An empty profile panel leaves the scalar cells intact and records the
    # profiles as unsupported rather than erasing the market.
    entry$profile_panel <- entry$profile_panel[0L]
    empty <- estimate_market_models(entry, "sales", cfg, verbose = FALSE)
    assert_true(
      all(vapply(empty$profiles, function(p) p$status, character(1)) == "unsupported_sample") &&
        isTRUE(all.equal(empty$cells, baseline$cells)) &&
        empty$samples$profile$n_rows == 0L && empty$samples$profile$panel == "separate",
      "an unsupported profile panel does not erase valid scalar cells"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  ae2_missing_to_observed_not_flagged_two_values_excluded = function() {
    panel <- fixture_model_panel("rentals")
    # p001: one missing and one observed bathroom value (not a change); p002: two observed values.
    panel[repeat_id == "p001" & post == 1L, bathrooms := NA]
    panel[repeat_id == "p002" & post == 1L, bathrooms := bathrooms + 1]
    cfg <- market_config("rentals")
    panel[,
      c(
        "change_property_type",
        "change_bedrooms",
        "change_bathrooms",
        "any_change"
      ) := NULL
    ]
    flags <- freeze_change_flags(panel, cfg$change_cols)
    assert_true(
      !flags[repeat_id == "p001", change_bathrooms] &&
        !flags[repeat_id == "p001", any_change],
      "AE2: missing-to-observed does not flag a change"
    )
    assert_true(
      flags[repeat_id == "p002", change_bathrooms] &&
        flags[repeat_id == "p002", any_change],
      "AE2: two distinct nonmissing values flag the property"
    )
    panel <- merge(panel, flags, by = "repeat_id", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
    vs <- build_variant_samples(
      fixture_model_entry(panel, "rentals"),
      "rentals",
      cfg
    )
    kept <- panel$repeat_id[vs$variants$exclude_changes]
    assert_true(
      !"p002" %chin% kept && "p001" %chin% kept,
      "exclude_changes drops the whole flagged group and keeps p001"
    )
    assert_true(
      length(vs$variants$exclude_changes) ==
        nrow(panel) - sum(panel$repeat_id == "p002"),
      "only p002's rows leave"
    )
    steps <- vs$ledger$step[vs$ledger$variant == "exclude_changes"]
    assert_true(
      identical(
        steps,
        c(
          "variant:exclude_changes:drop_flagged_groups",
          "variant:exclude_changes:recompute_repeats"
        )
      ),
      "exclude_changes ledger steps named and ordered"
    )
    assert_true(
      all(
        panel$repeat_id[vs$variants$complete_case] != "p001" |
          !is.na(panel$bathrooms[vs$variants$complete_case])
      ),
      "complete_case drops p001's missing-bathroom rows"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  complete_case_identity_within_fe_and_mismatch_rejected = function() {
    panel <- fixture_model_panel(
      "rentals",
      varying_controls = TRUE,
      missing_control_ids = c("t00001", "t00020", "t00300")
    )
    out <- estimate_market_models(
      fixture_model_entry(panel, "rentals"),
      "rentals",
      market_config("rentals"),
      verbose = FALSE
    )
    for (fe in names(MODEL_FE)) {
      for (attention in MODEL_ATTENTION) {
        comparator <- model_key("rentals", "complete_case", fe, attention)
        controlled <- model_key(
          "rentals",
          "complete_case_controls",
          fe,
          attention
        )
        assert_true(
          out$cells$status[out$cells$model_key == comparator] == "estimated" &&
            out$cells$status[out$cells$model_key == controlled] == "estimated",
          paste("complete-case pair estimated:", fe, attention)
        )
        assert_true(
          setequal(
            out$samples$estimated[[comparator]],
            out$samples$estimated[[controlled]]
          ) &&
            length(out$samples$estimated[[comparator]]) ==
              length(out$samples$estimated[[controlled]]),
          paste("identical estimation rows within", fe, attention)
        )
        assert_true(
          out$cells$nobs[out$cells$model_key == comparator] ==
            out$cells$nobs[out$cells$model_key == controlled],
          "identical nobs"
        )
        absorbed <- out$models[[controlled]]$controls_absorbed
        assert_true(
          out$cells$n_controls_absorbed[out$cells$model_key == controlled] ==
            length(absorbed) &&
            "bedrooms" %in% absorbed &&
            !"bathrooms" %in% absorbed &&
            any(grepl("^property_type", absorbed)),
          "type dummies and bedrooms absorbed; bathrooms (varying within property) retained"
        )
      }
    }
    missing_rows <- panel$id %chin% c("t00001", "t00020", "t00300")
    assert_true(
      !any(missing_rows[out$samples$variants$complete_case]) &&
        length(out$samples$variants$complete_case) < nrow(panel),
      "complete_case excludes missing-control rows"
    )
    ledger <- out$ledger[out$ledger$variant == "complete_case_controls", ]
    assert_true(
      nrow(ledger) == 2L && setequal(ledger$fe, names(MODEL_FE)),
      "one comparator-rows ledger row per FE"
    )
    assert_error_matching(
      assert_identical_estimation_rows(c("a", "b"), c("a", "c"), "k"),
      "did not retain the comparator",
      "a mismatched controlled sample is rejected"
    )
    assert_error_matching(
      assert_identical_estimation_rows(c("a", "b", "c"), c("a", "b"), "k"),
      "did not retain the comparator",
      "an extra row is rejected"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  known_coefficient_recovered_under_both_fe = function() {
    beta <- 0.05
    panel <- fixture_model_panel("sales", beta_post = beta)
    for (fe in names(MODEL_FE)) {
      res <- fit_cell(panel, "sales", "headline", fe, "post")
      assert_true(
        res$cell$status == "estimated",
        paste("post cell estimated under", fe)
      )
      assert_true(
        abs(res$cell$estimate - beta) < 1e-3,
        sprintf(
          "near:post recovered under %s (got %.5f)",
          fe,
          res$cell$estimate
        )
      )
      assert_true(
        res$cell$term == "near:post" &&
          res$cell$nobs == nrow(panel) &&
          res$cell$n_removed_by_estimator == 0,
        "term name and full retention"
      )
      assert_true(
        res$cell$n_near_properties == 20 &&
          res$cell$n_far_properties == 20 &&
          res$cell$n_properties_both_sides_event == 40 &&
          res$cell$n_clusters == 8,
        "sample support counts"
      )
      assert_true(
        is.finite(res$cell$std_error) &&
          res$cell$conf_low < beta &&
          res$cell$conf_high > beta,
        "interval covers beta"
      )
    }
    gamma <- 0.03
    panel_articles <- fixture_model_panel(
      "sales",
      beta_post = 0,
      beta_articles = gamma
    )
    for (fe in names(MODEL_FE)) {
      res <- fit_cell(panel_articles, "sales", "headline", fe, "log_articles")
      assert_true(
        res$cell$status == "estimated" && abs(res$cell$estimate - gamma) < 1e-3,
        sprintf(
          "near:log_articles recovered under %s (got %.5f)",
          fe,
          res$cell$estimate
        )
      )
    }
    TRUE
  },

  no_contrast_or_collinear_focal_is_unidentified = function() {
    all_near <- fit_cell(
      fixture_model_panel("sales", near_rule = "all_near"),
      "sales",
      "headline",
      "property_month",
      "post"
    )
    assert_true(
      all_near$cell$status == "unidentified" &&
        grepl("no far", all_near$cell$reason) &&
        is.na(all_near$cell$estimate),
      "all-near sample is unidentified with a cause, not zero"
    )
    all_far <- fit_cell(
      fixture_model_panel("sales", near_rule = "all_far"),
      "sales",
      "headline",
      "property_month",
      "post"
    )
    assert_true(
      all_far$cell$status == "unidentified" &&
        grepl("no near", all_far$cell$reason) &&
        is.na(all_far$cell$estimate),
      "all-far sample is unidentified"
    )
    pre_only <- fixture_model_panel("sales")[post == 0L]
    collinear <- fit_cell(
      pre_only,
      "sales",
      "headline",
      "property_month",
      "post"
    )
    assert_true(
      collinear$cell$status == "unidentified" &&
        grepl("collinear", collinear$cell$reason) &&
        is.na(collinear$cell$estimate),
      "focal term without variation is unidentified (collinear), not zero"
    )
    empty <- fit_cell(
      fixture_model_panel("sales")[0L],
      "sales",
      "headline",
      "property_month",
      "post"
    )
    assert_true(
      empty$cell$status == "unsupported_sample",
      "empty sample is unsupported"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  absorbed_by_full_fe_diagnosed_and_concentration_descriptive = function() {
    panel <- fixture_model_panel("sales", near_rule = "msoa")
    loose <- fit_cell(panel, "sales", "headline", "property_month", "post")
    tight <- fit_cell(
      panel,
      "sales",
      "headline",
      "property_month_msoa_year",
      "post"
    )
    assert_true(
      loose$cell$status == "estimated" &&
        abs(loose$cell$estimate - 0.05) < 1e-3 &&
        loose$cell$n_near_properties == 20 &&
        loose$cell$n_far_properties == 20,
      "abundant near/far rows: estimated under property + month"
    )
    assert_true(
      tight$cell$status == "unidentified" &&
        grepl("collinear", tight$cell$reason),
      "near varying only across MSOA-years is absorbed by MSOA x year and diagnosed"
    )
    balanced <- fit_cell(
      fixture_model_panel("sales"),
      "sales",
      "headline",
      "property_month",
      "post"
    )
    concentrated <- fit_cell(
      fixture_model_panel("sales", near_rule = "one_lsoa"),
      "sales",
      "headline",
      "property_month",
      "post"
    )
    assert_true(
      concentrated$cell$status == "estimated" &&
        abs(concentrated$cell$estimate - 0.05) < 1e-3 &&
        concentrated$cell$nobs == nrow(panel),
      "concentrated contrast is estimated on the full sample (no exclusion)"
    )
    assert_true(
      concentrated$support$largest_cluster_share >
        balanced$support$largest_cluster_share &&
        concentrated$support$lsoa_share_top1 ==
          concentrated$support$largest_cluster_share &&
        concentrated$support$n_clusters == 8 &&
        concentrated$support$ratio > 0 &&
        concentrated$support$ratio <= 1,
      "residual support reports the concentration descriptively"
    )
    by_year <- concentrated$support_by_year
    assert_true(
      abs(sum(by_year$share) - 1) < 1e-8 && all(by_year$year %in% panel$year),
      "year shares sum to one"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  absorbed_controls_and_inference_unavailable_distinguished = function() {
    panel <- fixture_model_panel("sales")
    controlled <- fit_cell(
      panel,
      "sales",
      "complete_case_controls",
      "property_month",
      "post",
      market_config("sales")$control_cols
    )
    assert_true(
      controlled$cell$status == "estimated" &&
        abs(controlled$cell$estimate - 0.05) < 1e-3,
      "absorbed controls leave the focal coefficient identified"
    )
    # Coefficient-level count: old_new (one level, dropped before fitting), three property_type
    # dummies and durationL are all constant within property.
    assert_true(
      controlled$cell$n_controls_absorbed == 5 &&
        "old_new" %in% controlled$model$controls_absorbed &&
        "durationL" %in% controlled$model$controls_absorbed &&
        sum(grepl("^property_type", controlled$model$controls_absorbed)) == 3,
      "old_new, the type dummies and duration are recorded as absorbed"
    )
    one_cluster <- fit_cell(
      fixture_model_panel("sales", single_lsoa = TRUE),
      "sales",
      "headline",
      "property_month",
      "post"
    )
    assert_true(
      one_cluster$cell$status == "estimated_inference_unavailable" &&
        abs(one_cluster$cell$estimate - 0.05) < 1e-3 &&
        is.na(one_cluster$cell$std_error) &&
        is.na(one_cluster$cell$conf_low) &&
        grepl("covariance", one_cluster$cell$reason),
      "single cluster: coefficient kept, inference unavailable"
    )
    assert_true(
      is.null(one_cluster$model$vcov) && !is.null(one_cluster$support),
      "no vcov stored; residual support still computed"
    )
    unidentified <- fit_cell(
      fixture_model_panel("sales", near_rule = "all_near"),
      "sales",
      "headline",
      "property_month",
      "post"
    )
    assert_true(
      unidentified$cell$status != one_cluster$cell$status,
      "unidentified is distinct from inference-unavailable"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  intervals_and_joint_test_reuse_stored_vcov_and_df = function() {
    panel <- fixture_model_panel("sales")
    res <- fit_cell(
      panel,
      "sales",
      "headline",
      "property_month_msoa_year",
      "post"
    )
    V <- res$model$vcov
    se <- sqrt(V["near:post", "near:post"])
    df <- attr(V, "df.t")
    assert_true(
      identical(as.numeric(df), res$cell$t_df) &&
        res$model$t_df == res$cell$t_df,
      "stored df matches the cell"
    )
    assert_true(
      abs(res$cell$std_error - se) < 1e-12 &&
        abs(
          res$cell$conf_low - (res$cell$estimate - stats::qt(0.975, df) * se)
        ) <
          1e-12 &&
        abs(
          res$cell$conf_high - (res$cell$estimate + stats::qt(0.975, df) * se)
        ) <
          1e-12,
      "interval recomputed from the stored vcov and df"
    )
    assert_true(
      !is.null(res$model$ssc) && identical(res$model$ssc, attr(V, "ssc")),
      "ssc recorded with the vcov"
    )
    assert_true(
      abs(res$cell$p_value - 2 * stats::pt(-abs(res$cell$estimate / se), df)) <
        1e-12,
      "p-value uses the same df"
    )
    prof <- fit_profile(panel, "sales", "property_month")$profile
    assert_true(
      prof$joint_test$status == "available",
      "joint test available on the fixture"
    )
    terms <- profile_term(CONFIG$profile_joint_years)
    b <- prof$coefficients$estimate[match(terms, prof$coefficients$term)]
    Vb <- prof$vcov[terms, terms]
    stat <- as.numeric(crossprod(b, solve(Vb, b))) / 5
    assert_true(
      abs(stat - prof$joint_test$statistic) < 1e-10 &&
        prof$joint_test$df1 == 5 &&
        prof$joint_test$df2 == prof$t_df &&
        abs(
          prof$joint_test$p_value -
            stats::pf(stat, 5, prof$t_df, lower.tail = FALSE)
        ) <
          1e-12,
      "joint statistic and p-value recomputed from the stored vcov and df"
    )
    row <- prof$coefficients[prof$coefficients$year == 2023L, ]
    assert_true(
      abs(
        row$conf_low -
          (row$estimate - stats::qt(0.975, prof$t_df) * row$std_error)
      ) <
        1e-12,
      "profile intervals use the same df"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  short_window_recomputed_with_long_run_articles = function() {
    panel <- fixture_model_panel("sales")
    extra <- panel[repeat_id == "p001" & month_index %in% c(61L, 109L)]
    extra[, repeat_id := "p999"][, id := c("t99991", "t99992")]
    panel <- data.table::rbindlist(list(panel, extra))
    entry <- fixture_model_entry(panel, "sales")
    vs <- build_variant_samples(entry, "sales", market_config("sales"))
    sw <- vs$variants$short_window
    assert_true(
      all(panel$date[sw] >= CONFIG$short_window_start),
      "short window keeps 2021 onward only"
    )
    assert_true(
      !"p999" %chin% panel$repeat_id[sw],
      "a property with one surviving date drops when repeats are recomputed"
    )
    assert_true(
      "t99992" %chin% panel$id[which(panel$date >= CONFIG$short_window_start)],
      "p999 had a row in the window before the recount"
    )
    steps <- vs$ledger$step[vs$ledger$variant == "short_window"]
    assert_true(
      identical(
        steps,
        c(
          "variant:short_window:date_from_start",
          "variant:short_window:recompute_repeats"
        )
      ),
      "short-window ledger steps"
    )
    assert_true(
      vs$ledger$n_rows_removed[
        vs$ledger$step == "variant:short_window:recompute_repeats"
      ] ==
        1,
      "exactly p999's row leaves at the recount"
    )
    cal <- entry$calendar
    assert_true(
      isTRUE(vs$metadata$short_window$article_values_match_long_run) &&
        all(
          panel$log_articles[sw] ==
            cal$log_articles[match(panel$month_index[sw], cal$month_index)]
        ),
      "short-window article values equal the long-run calendar"
    )
    tampered <- data.table::copy(panel)
    tampered[
      date >= CONFIG$short_window_start,
      log_articles := log_articles + 0.1
    ]
    assert_error_matching(
      build_variant_samples(
        fixture_model_entry(tampered, "sales"),
        "sales",
        market_config("sales")
      ),
      "differ from the long-run calendar",
      "a different article stock in the short window stops the run"
    )
    res <- fit_cell(
      panel[sw],
      "sales",
      "short_window",
      "property_month",
      "post"
    )
    assert_true(
      res$cell$status == "estimated" && abs(res$cell$estimate - 0.05) < 1e-3,
      "short-window cell estimated"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  profiles_omit_reference_and_joint_test_full_restriction = function() {
    panel <- fixture_model_panel("sales")
    for (fe in names(MODEL_FE)) {
      prof <- fit_profile(panel, "sales", fe)$profile
      assert_true(
        prof$status == "estimated" && !2019L %in% prof$coefficients$year,
        paste("2019 omitted as reference under", fe)
      )
      assert_true(
        setequal(prof$coefficients$year, c(2014:2018, 2022:2023)) &&
          all(prof$coefficients$available),
        "every non-reference year reported and available"
      )
      assert_true(
        prof$joint_test$status == "available" &&
          identical(prof$joint_test$years, 2014:2018) &&
          prof$joint_test$df1 == 5,
        "joint test covers exactly 2014-2018"
      )
      assert_true(
        abs(
          prof$coefficients$estimate[prof$coefficients$year == 2023L] - 0.05
        ) <
          1e-3 &&
          all(
            abs(prof$coefficients$estimate[prof$coefficients$year < 2019L]) <
              1e-3
          ),
        "annual contrasts recover the DGP"
      )
      assert_true(prof$joint_test$p_value > 0.001, "no early gap in the DGP")
    }
    # One requested coefficient unavailable: no near observation in 2016.
    reduced <- panel[!(year == 2016L & near == 1L)]
    prof <- fit_profile(reduced, "sales", "property_month")$profile
    assert_true(
      prof$status == "estimated",
      "profile still estimated with one year unavailable"
    )
    assert_true(
      !prof$coefficients$available[prof$coefficients$year == 2016L] &&
        is.na(prof$coefficients$estimate[prof$coefficients$year == 2016L]),
      "2016 contrast unavailable"
    )
    assert_true(
      all(prof$coefficients$available[prof$coefficients$year != 2016L]),
      "other contrasts retained"
    )
    assert_true(
      prof$joint_test$status == "unavailable" &&
        grepl("year::2016:near", prof$joint_test$reason) &&
        is.na(prof$joint_test$p_value),
      "full joint test unavailable rather than a reduced test"
    )
    # Non-positive-definite covariance block makes the full test unavailable.
    good <- fit_profile(panel, "sales", "property_month")
    coefs <- stats::coef(good$model$fit)
    V <- good$model$vcov
    bad <- V
    terms <- profile_term(2014:2018)
    bad[terms[2], ] <- bad[terms[1], ]
    bad[, terms[2]] <- bad[, terms[1]]
    Xd <- matrix(
      stats::rnorm(length(coefs) * 50),
      ncol = length(coefs),
      dimnames = list(NULL, names(coefs))
    )
    test <- joint_test(coefs, bad, good$profile$t_df, Xd, 2014:2018)
    assert_true(
      test$status == "unavailable" && grepl("positive definite", test$reason),
      "non-PD covariance block is refused"
    )
    rank_deficient <- Xd
    rank_deficient[, terms[2]] <- rank_deficient[, terms[1]]
    test2 <- joint_test(coefs, V, good$profile$t_df, rank_deficient, 2014:2018)
    assert_true(
      test2$status == "unavailable" && grepl("rank", test2$reason),
      "rank-deficient annual matrix is refused"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  driver_grid_complete_blocked_articles_and_samples_reconcile = function() {
    panel <- fixture_model_panel("sales")
    out <- estimate_market_models(
      fixture_model_entry(panel, "sales"),
      "sales",
      market_config("sales"),
      verbose = FALSE
    )
    assert_model_grid_complete(out$cells, out$profiles, "sales")
    assert_true(
      nrow(out$cells) == 20L &&
        length(out$profiles) == 2L &&
        nrow(out$fit_log) == 22L,
      "20 scalar cells, 2 profiles, 22 log rows"
    )
    assert_true(
      all(out$cells$status == "estimated"),
      "every fixture cell estimated"
    )
    assert_true(
      identical(out$cells$model_key, model_grid("sales")$model_key),
      "sequential variant -> FE -> attention order"
    )
    for (key in out$cells$model_key) {
      assert_true(
        length(out$samples$estimated[[key]]) ==
          out$cells$nobs[out$cells$model_key == key],
        paste("estimated rows reconcile:", key)
      )
      assert_true(
        all(out$samples$estimated[[key]] %in% seq_along(out$samples$ids)),
        "estimated indices point into the dictionary"
      )
      assert_true(
        !is.null(out$models[[key]]$fit) &&
          as.numeric(utils::object.size(out$models[[key]])) < 2e6,
        "compact model stored"
      )
      assert_true(
        is.null(out$models[[key]]$fit$X_demeaned) &&
          is.null(out$models[[key]]$fit$residuals),
        "large elements stripped"
      )
      ct <- fixest::coeftable(out$models[[key]]$fit)
      term <- out$cells$term[out$cells$model_key == key]
      assert_true(
        abs(
          ct[term, "Estimate"] - out$cells$estimate[out$cells$model_key == key]
        ) <
          1e-12 &&
          abs(
            ct[term, "Std. Error"] -
              out$cells$std_error[out$cells$model_key == key]
          ) <
            1e-12,
        "compact model reproduces the coefficient table"
      )
    }
    assert_true(
      nrow(out$residual_support) == 20L &&
        all(out$residual_support$model_key %in% out$cells$model_key),
      "residual support for every estimated cell"
    )
    assert_true(all(out$fit_log$seconds >= 0), "timings recorded")
    assert_variant_ledger_identity(
      out$ledger,
      nrow(panel),
      length(out$samples$variants$complete_case)
    )
    # Blocked article calendar: article cells blocked, post cells and profiles unaffected.
    blocked_calendar <- fixture_model_calendar("sales", blocked = TRUE)
    blocked_panel <- fixture_model_panel("sales", calendar = blocked_calendar)
    assert_true(
      all(is.na(blocked_panel$log_articles)) &&
        all(blocked_panel$post == panel$post),
      "blocked calendar: articles NA, post intact"
    )
    blocked <- estimate_market_models(
      fixture_model_entry(blocked_panel, "sales", blocked_calendar),
      "sales",
      market_config("sales"),
      verbose = FALSE
    )
    articles <- blocked$cells[blocked$cells$attention == "log_articles", ]
    assert_true(
      all(articles$status == "blocked_input") &&
        all(grepl("article", articles$reason)),
      "article cells blocked with the calendar reason"
    )
    assert_true(
      all(
        blocked$cells$status[blocked$cells$attention == "post"] == "estimated"
      ),
      "post cells estimated when articles are blocked"
    )
    assert_true(
      all(
        vapply(blocked$profiles, function(p) p$status, character(1)) ==
          "estimated"
      ),
      "profiles unaffected by blocked articles"
    )
    # Blocked market: every key blocked_input.
    market_blocked <- blocked_cells_for_market(
      "rentals",
      "mapping validation failed"
    )
    assert_true(
      nrow(market_blocked$cells) == 20L &&
        all(market_blocked$cells$status == "blocked_input") &&
        length(market_blocked$profiles) == 2L &&
        all(
          vapply(market_blocked$profiles, function(p) p$status, character(1)) ==
            "blocked_input"
        ),
      "blocked market yields 20 + 2 blocked keys"
    )
    assert_model_grid_complete(
      market_blocked$cells,
      market_blocked$profiles,
      "rentals"
    )
    assert_error_matching(
      assert_model_grid_complete(out$cells[-1L, ], out$profiles, "sales"),
      "expected 20 keys",
      "a missing key fails the grid check"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  unexpected_inference_error_stops_but_covariance_failure_keeps_coefficient = function() {
    panel <- fixture_model_panel("sales")
    boom <- function(fit) stop("boom: unexpected")
    assert_error_matching(
      fit_cell(
        panel,
        "sales",
        "headline",
        "property_month",
        "post",
        summariser = boom
      ),
      "Inference error for sales__headline__property_month__post: boom: unexpected",
      "an unexpected summariser error stops the run with the model key"
    )
    assert_error_matching(
      fit_profile(panel, "sales", "property_month", summariser = boom),
      "Inference error for sales__headline__property_month__profile: boom",
      "the profile stops too"
    )
    vcov_fail <- function(fit) stop("infinite or missing values in 'x'")
    res <- fit_cell(
      panel,
      "sales",
      "headline",
      "property_month",
      "post",
      summariser = vcov_fail
    )
    assert_true(
      res$cell$status == "estimated_inference_unavailable" &&
        abs(res$cell$estimate - 0.05) < 1e-3 &&
        is.na(res$cell$std_error) &&
        is.na(res$cell$conf_low) &&
        is.na(res$cell$p_value) &&
        grepl("infinite or missing values", res$cell$reason),
      "a covariance failure keeps the coefficient and records why inference is unavailable"
    )
    assert_true(
      is.null(res$model$vcov) &&
        is.null(res$model$ssc) &&
        !is.null(res$support) &&
        res$cell$nobs == nrow(panel),
      "no vcov stored; residual support and sample counts still computed"
    )
    prof <- fit_profile(
      panel,
      "sales",
      "property_month",
      summariser = vcov_fail
    )$profile
    assert_true(
      prof$status == "estimated_inference_unavailable" &&
        all(prof$coefficients$available) &&
        all(is.na(prof$coefficients$std_error)) &&
        prof$joint_test$status == "unavailable" &&
        grepl("covariance unavailable", prof$joint_test$reason) &&
        is.null(prof$vcov),
      "the profile keeps its annual estimates; intervals and the joint test are unavailable"
    )
    covered <- c(
      "Matrix is singular",
      "The matrix is not positive definite",
      "not positive-definite",
      "only one cluster",
      "Degrees of freedom are not finite",
      "vcov could not be computed",
      "eigen() failed",
      "NA/NaN/Inf in foreign function call",
      "non-conformable arguments",
      "Lapack routine dgesv: system is exactly singular"
    )
    assert_true(
      all(grepl(
        VCOV_UNAVAILABLE_PATTERN,
        covered,
        perl = TRUE,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      )),
      "covariance messages are classified"
    )
    unrelated <- c("boom: unexpected", "object 'lsoa' not found")
    assert_true(
      !any(grepl(
        VCOV_UNAVAILABLE_PATTERN,
        unrelated,
        perl = TRUE,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      )),
      "unrelated messages are not classified as covariance failures"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  estimator_singleton_removal_reconciles_samples = function() {
    panel <- fixture_model_panel("sales")
    # p041: two dates in its own MSOA, one observation per (MSOA, year), so both rows are
    # singleton cells under msoa^year and the estimator removes them; property + month keeps them.
    extra <- panel[repeat_id == "p001" & month_index %in% c(61L, 109L)]
    extra[, `:=`(
      repeat_id = "p041",
      id = c("t99991", "t99992"),
      msoa = "E02000099",
      lsoa = "E01000099",
      easting = 400041
    )]
    panel <- data.table::rbindlist(list(panel, extra))
    out <- estimate_market_models(
      fixture_model_entry(panel, "sales"),
      "sales",
      market_config("sales"),
      verbose = FALSE
    )
    for (attention in MODEL_ATTENTION) {
      loose <- out$cells[
        out$cells$model_key ==
          model_key("sales", "headline", "property_month", attention),
      ]
      tight <- out$cells[
        out$cells$model_key ==
          model_key("sales", "headline", "property_month_msoa_year", attention),
      ]
      assert_true(
        loose$status == "estimated" &&
          loose$nobs == nrow(panel) &&
          loose$n_removed_by_estimator == 0,
        "property + month keeps every row"
      )
      assert_true(
        tight$status == "estimated" &&
          tight$nobs == nrow(panel) - 2 &&
          tight$n_removed_by_estimator == 2 &&
          tight$n_properties == 40,
        "MSOA x year drops the two singleton rows"
      )
      key <- tight$model_key
      retained <- out$samples$estimated[[key]]
      assert_true(
        length(retained) == tight$nobs &&
          !any(out$samples$ids[retained] %in% c("t99991", "t99992")),
        "retained rows reconcile with nobs and exclude the removed rows"
      )
      assert_true(
        any(grepl("singleton", out$models[[key]]$warnings)),
        "the estimator's singleton note is recorded"
      )
      comparator <- model_key(
        "sales",
        "complete_case",
        "property_month_msoa_year",
        attention
      )
      controlled <- model_key(
        "sales",
        "complete_case_controls",
        "property_month_msoa_year",
        attention
      )
      assert_true(
        setequal(
          out$samples$estimated[[comparator]],
          out$samples$estimated[[controlled]]
        ) &&
          out$cells$nobs[out$cells$model_key == controlled] == tight$nobs &&
          out$cells$n_removed_by_estimator[out$cells$model_key == controlled] ==
            0,
        "the controlled fit uses exactly the comparator's retained rows and removes nothing further"
      )
    }
    step <- out$ledger[
      out$ledger$step ==
        "variant:complete_case_controls:property_month_msoa_year:comparator_estimation_rows",
    ]
    assert_true(
      nrow(step) == 1L && step$n_rows_removed == 2 && step$n_groups_after == 40,
      "the comparator-rows ledger step records the estimator's removal"
    )
    compressed <- compress_samples(list(sales = out$samples))
    assert_samples_roundtrip(list(sales = out$samples), compressed)
    assert_true(
      identical(
        compressed$sales$estimated[[key]]$removed,
        which(out$samples$ids %in% c("t99991", "t99992"))
      ),
      "the compressed sample stores exactly the removed rows"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  absorbed_controls_leave_residual_support_unchanged = function() {
    panel <- fixture_model_panel("sales")
    plain <- fit_cell(panel, "sales", "complete_case", "property_month", "post")
    controlled <- fit_cell(
      panel,
      "sales",
      "complete_case_controls",
      "property_month",
      "post",
      market_config("sales")$control_cols
    )
    assert_true(
      controlled$cell$status == "estimated" &&
        length(controlled$model$controls_absorbed) == 5L &&
        identical(controlled$retained, plain$retained),
      "every control is absorbed on identical rows"
    )
    assert_true(
      abs(controlled$support$rss - plain$support$rss) <=
        1e-8 * plain$support$rss &&
        abs(controlled$support$ratio - plain$support$ratio) <= 1e-10 &&
        abs(
          controlled$support$lsoa_share_top1 - plain$support$lsoa_share_top1
        ) <=
          1e-10,
      "absorbed controls do not change the residual support"
    )
    assert_true(
      abs(controlled$cell$estimate - plain$cell$estimate) < 1e-10,
      "absorbed controls leave the coefficient unchanged"
    )
    TRUE
  }
)

# ---- U4 fixtures ------------------------------------------------------------------

# Two tiny binary inputs whose content hashes stand in for the parquet provenance;
# `fixture_expected_inputs` is what load_bundle() must expect of a fixture bundle.
fixture_expected_inputs <- c("fixture_a", "fixture_b")

fixture_bundle_inputs <- function(dir) {
  paths <- file.path(dir, c("input_a.bin", "input_b.bin"))
  writeBin(as.raw(1:64), paths[[1L]])
  writeBin(as.raw(101:164), paths[[2L]])
  tibble::tibble(
    input = c("fixture_a", "fixture_b"),
    path = paths,
    content_hash = vapply(
      paths,
      hash_file_content,
      character(1),
      USE.NAMES = FALSE
    ),
    generation_id = c("g1", NA_character_),
    n_rows = c(64, 64),
    columns_used = "bytes",
    mtime = format(file.info(paths)$mtime, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", tz = "UTC")
  )
}

fixture_market_samples <- function(n = 10L) {
  ids <- sprintf("t%03d", seq_len(n))
  variants <- list(
    headline = seq_len(n),
    exclude_changes = seq_len(n - 2L),
    complete_case = seq_len(n),
    complete_case_controls = seq_len(n),
    short_window = seq.int(n - 5L, n)
  )
  metadata <- lapply(variants, function(idx) {
    list(n_rows = length(idx), n_properties = length(idx) %/% 2L)
  })
  profile <- empty_profile_samples()
  profile$n_rows <- n
  profile$start <- "2014-01-01"
  profile$end <- "2024-12-31"
  profile$metadata <- list(n_rows = n, n_properties = n %/% 2L)
  list(
    ids = ids,
    variants = variants,
    estimated = list(),
    metadata = metadata,
    profile = profile
  )
}

# A separate profile membership over `n` rows whose first ids coincide with the
# scalar dictionary positions (row positions overlap, ids do not all match).
fixture_separate_profile_samples <- function(s, n = 14L) {
  s$profile$panel <- "separate"
  s$profile$ids <- c(sprintf("t%03d", seq_len(3L)), sprintf("e%03d", seq_len(n - 3L)))
  s$profile$n_rows <- n
  s$profile$start <- "1995-01-01"
  s$profile$end <- "2024-12-31"
  s$profile$metadata <- list(n_rows = n, n_properties = n %/% 2L)
  s
}

# A complete synthetic bundle: every scalar key estimated (or the article cells blocked),
# retained rows = the variant input less its last row, models carrying only nobs.
fixture_bundle <- function(
  dir = tempfile("bundle-fixture-"),
  article_blocked = FALSE
) {
  dir.create(dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  inputs <- fixture_bundle_inputs(dir)
  grid <- model_grid()
  samples <- list()
  cells <- list()
  models <- list()
  profiles <- list()
  fit_log <- list()
  calendars <- list()
  for (m in MARKETS) {
    s <- fixture_market_samples()
    calendars[[m]] <- fixture_model_calendar(m, blocked = article_blocked)
    rows <- grid[grid$market == m, ]
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(rows))) {
      key <- rows$model_key[[i]]
      input <- s$variants[[rows$variant[[i]]]]
      if (article_blocked && rows$attention[[i]] == "log_articles") {
        cells[[key]] <- empty_cell(
          m,
          rows$variant[[i]],
          rows$fe[[i]],
          rows$attention[[i]],
          "blocked_input",
          "article cells blocked: fixture coverage unavailable"
        )
        s$estimated[[key]] <- integer()
        models[key] <- list(NULL)
      } else {
        retained <- input[-length(input)]
        cell <- empty_cell(
          m,
          rows$variant[[i]],
          rows$fe[[i]],
          rows$attention[[i]],
          "estimated"
        )
        cell$estimate <- 0.01 * i
        cell$std_error <- 0.004
        cell$t_df <- 7
        cell$conf_low <- cell$estimate - 0.01
        cell$conf_high <- cell$estimate + 0.01
        cell$p_value <- 0.05
        cell$nobs <- length(retained)
        cell$n_properties <- length(retained) %/% 2
        cell$n_clusters <- 4
        cell$n_near_properties <- 2
        cell$n_far_properties <- 3
        cell$n_properties_both_sides_event <- 2
        cell$n_removed_by_estimator <- 1
        cell$n_controls_absorbed <- 0
        cells[[key]] <- cell
        s$estimated[[key]] <- retained
        models[[key]] <- list(
          model_key = key,
          nobs = length(retained),
          status = "estimated"
        )
      }
      fit_log[[key]] <- tibble::tibble(
        market = m,
        model_key = key,
        status = cells[[key]]$status,
        seconds = 0.1,
        peak_gc_mb = 1
      )
    }
    for (fe in names(MODEL_FE)) {
      key <- profile_key(m, fe)
      retained <- s$variants$headline[-length(s$variants$headline)]
      p <- empty_profile(m, fe, "estimated")
      years <- setdiff(2014:2024, CONFIG$profile_reference_year)
      p$coefficients <- tibble::tibble(
        year = years,
        term = sprintf("year::%d:near", years),
        estimate = 0.001 * seq_along(years),
        std_error = 0.002,
        t_df = 7,
        conf_low = 0.001 * seq_along(years) - 0.005,
        conf_high = 0.001 * seq_along(years) + 0.005,
        p_value = 0.3,
        available = TRUE
      )
      p$joint_test <- list(
        status = "available",
        statistic = 1.2,
        df1 = 5,
        df2 = 7,
        p_value = 0.4,
        reason = NA_character_,
        years = CONFIG$profile_joint_years,
        rank = 5L
      )
      p$nobs <- length(retained)
      p$n_properties <- 4L
      p$n_clusters <- 4L
      p$n_removed_by_estimator <- 1L
      profiles[[key]] <- p
      s$profile$estimated[[key]] <- retained
      models[[key]] <- list(
        model_key = key,
        nobs = length(retained),
        status = "estimated"
      )
      fit_log[[key]] <- tibble::tibble(
        market = m,
        model_key = key,
        status = "estimated",
        seconds = 0.1,
        peak_gc_mb = 1
      )
    }
    samples[[m]] <- s
  }
  cells <- dplyr::bind_rows(cells)
  readiness <- lapply(MARKETS, function(m) {
    list(
      market = m,
      status = "ready",
      reason = NA_character_,
      n_rows_pre_band = 10,
      n_groups_pre_band = 5,
      runtime_seconds = 1,
      peak_memory_mb = 1
    )
  })
  names(readiness) <- MARKETS
  market_data <- lapply(MARKETS, function(m) {
    list(
      market = m,
      status = "ready",
      reason = NA_character_,
      runtime_seconds = 1,
      exposure_summary = list(
        change_prevalence = tibble::tibble(
          band = c("near", "far"),
          change_flag = "any_change",
          n_properties = c(2, 3),
          n_changed = c(0, 1),
          share_changed = c(0, 1 / 3)
        )
      ),
      distance_summary_all = tibble::tibble(
        n_unique_coordinates = 5,
        n_rows = 10
      )
    )
  })
  names(market_data) <- MARKETS
  site_projection <- list(
    projection = tibble::tibble(
      site_id = 1:2,
      easting = c(400000, 403000),
      northing = 300000,
      usable = TRUE
    ),
    years = CONFIG$crosswalk_years,
    n_sites = 2L,
    n_usable = 2L,
    n_unusable = 0L,
    unusable_site_ids = integer(),
    n_water_companies = 1L,
    n_crosswalk_rows = 8L,
    provenance = tibble::tibble()
  )
  bundle <- assemble_bundle(
    site_projection = site_projection,
    article_validation = list(status = "passed"),
    article_evidence = list(
      status = if (article_blocked) "unavailable" else "established",
      files = tibble::tibble()
    ),
    attention_calendars = calendars,
    input_provenance = inputs,
    readiness = readiness,
    observation_diagnostics = list(sales = NULL, rentals = NULL),
    exclusion_ledger = new_ledger(),
    variant_ledger = new_variant_ledger(),
    market_data = market_data,
    cells = cells,
    profiles = profiles,
    residual_support = empty_residual_support(),
    residual_support_by_year = tibble::tibble(
      model_key = character(),
      year = integer(),
      share = numeric()
    ),
    samples = samples,
    models = models,
    fit_log = dplyr::bind_rows(fit_log),
    fixture_checks = tibble::tibble(
      unit = "u4",
      scenario = "fixture",
      passed = TRUE
    ),
    runtime = list(total_seconds = 1, peak_memory_note = "fixture"),
    fingerprint = compute_fingerprint(inputs, rehash = TRUE)
  )
  complete_bundle(bundle)
}

# Copy of the report source with `edit(lines)` applied.
fixture_qmd_copy <- function(edit) {
  lines <- readLines(report_qmd_path(), warn = FALSE)
  path <- tempfile("qmd-copy-", fileext = ".qmd")
  writeLines(edit(lines), path)
  path
}

chunk_label_lines <- function(lines) {
  labels <- sub("^#\\|\\s*label:\\s*", "", lines)
  labels[!grepl("^#\\|\\s*label:", lines)] <- NA_character_
  trimws(labels)
}

FIXTURE_CHECKS$u4 <- list(
  fingerprint_input_content_change_with_same_size_and_mtime = function() {
    dir <- tempfile("inputs-")
    dir.create(dir)
    inputs <- fixture_bundle_inputs(dir)
    stamp <- as.POSIXct("2026-01-01 00:00:00", tz = "UTC")
    Sys.setFileTime(inputs$path, stamp)
    saved <- compute_fingerprint(inputs, rehash = TRUE)
    writeBin(as.raw(64:1), inputs$path[[1L]])
    Sys.setFileTime(inputs$path[[1L]], stamp)
    info <- file.info(inputs$path[[1L]])
    assert_true(
      info$size == 64 && abs(as.numeric(info$mtime) - as.numeric(stamp)) < 1,
      "size and mtime preserved by the replacement"
    )
    current <- compute_fingerprint(inputs, rehash = TRUE)
    assert_true(
      saved$inputs[["fixture_a"]] != current$inputs[["fixture_a"]] &&
        saved$combined != current$combined,
      "replaced input content changes the fingerprint despite identical size and mtime"
    )
    assert_true(
      identical(
        fingerprint_differences(saved, current),
        "input `fixture_a` (content changed)"
      ),
      "the changed input is named"
    )
    unlink(inputs$path[[2L]])
    missing <- compute_fingerprint(inputs, rehash = TRUE)
    assert_true(
      any(grepl(
        "input `fixture_b` \\(now missing or unreadable\\)",
        fingerprint_differences(saved, missing)
      )),
      "a missing input is reported by name"
    )
    TRUE
  },
  fingerprint_code_change_invalidates = function() {
    saved <- code_fingerprint()
    edited <- fixture_qmd_copy(function(lines) {
      at <- which(chunk_label_lines(lines) == "helpers-inputs")[[1L]]
      append(lines, "fixture_marker <- 1  # computational edit", after = at)
    })
    current <- code_fingerprint(edited)
    assert_true(
      saved$hash != current$hash,
      "an edit inside a computational chunk changes the code hash"
    )
    assert_true(
      identical(
        differing_names(saved$parts, current$parts),
        "chunk:helpers-inputs"
      ),
      "only the edited chunk differs"
    )
    helper_copy <- tempfile("hash_utils-", fileext = ".R")
    writeLines(
      c(
        readLines(helper_file_paths()[["hash_utils.R"]], warn = FALSE),
        "# edited helper"
      ),
      helper_copy
    )
    paths <- helper_file_paths()
    paths[["hash_utils.R"]] <- helper_copy
    helper_changed <- code_fingerprint(helper_paths = paths)
    assert_true(
      saved$hash != helper_changed$hash &&
        identical(
          differing_names(saved$parts, helper_changed$parts),
          "helper:hash_utils.R"
        ),
      "an edited sourced helper changes the code hash and is named"
    )
    dir <- tempfile("inputs-")
    dir.create(dir)
    inputs <- fixture_bundle_inputs(dir)
    diffs <- fingerprint_differences(
      compute_fingerprint(inputs),
      compute_fingerprint(inputs, qmd_path = edited)
    )
    assert_true(
      identical(diffs, "code (chunk:helpers-inputs)"),
      "the difference report names the code component and chunk"
    )
    TRUE
  },
  fingerprint_settings_change_invalidates = function() {
    baseline <- settings_fingerprint(CONFIG)
    cfg <- CONFIG
    cfg$event_month <- CONFIG$event_month + 31
    changed <- settings_fingerprint(cfg)
    assert_true(
      baseline$hash != changed$hash &&
        identical(
          differing_names(baseline$parts, changed$parts),
          "event_month"
        ),
      "an analysis-setting change alters the settings hash and is named"
    )
    cfg <- CONFIG
    cfg$bands$near_max <- 400
    assert_true(
      identical(
        differing_names(baseline$parts, settings_fingerprint(cfg)$parts),
        "bands"
      ),
      "nested settings are attributed to their top-level key"
    )
    json <- settings_json(canonical_settings(CONFIG))
    assert_true(
      !grepl(here::here(), json, fixed = TRUE) &&
        grepl("output/regs/long_run_public_attention", json, fixed = TRUE),
      "paths are serialised project-relative"
    )
    assert_true(
      identical(settings_fingerprint(CONFIG)$hash, baseline$hash),
      "the settings hash is deterministic"
    )
    dir <- tempfile("inputs-")
    dir.create(dir)
    inputs <- fixture_bundle_inputs(dir)
    cfg <- CONFIG
    cfg$event_month <- CONFIG$event_month + 31
    diffs <- fingerprint_differences(
      compute_fingerprint(inputs),
      compute_fingerprint(inputs, config = cfg)
    )
    assert_true(
      identical(diffs, "settings (event_month)"),
      "the difference report names the settings key"
    )
    TRUE
  },
  fingerprint_prose_and_reestimate_toggle_keep_reuse = function() {
    saved <- code_fingerprint()
    labels <- chunk_label_lines(readLines(report_qmd_path(), warn = FALSE))
    display_labels <- setdiff(
      labels[!is.na(labels)],
      computational_chunk_labels()
    )
    assert_true(length(display_labels) > 0L, "the report has display chunks")
    edited <- fixture_qmd_copy(function(lines) {
      lines <- sub("^params:$", "params:", lines)
      lines[grepl(
        "^\\s*reestimate:\\s*true\\s*$",
        lines
      )] <- "  reestimate: false"
      prose <- which(grepl("^This report", lines))[[1L]]
      lines[prose] <- paste(lines[prose], "Edited prose.")
      at <- which(chunk_label_lines(lines) == display_labels[[1L]])[[1L]]
      append(lines, "display_marker <- 1  # display-only edit", after = at)
    })
    current <- code_fingerprint(edited)
    assert_true(
      identical(saved$hash, current$hash),
      "prose, display-chunk and reestimate edits leave the code hash unchanged"
    )
    assert_true(
      !"reestimate" %in% names(CONFIG),
      "the reestimate switch is not an analysis setting"
    )
    assert_true(
      identical(package_fingerprint()$hash, package_fingerprint()$hash) &&
        !any(DISPLAY_PACKAGES %in% names(package_fingerprint()$versions)),
      "display packages are outside the package fingerprint"
    )
    TRUE
  },
  missing_bundle_fails_with_regeneration_instruction = function() {
    path <- file.path(tempfile("no-bundle-"), "bundle.rds")
    err <- assert_error_matching(
      load_bundle(path, list()),
      "reestimate:true",
      "a missing bundle names the regeneration command"
    )
    assert_true(
      grepl("No saved results bundle", conditionMessage(err)),
      "the message says the bundle is missing"
    )
    TRUE
  },
  partial_bundle_fails_naming_what_is_missing = function() {
    bundle <- fixture_bundle()
    path <- tempfile("partial-", fileext = ".rds")
    saveRDS(bundle, path)
    bytes <- readBin(path, "raw", file.size(path))
    writeBin(bytes[seq_len(length(bytes) %/% 3L)], path)
    assert_error_matching(
      load_bundle(path, bundle$metadata$fingerprint),
      "could not be read.*reestimate:true",
      "a truncated bundle is rejected with the regeneration command"
    )
    saveRDS(bundle[setdiff(names(bundle), c("cells", "models"))], path)
    assert_error_matching(
      load_bundle(path, bundle$metadata$fingerprint),
      "missing components: cells, models",
      "missing components are named"
    )
    pending <- bundle
    pending$metadata$status <- "pending"
    saveRDS(pending, path)
    assert_error_matching(
      load_bundle(path, bundle$metadata$fingerprint),
      "not `complete`",
      "an unfinished bundle is rejected"
    )
    incomplete_metadata <- bundle
    incomplete_metadata$metadata$fingerprint$code <- NULL
    assert_error_matching(
      validate_bundle(incomplete_metadata),
      "fingerprint lacks: code",
      "missing fingerprint fields are named"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  interrupted_save_leaves_previous_bundle_intact = function() {
    bundle <- fixture_bundle()
    dir <- tempfile("bundle-dir-")
    dir.create(dir)
    path <- file.path(dir, "bundle.rds")
    save_bundle_atomic(bundle, path)
    before <- file.info(path)
    newer <- bundle
    newer$cells$estimate[[1L]] <- 99
    truncating_writer <- function(object, file) {
      writeBin(serialize(object, NULL)[seq_len(200L)], file)
    }
    assert_error_matching(
      save_bundle_atomic(newer, path, writer = truncating_writer),
      "previous bundle is untouched",
      "an interrupted write fails before replacement"
    )
    assert_true(
      identical(file.info(path)$size, before$size),
      "the previous bundle file is unchanged"
    )
    assert_true(
      length(list.files(dir, all.files = TRUE, no.. = TRUE)) == 1L,
      "no staged temp file is left behind"
    )
    reloaded <- load_bundle(
      path,
      bundle$metadata$fingerprint,
      expected_inputs = fixture_expected_inputs
    )
    assert_true(
      identical(reloaded$cells, bundle$cells) &&
        reloaded$cells$estimate[[1L]] != 99,
      "the previous valid bundle still loads"
    )
    invalid <- newer
    invalid$cells <- invalid$cells[-1L, ]
    assert_error_matching(
      save_bundle_atomic(invalid, path),
      "exactly once each",
      "an invalid bundle is never staged"
    )
    survivor <- load_bundle(
      path,
      bundle$metadata$fingerprint,
      expected_inputs = fixture_expected_inputs
    )
    assert_true(
      identical(survivor$cells, bundle$cells),
      "the previous bundle survives a rejected save"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  saved_bundle_reloads_identically = function() {
    bundle <- fixture_bundle()
    path <- tempfile("roundtrip-", fileext = ".rds")
    save_bundle_atomic(bundle, path)
    loaded <- load_bundle(
      path,
      function(inputs) compute_fingerprint(inputs, rehash = TRUE),
      expected_inputs = fixture_expected_inputs
    )
    assert_true(
      identical(loaded$cells, bundle$cells) &&
        identical(loaded$profiles, bundle$profiles),
      "cells and profiles reload identically"
    )
    assert_true(
      identical(expand_samples(loaded$samples), expand_samples(bundle$samples)),
      "sample membership reloads identically"
    )
    assert_true(
      identical(
        loaded$metadata$fingerprint$combined,
        bundle$metadata$fingerprint$combined
      ),
      "the fingerprint reloads"
    )
    stale <- bundle$metadata$fingerprint
    stale$inputs[["fixture_a"]] <- "0000000000000000"
    assert_error_matching(
      load_bundle(path, stale, expected_inputs = fixture_expected_inputs),
      "stale.*input `fixture_a` \\(content changed\\).*reestimate:true",
      "a fingerprint mismatch names the input and the regeneration command"
    )
    stale <- bundle$metadata$fingerprint
    stale$packages <- "different"
    stale$package_versions[["fixest"]] <- "0.0.0"
    assert_error_matching(
      load_bundle(path, stale, expected_inputs = fixture_expected_inputs),
      "packages \\(fixest",
      "a package-version mismatch names the package"
    )
    TRUE
  },
  unsupported_cells_stay_visible_in_plot_data = function() {
    bundle <- fixture_bundle()

    key <- "rentals__short_window__property_month__post"
    row <- cells$model_key == key
    cells[
      row,

        "t_df",

        "conf_high",

    cells$status[row] <- "unsupported_sample"

    assert_true(
      key %in%
        parts$unsupported$model_key &&
        identical(
          parts$unsupported$label[parts$unsupported$model_key == key],

        ),
      "the unsupported cell is in the plot data with its status label"
    )

      nrow(parts$supported) + nrow(parts$unsupported) == nrow(cells),

    )
    built <- ggplot2::ggplot_build(plot_coefficients(cells))
    text_layer <- built$data[[length(built$data)]]
    assert_true(
      any(grepl("unsupported_sample", text_layer$label)),

    )
    table <- headline_table(cells)
    assert_true(
      nrow(table) == 8L &&
        setequal(table$Market, unname(MARKET_LABELS)) &&
        all(!is.na(table$Estimate)),
      "the headline table carries the eight headline cells of both markets; the short-window cell is not among them"
    )
    headline_key <- "rentals__headline__property_month__post"
    hrow <- cells$model_key == headline_key
    cells[
      hrow,
      c(
        "estimate",
        "std_error",
        "t_df",
        "conf_low",
        "conf_high",
        "p_value",
        "nobs"
      )
    ] <- NA_real_
    cells$status[hrow] <- "unsupported_sample"
    cells$reason[hrow] <- "no rows after the variant restrictions"
    table <- headline_table(cells)
    row <- table[
      table$Market == "Rentals" &
        table$`Fixed effects` == FE_LABELS[["property_month"]] &
        table$Attention == ATTENTION_LABELS[["post"]],
    ]
    assert_true(
      nrow(table) == 8L &&
        nrow(row) == 1L &&
        row$Status == "unsupported_sample" &&
        is.na(row$Estimate) &&
        is.na(row$`95% CI`) &&

    )

  bundle_requires_profile_membership_and_current_version = function() {
    bundle <- fixture_bundle()
    assert_true(validate_bundle(bundle), "the fixture bundle validates")
    no_membership <- bundle
    no_membership$samples$sales$profile <- NULL
    assert_error_matching(

      "annual-profile membership",
      "a bundle without profile membership is refused with the reason"
    )

    old_version$metadata$bundle_version <- "1"
    assert_error_matching(
      validate_bundle(old_version),
      "bundle_version `1` does not match the expected `2`",
      "a version-1 bundle cannot be accepted as carrying extended profiles"
    )
    separate <- bundle
    separate$samples$sales <- fixture_separate_profile_samples(separate$samples$sales, n = 10L)
    separate$samples$sales$profile$estimated <- bundle$samples$sales$profile$estimated
    assert_true(validate_bundle(separate), "a separate profile dictionary validates")
    profile <- profile_key("sales", "property_month")
    assert_true(
      identical(sample_retained_ids(separate$samples$sales, profile), c("t001", "t002", "t003", sprintf("e%03d", 1:6))) &&
        identical(
          sample_retained_ids(separate$samples$sales, model_key("sales", "headline", "property_month", "post")),
          sprintf("t%03d", 1:9)
        ),
      "overlapping row positions resolve to different dictionaries"
    )
    duplicated_ids <- separate
    duplicated_ids$samples$sales$profile$ids[2L] <- "t001"
    assert_error_matching(
      validate_bundle(duplicated_ids),
      "unique ids",
      "a profile dictionary with duplicated ids is refused"
    )
    misplaced <- bundle
    misplaced$samples$sales$estimated[[profile]] <- misplaced$samples$sales$profile$estimated[[profile]]
    assert_error_matching(
      validate_bundle(misplaced),
      "wrong dictionary",
      "a profile key beside scalar keys is refused"
    )
    shared_with_ids <- bundle
    shared_with_ids$samples$rentals$profile$ids <- shared_with_ids$samples$rentals$ids
    assert_error_matching(
      validate_bundle(shared_with_ids),
      "must not carry its own dictionary",
      "a shared panel with a dictionary is refused"
    )
    TRUE
  },
  samples_compress_and_expand_identically = function() {
    s <- fixture_market_samples()
    s$estimated[["sales__headline__property_month__post"]] <- 1:9
    s$estimated[["sales__short_window__property_month__post"]] <- c(5L, 7L, 9L)
    s$profile$estimated[["sales__headline__property_month__profile"]] <- c(3L, 1L, 2L) # not a subsequence
    s$estimated[["sales__headline__property_month__log_articles"]] <- integer()
    samples <- list(sales = s)
    compressed <- compress_samples(samples)
    assert_samples_roundtrip(samples, compressed)
    e <- compressed$sales$estimated
    assert_true(
      identical(e[["sales__headline__property_month__post"]]$removed, 10L),
      "removed rows are stored for a subsequence"
    )
    assert_true(
      identical(
        compressed$sales$profile$estimated[["sales__headline__property_month__profile"]]$retained,
        c(3L, 1L, 2L)
      ),
      "a non-subsequence keeps the full index (profile membership)"
    )
    # A separate profile dictionary: profile rows resolve to their own ids even
    # where the row positions coincide with scalar positions.
    sep <- fixture_separate_profile_samples(s)
    sep$profile$estimated[["sales__headline__property_month__profile"]] <- c(1L, 2L, 4L, 14L)
    sep_compressed <- compress_samples(list(sales = sep))
    assert_samples_roundtrip(list(sales = sep), sep_compressed)
    assert_true(
      identical(
        sample_retained_ids(sep_compressed$sales, "sales__headline__property_month__profile"),
        c("t001", "t002", "e001", "e011")
      ) &&
        identical(
          sample_retained_ids(sep_compressed$sales, "sales__headline__property_month__post"),
          sprintf("t%03d", 1:9)
        ),
      "profile rows resolve against the profile dictionary, scalar rows against the scalar one"
    )
    misplaced <- s
    misplaced$estimated[["sales__headline__property_month__profile"]] <- 1:3
    assert_error_matching(
      compress_samples(list(sales = misplaced)),
      "Profile key in the scalar membership",
      "a profile key cannot be stored beside scalar keys"
    )
    sep$profile$estimated[["sales__headline__property_month__profile"]] <- c(1L, 15L)
    assert_error_matching(
      compress_samples(list(sales = sep)),
      "outside the profile panel",
      "profile rows outside the profile panel are rejected"
    )
    assert_true(
      e[["sales__headline__property_month__log_articles"]]$n_retained == 0L,
      "an empty retained set stores nothing else"
    )
    assert_true(
      sample_retained_count(
        compressed$sales,
        "sales__short_window__property_month__post"
      ) ==
        3L &&
        sample_retained_count(compressed$sales, "absent") == 0L,
      "retained counts read from the compressed form"
    )
    s$estimated[["sales__short_window__property_month__post"]] <- 1:3
    assert_error_matching(
      compress_samples(list(sales = s)),
      "outside the variant input",
      "rows outside the variant input are rejected"
    )
    TRUE
  },
  export_artifacts_are_stamped_with_the_fingerprint = function() {
    bundle <- fixture_bundle()
    root <- tempfile("artifacts-")
    dir.create(root)
    cfg <- CONFIG
    cfg$output <- list(
      regs = file.path(root, "regs"),
      tables = file.path(root, "tables"),
      figures = file.path(root, "figures"),
      log = file.path(root, "log")
    )
    written <- export_artifacts(bundle, cfg)
    assert_true(all(file.exists(written)), "every artifact is written")
    csvs <- written[grepl("\\.csv$", written)]
    stamped <- vapply(
      csvs,
      function(p) {
        df <- utils::read.csv(p)
        "fingerprint" %in%
          names(df) &&
          all(df$fingerprint == bundle$metadata$fingerprint$combined)
      },
      logical(1)
    )
    assert_true(
      length(csvs) >= 10L && all(stamped),
      "every CSV carries the combined fingerprint"
    )
    assert_true(
      all(file.exists(file.path(
        cfg$output$figures,
        c(
          "coefficient_comparison.pdf",
          "annual_profiles.pdf",
          "attention_history_sales.pdf",
          "run_fingerprint.txt"
        )
      ))),
      "figures and the fingerprint file are written"
    )
    log_lines <- readLines(file.path(cfg$output$log, "run_log.txt"))
    assert_true(
      any(grepl(
        bundle$metadata$fingerprint$combined,
        log_lines,
        fixed = TRUE
      )) &&
        any(grepl("status: complete", log_lines)),
      "the run log carries the fingerprint and status"
    )
    assert_true(
      length(list.files(
        cfg$output$tables,
        pattern = "\\.tmp$",
        all.files = TRUE
      )) ==
        0L,
      "no staged temp files remain"
    )
    TRUE
  },
